BALA.phalaProse: Viṣamarāśau prathame ṣaḍaṃśe (0–6 aṃśa), samarāśau ca antye ṣaḍaṃśe sthitaḥ grahaḥ bālāvastho bhavati. Eṣa śiśuvat alpatejaskaḥ san svaphalasya pādamātraṃ (25%) vitarati.

KUMARA.phalaProse: Viṣamarāśau dvitīye ṣaḍaṃśe (6–12 aṃśa), samarāśau ca caturthe ṣaḍaṃśe sthitaḥ grahaḥ kumārāvastho bhavati. Eṣa kiśoravat ardhavikasitabalaḥ san svaphalasya ardhabhāgaṃ (50%) prayacchati.

MRITA.phala: Mṛtāvasthāyāṃ grahaḥ sarvathā phalahīnaḥ prāyaḥ śūnyabalaḥ bhavati.
MRITA.phalaProse: Viṣamarāśau antye ṣaḍaṃśe (24–30 aṃśa), samarāśau ca prathame ṣaḍaṃśe sthitaḥ grahaḥ mṛtāvastho bhavati. Eṣa sarvathā niṣprāṇaḥ śūnyabalaḥ san śubhaphalaṃ dātuṃ na śaknoti.

VRIDDHA.phala: Vṛddhāvasthāyāṃ grahaḥ alpabalaṃ kṣīṇaphalaṃ ca dadāti.
VRIDDHA.phalaProse: Viṣamarāśau caturthe ṣaḍaṃśe (18–24 aṃśa), samarāśau ca dvitīye ṣaḍaṃśe sthitaḥ grahaḥ vṛddhāvastho bhavati. Eṣa kṣīyamāṇatejaskaḥ san svaphalasya nagaṇyaṃ bhāgaṃ (prāyaḥ nyūnataraṃ) vitarati.

YUVA.phalaProse: Viṣamarāśau tṛtīye ṣaḍaṃśe (12–18 aṃśa), samarāśau ca tṛtīye ṣaḍaṃśe sthitaḥ grahaḥ yuvāvastho bhavati. Eṣa pūrṇayauvanatejoyuktaḥ san svakārakatvaphalaṃ sampūrṇarūpeṇa (100%) sādhayati. Eṣā sarvaśreṣṭhā balavatī cāvasthā.

DEEPTA.phala: Dīptāvasthāyāṃ (svoccasthaḥ) grahaḥ sarvottamaṃ yaśaḥ aiśvaryaṃ ca dadāti.
DEEPTA.phalaProse: Svoccarāśisthitaḥ grahaḥ dīpta iti kathyate. Eṣaḥ mahātejasā pradīptaḥ san jātakasya paramaṃ saubhāgyaṃ, kīrtiṃ, lakṣmīkṛpāṃ, sarvasukhañca vardhayati. Eṣā sarvaśreṣṭhadaśā.

DINA.phala: Dīnāvasthāyāṃ (śatrurāśisthaḥ) grahaḥ duḥkhaṃ dainyatāṃ ca janayati.
DINA.phalaProse: Śatrurāśisthitaḥ grahaḥ dīna iti kathyate. Eṣaḥ sarvathā balahīnaḥ nirīhaśca bhūtvā jātakasya dainyatāṃ, mānasikakleśaṃ, udyogahāniñca phalayati.

DUKHI.phala: Duḥkhitāvasthāyāṃ (pāpayuktaḥ) grahaḥ śokamayīṃ pīḍāṃ vipattiṃ ca dadāti.
DUKHI.phalaProse: Pāpayuktaḥ śatrusambaddho vā grahaḥ duḥkhita iti vikhyātaḥ. Eṣaḥ śokaviklavaḥ san manastāpaṃ, viphalatāṃ, kauṭumbikakleśaṃ ca sadā janayati.

KHALA.phala: Khalāvasthāyāṃ (nīcasthaḥ) grahaḥ malināṃ buddhiṃ duḥkhaṃ ca janayati.
KHALA.phalaProse: Nīcarāśisthitaḥ grahaḥ khala iti nigadyate. Eṣaḥ duṣṭasvabhāvayuktaḥ san jātakasya kalahapriyatāṃ, durbuddhiṃ, dhanahāniñca sadā prayacchati.

KOPA.phala: Kopāvasthāyāṃ (grahayuddhasthaḥ) grahaḥ mānasikaviplavaṃ vivādaṃ ca janayati.
KOPA.phalaProse: Grahayuddhe parājitaḥ pāpakrāntaḥ vā grahaḥ kopa iti sañjñitaḥ. Eṣaḥ atyantaṃ kruddhaḥ san jātakasya ugratāṃ, kalahaṃ, śatrubhītiñca karoti.

MUDITA.phala: Muditāvasthāyāṃ (mitrarāśisthaḥ) grahaḥ santoṣaṃ sauhārdaṃ ca vardhayati.
MUDITA.phalaProse: Mitrarāśisthitaḥ grahaḥ mudita iti sañjñitaḥ. Eṣaḥ harṣātirekeṇa vidyāṃ, dhanalābhaṃ, bandhujanānāṃ saukhyaṃ, cittaprasannatāñca sadā vitarati.

SHANTA.phala: Śāntāvasthāyāṃ (śubhavargasthaḥ) grahaḥ saumyatāṃ ādhyātmikaśāntiṃ ca dadāti.
SHANTA.phalaProse: Śubhavargeṣu śubhayuktadṛṣṭo vā sthitaḥ grahaḥ śānta iti kathyate. Eṣaḥ praśāntamanaḥ bhūtvā jātakasya satkarmapravṛttiṃ, dhārmikabuddhiṃ, sukhamayīṃ saumyatāñca dadāti.

SWASTHA.phala: Svasthāvasthāyāṃ (svarāśisthaḥ) grahaḥ ārogyaṃ sukhaṃ sthairyaṃ ca karoti.
SWASTHA.phalaProse: Svakīyarāśisthitaḥ grahaḥ svastha iti kathyate. Nijagṛhe niścintaṃ susthitaḥ san eṣaḥ ārogyaṃ, mānasikaśāntiṃ, pārivārikasthairyaṃ, lakṣmīvṛddhiśca sampādayati.

VIKALA.phala: Vikalāvasthāyāṃ (astaṅgataḥ) grahaḥ sarvathā prabhāvarahitaḥ mando vā bhavati.
VIKALA.phalaProse: Sūryatejasā abhibhūtaḥ astaṅgataḥ grahaḥ vikala iti kathyate. Eṣaḥ hṛtatejaskaḥ aṅgahīnaḥ iva bhūtvā svakīyaṃ phalaṃ dātuṃ na śaknoti.

JAGRAT.phalaProse: Svocce svarāśisthe vā vartamānaḥ grahaḥ jāgradavastho jāyate. Eṣa pūrṇasajagaḥ san svakīyakāryāṇi tīvrabalena nirbādhaṃ ca sampādayati.

SUSHUPTI.phala: Suṣuptyavasthāyāṃ grahaḥ prasuptaḥ sarvathā kṣīṇaphalaḥ bhavati.
SUSHUPTI.phalaProse: Śatrugṛhe nīcarāśau vā vartamānaḥ grahaḥ suṣuptyavastho bhavati. Eṣa gāḍhanidritaḥ iva cetanārahitaḥ san niṣphalaprāyaḥ mandabalaśca bhavati.

SWAPNA.phalaProse: Mitragṛhe samarāśau vā vartamānaḥ grahaḥ svapnāvastho bhavati. Eṣa ardhanidritaḥ iva madhyamabalaṃ miśritaphalaṃ vā pradāti.

GARVITA.phala: Garvitāvasthāyāṃ (uccamūlatrikoṇasthaḥ) grahaḥ rājyamānaṃ samṛddhiṃ ca dadāti.
GARVITA.phalaProse: Svakīyoccarāśau mūlatrikoṇe vā sthitaḥ grahaḥ garvita iti kathyate. Eṣaḥ jātakasya rājakīyasammānaṃ, mahāvaibhavaṃ, uccādhikāraṃ, dṛḍhaniścayatāñca phalayati.

KSHOBHITA.phala: Kṣobhitāvasthāyāṃ grahaḥ tīvraṃ viplavaṃ kāryanāśaṃ ca karoti.
KSHOBHITA.phalaProse: Sūryeṇa saha yuktaḥ pāpagrahadṛṣṭaḥ krūrasambaddho vā grahaḥ kṣobhita iti vikhyātaḥ. Eṣaḥ kṣubdhaḥ san jātakasya sarvavighnaṃ, mānasikakleśaṃ, dāridryañca karoti.

KSHUDHA.phala: Kṣudhitāvasthāyāṃ (śatruyuktaḥ) grahaḥ atṛptiṃ duḥkhaṃ dāridryaṃ ca janayati.
KSHUDHA.phalaProse: Śatrurāśau śatruyutaḥ śatrudṛṣṭo vā grahaḥ kṣudhita iti sañjñitaḥ. Eṣaḥ bubhukṣitaḥ iva vyākulaḥ bhūtvā jātakasya nirantarakaṣṭaṃ, daridratām, atṛptiñca karoti.

LAJJITA.phala: Lajjitāvasthāyāṃ grahaḥ ātmaglāniṃ santativighnaṃ ca karoti.
LAJJITA.phalaProse: Pañcamabhāve rāhu-ketu-sūrya-śani-maṅgalaiḥ saha yuktaḥ grahaḥ lajjita iti kathyate. Eṣaḥ jātakasya buddhibhraṃśaṃ, santatipratirodhaṃ, sāmājikamaryādāhāniñca karoti.

MUDITA.phala: Muditāvasthāyāṃ (mitrayuktaḥ) grahaḥ aiśvaryaṃ saukhyaṃ maitrīṃ ca vivardhayati.
MUDITA.phalaProse: Mitrarāśau mitragrahaiḥ yuktaḥ śubhadṛṣṭo vā grahaḥ mudita iti sañjñitaḥ. Eṣaḥ prasannacittaḥ bhūtvā jātakasya sukhasampadaṃ, kauṭumbikapremaṃ, dhanalābhañca sadā karoti.

TRISHITA.phala: Tṛṣitāvasthāyāṃ (jalarāśau pāpadṛṣṭe) grahaḥ cañcalatāṃ bhramaṃ ca janayati.
TRISHITA.phalaProse: Jalarāśau vartamānaḥ pāpagrahaiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yukto vā grahaḥ tṛṣita iti vikhyātaḥ. Eṣaḥ pipāsitaḥ iva cañcalaḥ san jātakasya bhramaṃ, vāsanāṃ, bhāvukakleśañca karoti.

JUPITER.colourProse: Guroḥ śubhavarṇaḥ pītaḥ svarṇaśca; ete jñānadharmasamṛddhiśubhatvavardhakāḥ.
JUPITER.dashaActivationProse: Guroḥ mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā ayaṃ yogaḥ svaphalaṃ prakaṭayati — jñānadhanadharmasantānasambaddharūpeṇa.
JUPITER.dashaPhala: Gurudaśāyāṃ jñānaṃ dhanaṃ santānasukhaṃ dharmaśca, durbale tu śraddhāhāniḥ medorogaśca.
JUPITER.dashaPhalaProse: Gurumahādaśā ṣoḍaśavarṣaparyantā. Balini śubhe gurau jñānalābhaḥ, dhanadhānyasamṛddhiḥ, santānasukham, dharmakarmapravṛttiḥ, gurudevabrāhmaṇasammānaḥ, padonnatiḥ, yaśaśca bhavati. Jātakaḥ sadācārī udāraḥ vivekī āstikaśca. Pāpayute durbale vā gurau śraddhāhāniḥ, santānakleśaḥ, medovṛddhiḥ, yakṛdrogaḥ, dharmavimukhatā, arthahāniśca sambhavati. Guruḥ jñānadhanasantānakārakaḥ ākāśatattvapradhānaśca, ataḥ asya daśā śubhā vṛddhikarī ca.
JUPITER.directionProse: Guroḥ anukūlā dik īśānī (uttarapūrvā); taddigmukhaṃ kāryaṃ jñānadharmasamṛddhipradam.
JUPITER.mantraProse: Guroḥ mantrajapaḥ prātaḥkāle īśānābhimukhaṃ guruvāre ca praśastaḥ; pītapuṣpacandanasahitaḥ.

KETU.colourProse: Ketoḥ śubhavarṇaḥ dhūmraḥ kapiśo (pāṭalamiśraśca); ete vairāgyamokṣādhyātmavardhakāḥ.
KETU.dashaActivationProse: Ketoḥ mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā ayaṃ yogaḥ svaphalaṃ prakaṭayati — vairāgyamokṣādhyātmagūḍhavidyāsambaddharūpeṇa.
KETU.dashaPhala: Ketudaśāyāṃ vairāgyaṃ mokṣapravṛttiḥ ādhyātmikasiddhiśca, duṣṭe tu kleśaḥ bhayaṃ gūḍharogāśca.
KETU.dashaPhalaProse: Ketumahādaśā saptavarṣaparyantā. Śubhasthe balini vā ketau ādhyātmikonnatiḥ, jñānavairāgyam, mokṣapravṛttiḥ, gūḍhavidyāsiddhiḥ, tīrthāṭanam, akasmātphalalābhaśca bhavati. Jātakaḥ antarmukhaḥ vivekī mokṣābhilāṣī ca. Pāpayute durbale vā ketau akāraṇakleśaḥ, aniścitabhayam, gūḍharogaḥ (nidānātītaḥ), apavādaḥ, svajanaviyogaḥ, mānasikavikṣepaśca sambhavati. Ketuḥ chāyāgrahaḥ mokṣakārakaśca, ataḥ asya daśā vairāgyasya āntarikasādhanāyāśca kālaḥ.
KETU.directionProse: Ketoḥ anukūlā dik nairṛtyā; taddigmukhaṃ kāryaṃ vairāgyamokṣādhyātmasiddhipradam.
KETU.mantraProse: Ketoḥ mantrajapaḥ sāyaṅkāle nairṛtyābhimukhaṃ maṅgalavāre ca praśastaḥ; kapiśadravyasahitaḥ.

MARS.colourProse: Kujasya śubhavarṇaḥ raktaḥ aruṇaśca; ete parākramasāhasotsāhavardhakāḥ.
MARS.dashaActivationProse: Kujasya mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā ayaṃ yogaḥ svaphalaṃ prakaṭayati — parākramasāhasabhūmisambaddharūpeṇa.
MARS.dashaPhala: Bhaumadaśāyāṃ parākramaḥ bhūmilābhaḥ sāhasaṃ ca, duṣṭe tu raktapittaṃ kalaho vraṇāśca.
MARS.dashaPhalaProse: Bhaumamahādaśā saptavarṣaparyantā. Balini śubhe kuje parākramaḥ, bhūmilābhaḥ, bhrātṛsukham, senāparākramaḥ, śatrujayaḥ, sāhasam, udyamasiddhiśca bhavati. Jātakaḥ ūrjasvī nirbhīkaḥ kriyāśīlaśca. Pāpayute durbale vā kuje raktapittavikāraḥ, vraṇaḥ, agniśastrabhayam, kalahaḥ, bhrātṛkleśaḥ, raktacāpaśca sambhavati. Kujaḥ agnitattvapradhānaḥ parākramakārakaśca, ataḥ asya daśā sāhasasya saṅgharṣasya ca kālaḥ.
MARS.directionProse: Kujasya anukūlā dik dakṣiṇā; dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ kāryaṃ parākramasāhasapradam.
MARS.mantraProse: Kujasya mantrajapaḥ prātaḥkāle dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ maṅgalavāre ca praśastaḥ; raktapuṣpaguḍasahitaḥ.

MERCURY.dashaActivationProse: Budhasya mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā ayaṃ yogaḥ svaphalaṃ prakaṭayati — buddhivāṇīvyāpārasambaddharūpeṇa.
MERCURY.dashaPhala: Budhadaśāyāṃ vidyā vyāpārakauśalaṃ dhanaṃ ca, duṣṭe tu vākkleśaḥ tvagrogo bhramaśca.
MERCURY.dashaPhalaProse: Budhamahādaśā saptadaśavarṣaparyantā. Balini śubhe budhe vidyālābhaḥ, vyāpārasiddhiḥ, buddhivaibhavam, lekhanavaktṛtvakauśalam, mitrasukham, dhanāgamaḥ, gaṇitaśāstranaipuṇyaṃ ca bhavati. Jātakaḥ caturaḥ vāgmī vyavahārakuśalaśca. Pāpayute durbale vā budhe vākkleśaḥ, tvagrogaḥ, snāyudaurbalyam, buddhibhramaḥ, vyāpārahāniḥ, apavādaśca sambhavati. Budhaḥ buddhivākkārakaḥ pṛthvītattvapradhānaśca, ataḥ asya daśā vidyāyāḥ vāṇijyasya ca kālaḥ.
MERCURY.directionProse: Budhasya anukūlā dik uttarā; uttarābhimukhaṃ kāryaṃ buddhividyāvyāpārapradam.
MERCURY.mantraProse: Budhasya mantrajapaḥ prātaḥkāle uttarābhimukhaṃ budhavāre ca praśastaḥ; haritapuṣpasahitaḥ.

MOON.colourProse: Candrasya śubhavarṇaḥ śvetaḥ rajataśca; ete manaḥśāntisaumyatāmātṛsaukhyavardhakāḥ.
MOON.dashaActivationProse: Candrasya mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā ayaṃ yogaḥ svaphalaṃ prakaṭayati — manaḥsukhamātṛsambaddharūpeṇa.
MOON.dashaPhala: Candradaśāyāṃ manaḥsukhaṃ mātṛsukhaṃ dhanaṃ ca, durbale tu mānasakleśaḥ kapharogāśca.
MOON.dashaPhalaProse: Candramahādaśā daśavarṣaparyantā. Balini śubhe candre manaḥśāntiḥ, mātṛsukham, dhanalābhaḥ, jalayānayātrā, sukhasamṛddhiḥ, janapriyatā, strīsukhaṃ ca bhavati. Jātakaḥ saumyaḥ bhāvukaḥ kalpanāśīlaśca. Kṣīṇe pāpayute vā candre mānasacañcalatā, viṣādaḥ, kaphajvaraḥ, mātṛkleśaḥ, dhananāśaḥ, anidrā ca sambhavati. Candraḥ manaḥkārakaḥ jalatattvapradhānaśca, ataḥ asya daśā bhāvanānāṃ sambandhānāṃ ca prādhānyakālaḥ.
MOON.directionProse: Candrasya anukūlā dik vāyavyā (uttarapaścimā); taddigmukhaṃ kāryaṃ manaḥśāntimātṛsaukhyapradam.
MOON.mantraProse: Candrasya mantrajapaḥ rātrau vāyavyābhimukhaṃ somavāre ca praśastaḥ; śvetapuṣpajalasahitaḥ.

RAHU.colourProse: Rāhoḥ śubhavarṇaḥ dhūmraḥ nīlamiśraśca; ete ākasmikalābharahasyabodhasāhasavardhakāḥ.
RAHU.dashaActivationProse: Rāhoḥ mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā ayaṃ yogaḥ svaphalaṃ prakaṭayati — ākasmikalābhavideśamahattvākāṅkṣāsambaddharūpeṇa.
RAHU.dashaPhala: Rāhudaśāyāṃ ākasmikalābhaḥ videśayogaḥ mahattvākāṅkṣā ca, duṣṭe tu bhramaḥ bhayaṃ viṣarogāśca.
RAHU.dashaPhalaProse: Rāhumahādaśā aṣṭādaśavarṣaparyantā. Śubhasthe balini vā rāhau ākasmikadhanalābhaḥ, videśagamanam, rājanaitikonnatiḥ, apūrvasiddhiḥ, prasiddhiḥ, adbhutakāryasāphalyaṃ ca bhavati. Jātakaḥ mahattvākāṅkṣī kūṭanītijñaḥ apāramparikaśca. Pāpayute durbale vā rāhau buddhibhramaḥ, akāraṇabhayam, viṣakīṭarogaḥ, apavādaḥ, vañcanā, mānasikāśāntiḥ, ākasmikahāniśca sambhavati. Rāhuḥ chāyāgrahaḥ māyākārakaśca, ataḥ asya daśā aniścitaphalā tīvraparivartanakarī ca.
RAHU.directionProse: Rāhoḥ anukūlā dik nairṛtyā (dakṣiṇapaścimā); taddigmukhaṃ kāryaṃ akasmātsiddhivideśayogapradam.
RAHU.mantraProse: Rāhoḥ mantrajapaḥ sāyaṅkāle nairṛtyābhimukhaṃ śanivāre ca praśastaḥ; dhūmradravyasahitaḥ.

SATURN.colourProse: Śaneḥ śubhavarṇaḥ nīlaḥ kṛṣṇaśca; ete dhairyakarmasthairyanyāyavardhakāḥ.
SATURN.dashaActivationProse: Śaneḥ mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā ayaṃ yogaḥ svaphalaṃ prakaṭayati — karmadhairyasevādīrghakālikalābhasambaddharūpeṇa (vilambena kintu sthāyi).
SATURN.dashaPhala: Śanidaśāyāṃ śramaḥ vilambaḥ vairāgyaṃ karmaphalaṃ ca, duṣṭe tu duḥkhaṃ rogo dāridryaṃ ca.
SATURN.dashaPhalaProse: Śanimahādaśā ekonatriṃśadvarṣaparyantā (ekonaviṃśatyadhikavarṣāṇi — 19 varṣāṇi). Balini śubhe śanau dhairyeṇa karmaṇā ca sthāyī siddhiḥ, sevāpadam, bhūmijanasamarthanam, dīrghakālikalābhaḥ, vairāgyavivekaśca bhavati. Jātakaḥ pariśramī sahanaśīlaḥ nyāyapriyaśca. Pāpayute durbale vā śanau duḥkham, vilambaḥ, vātarogaḥ, dāridryam, sthānabhraṃśaḥ, mānasikāvasādaḥ, svajanaviyogaśca sambhavati. Śaniḥ karmāyuḥkārakaḥ vāyutattvapradhānaśca, ataḥ asya daśā śramasya parīkṣāyāḥ paripakvatāyāśca kālaḥ.
SATURN.directionProse: Śaneḥ anukūlā dik paścimā; paścimābhimukhaṃ kāryaṃ dhairyakarmasthairyapradam.
SATURN.mantraProse: Śaneḥ mantrajapaḥ sāyaṅkāle paścimābhimukhaṃ śanivāre ca praśastaḥ; nīlapuṣpatailasahitaḥ.

SUN.colourProse: Sūryasya śubhavarṇaḥ raktaḥ tāmraḥ kesaraśca; ete varṇāḥ ātmabalatejaḥpratiṣṭhāvardhakāḥ.
SUN.dashaActivationProse: Sūryasya mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā ayaṃ yogaḥ svaphalaṃ prakaṭayati — pratiṣṭhādhikāratejaḥsambaddharūpeṇa.
SUN.dashaPhala: Sūryadaśāyāṃ rājamānyatā tejaḥ pitṛsukhaṃ ca, kintu pittajarogāḥ kleśāśca.
SUN.dashaPhalaProse: Sūryamahādaśā ṣaḍvarṣaparyantā. Śubhasthe balini sūrye rājasammānaḥ, adhikāraḥ, pitṛsukham, ārogyam, uccapadaprāptiḥ, dhairyaṃ ca bhavati. Jātakaḥ tejasvī ātmaviśvāsī netṛtvaguṇayuktaśca jāyate. Durbale pāpayute vā sūrye pittajvaraḥ, netrarogaḥ, pitṛkleśaḥ, uccādhikāribhiḥ saha virodhaḥ, sthānabhraṃśaśca sambhavati. Sūryaḥ agnitattvapradhānaḥ ātmakārakaśca, ataḥ asya daśā ātmapratiṣṭhāyāḥ kīrteśca kālaḥ.
SUN.directionProse: Sūryasya anukūlā dik pūrvā; pūrvābhimukhaṃ kāryaṃ upāsanā ca tejobalapradā.
SUN.mantraProse: Sūryasya mantrajapaḥ aruṇodaye (sūryodayakāle) pūrvābhimukhaṃ ravivāre ca praśastaḥ; tāmrapātrajalārghyasahitaḥ.

VENUS.colourProse: Śukrasya śubhavarṇaḥ śvetaḥ gulābī vicitraśca; ete sukhasaubhāgyakalādāmpatyavardhakāḥ.
VENUS.dashaActivationProse: Śukrasya mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā ayaṃ yogaḥ svaphalaṃ prakaṭayati — sukhavaibhavadāmpatyakalāsambaddharūpeṇa.
VENUS.dashaPhala: Śukradaśāyāṃ sukhaṃ vaibhavaṃ kalāsaubhāgyaṃ dāmpatyasukhaṃ ca, duṣṭe tu kāmakleśo mūtrarogaśca.
VENUS.dashaPhalaProse: Śukramahādaśā viṃśativarṣaparyantā. Balini śubhe śukre sukhasamṛddhiḥ, vāhanabhūṣaṇavastralābhaḥ, kalāsaṅgītaprītiḥ, dāmpatyasukham, strīsaubhāgyam, bhogaiśvaryaṃ ca bhavati. Jātakaḥ saundaryapriyaḥ rasikaḥ ākarṣakaśca. Pāpayute durbale vā śukre kāmakleśaḥ, dāmpatyavirodhaḥ, mūtrajananarogaḥ, madhumehaḥ, bhogātirekahāniśca sambhavati. Śukraḥ kalākāmabhogakārakaḥ jalatattvapradhānaśca, ataḥ asya daśā sukhasaubhāgyabhogānāṃ kālaḥ.
VENUS.directionProse: Śukrasya anukūlā dik āgneyī (dakṣiṇapūrvā); taddigmukhaṃ kāryaṃ sukhasaubhāgyadāmpatyapradam.
VENUS.mantraProse: Śukrasya mantrajapaḥ prātaḥkāle āgneyābhimukhaṃ śukravāre ca praśastaḥ; śvetapuṣpasugandhasahitaḥ.

ABHUKTA_MOOLA_DOSHA.timingProse: Abhuktamūladoṣasya (jyeṣṭhāntamūlādinakṣatrasandhau janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ bālye prathamavarṣeṣu prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle bālārogyakleśaḥ, pitṛmātṛsannidhau ariṣṭasūcanaṃ ca. Aṣṭottarīdaśārambhe viśeṣataḥ sāvadhānatā; śāntikarmaṇā (mūlaśāntyā) parihāraḥ.

AMAVASYA_DOSHA.timing: Amāvāsyādoṣaḥ candradaśāyāṃ kṣīṇacandragocare ca manobalakṣayaṃ sūcayati.
AMAVASYA_DOSHA.timingProse: Amāvāsyādoṣasya (amāvāsyāsannidhau kṣīṇacandrajanmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ candramahādaśāntardaśāsu, amāvāsyāsannidhigocare ca. Asmin kāle manobalakṣayaḥ, ātmaviśvāsanyūnatā, mātṛsukhabādhā, viṣādaśca sūcyate. Śubhagrahayoge pūrṇimāgocare ca śamanam.

ANGARAK_DOSHA.timingProse: Aṅgārakadoṣasya (maṅgalarāhuyuteḥ) phalakālaḥ kuja-rāhu mahādaśāntardaśāsu. Asmin kāle atyadhikakrodhaḥ, raktapittavikāraḥ, agniśastradurghaṭanābhayam, ākasmikakalahaśca sūcyate. Kujagocare rāhusthānopari phalodrekaḥ; dhairyasaṃyamābhyāṃ śamanam.

ANSHIK_MANGAL.timing: Āṃśikamaṅgaladoṣaḥ kujadaśāyāṃ vivāhakāle ca alpadāmpatyakleśaṃ sūcayati.
ANSHIK_MANGAL.timingProse: Āṃśikamaṅgaladoṣasya (nyūnatarakujadoṣasya) phalakālaḥ kujamahādaśāntardaśāsu, vivāhayogye vayasi ca. Pūrṇamaṅgalāpekṣayā alpataraḥ kleśaḥ — svalpadāmpatyamatabhedaḥ, ārambhavilambaḥ vā. Kujagocare saptame phalodrekaḥ; bhaṅgayoge prāyaḥ nagaṇyam.

BADHAKA_DOSHA.timing: Bādhakadoṣaḥ bādhakeśadaśāyāṃ bādhakagrahagocare ca vighnabādhāṃ sūcayati.
BADHAKA_DOSHA.timingProse: Bādhakadoṣasya phalakālaḥ bādhakeśa (care ekādaśeśaḥ, sthire navameśaḥ, dvisvabhāve saptameśaḥ) mahādaśāntardaśāsu. Asmin kāle akasmāt vighnāḥ, kāryavilambaḥ, guptavirodhaḥ, siddhiprāye bādhā ca sūcyate. Bādhakeśagocare bādhakasthānopari phalodrekaḥ; bādhakeśaśāntyā śamanam.

BANDHU_DOSHA.timingProse: Bandhudoṣasya phalakālaḥ caturtheśa (bandhubhāveśa) tatsambaddhagrahāṇāṃ ca daśāsu. Asmin kāle mātṛsukhabādhā, gṛhakleśaḥ, bandhuvirodhaḥ, sthāvarasampattivighnaśca sūcyate. Kaṇṭakaśanigocare caturthe phalodrekaḥ; caturtheśabale śamanam.

BHADRA_DOSHA.timingProse: Bhadrādoṣasya (viṣṭi-bhadrākaraṇe janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ śubhakāryārambhakāle, tathā bhadrākaraṇagocare prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle śubhakāryavighnaḥ, ārambhavilambaḥ, akasmātbādhā ca sūcyate. Bhadrāmukhatyāgena śubhamuhūrtacayanena ca parihāraḥ.

BHAKOOT_DOSHA.timing: Bhakūṭadoṣaḥ vivāhottarakāle rāśyantaragocare ca dāmpatyāsāmañjasyaṃ sūcayati.
BHAKOOT_DOSHA.timingProse: Bhakūṭadoṣasya (vadhūvarayoḥ candrarāśyoḥ ṣaḍaṣṭadvidvādaśādisambandhasya) phalakālaḥ vivāhottaraṃ dāmpatyajīvane prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle manomilanābhāvaḥ, ārthikasantānaviṣamatā, pārasparikamatabhedaśca sūcyate. Rāśīśamaitryāṃ grahabale ca śamanam; gocare candrayoḥ viṣamasthitau phalodrekaḥ.

BRAHMA_DOSHA.timing: Brahmadoṣaḥ gurudaśāyāṃ dvitīyapañcameśadaśāyāṃ ca, dharmalopajaphalaṃ sūcayati.
BRAHMA_DOSHA.timingProse: Brahmadoṣasya (brahmahatyādipūrvajakarmasūcakasya) phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ guru (dharmakāraka) mahādaśāyām, tathā dvitīyapañcamanavameśadaśāsu prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle kuladharmalopajaḥ kleśaḥ, santānabādhā, vidyāvyāghātaśca sūcyate. Gurugocare pañcame navame vā śubhe śamanam; brāhmaṇapūjādānādibhiḥ śāntiḥ.

CHANDAL_DOSHA.timingProse: Cāṇḍāladoṣasya (gururāhuyuteḥ, gurucāṇḍālasadṛśasya) phalakālaḥ guru-rāhu daśāsu. Asmin kāle dharmavivekabhramaḥ, gurujanavirodhaḥ, anaitikākarṣaṇam, uccaśikṣāvighnaśca sūcyate. Gurugocare svoccamitrarāśau śubhe śamanam.

CHANDRA_DOSHA.timing: Candradoṣaḥ candradaśāyāṃ durbalagocare ca mānasamātṛkleśaṃ sūcayati.
CHANDRA_DOSHA.timingProse: Candradoṣasya (candrapīḍāyāḥ) phalakālaḥ candramahādaśāntardaśāsu, tathā kṣīṇacandragocare amāvāsyāsannidhau ca. Asmin kāle mānasacañcalatā, viṣādaḥ, mātṛkleśaḥ, kaphajarogaḥ, nidrābhaṅgaśca sūcyate. Śubhacandragocare pūrṇimāsannidhau ca śamanam.

DAGDHA_RASHI_DOSHA.timingProse: Dagdharāśidoṣasya (vāratithisaṃyogena dagdhabhūtarāśau grahasthiteḥ) phalakālaḥ dagdharāśīśasya tatsthagrahāṇāṃ ca daśāsu. Asmin kāle tadrāśisambaddhabhāvaphalakṣayaḥ, prayatnaniṣphalatā, miśraphalaṃ ca sūcyate. Śubhagrahadṛṣṭyā bale ca phalaṃ kiñcit sudharati.

DARIDRA_DOSHA.timingProse: Daridradoṣasya (dhanalābhasthānadūṣaṇasya) phalakālaḥ dhaneśa (dvitīyeśa) lābheśa (ekādaśeśa) taddūṣakagrahāṇāṃ ca daśāsu. Asmin kāle arthasaṅkaṭaḥ, vyayādhikyam, ṛṇavṛddhiḥ, sañcayabādhā ca sūcyate. Śubhagrahadaśāgocare dvitīyaikādaśe śamanam.

ECLIPSE_DOSHA.timing: Grahaṇajanmadoṣaḥ sūryacandrarāhuketudaśāyāṃ grahaṇakāle ca tīvraphalaṃ sūcayati.
ECLIPSE_DOSHA.timingProse: Grahaṇajanmadoṣasya (grahaṇakāle janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ sūryacandrarāhuketūnāṃ daśāsu, tathā pratyakṣagrahaṇakāle prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle ārogyakleśaḥ, mānasikāśāntiḥ, pitṛmātṛsukhabādhā, akasmātvighnaśca sūcyate. Grahaṇaśāntijapadānaiḥ parihāraḥ.

GANA_DOSHA.timingProse: Gaṇadoṣasya (vadhūvarayoḥ devamanuṣyarākṣasagaṇavaiṣamyasya, viśeṣataḥ devarākṣasamelane) phalakālaḥ vivāhottaraṃ prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle svabhāvabhedaḥ, mānasikamatabhedaḥ, pārasparikāsantoṣaśca sūcyate. Rāśīśamaitryāṃ nāḍībhede ca śamanam; candrabale manomilanam.

GANDANTA_DOSHA.timing: Gaṇḍāntadoṣaḥ bālye tatsandhinakṣatrarāśigocare ca ariṣṭaṃ sūcayati.
GANDANTA_DOSHA.timingProse: Gaṇḍāntadoṣasya (jalāgnirāśyoḥ sandhau, mīnameṣakarkasiṃhavṛścikadhanuḥsandhau, revatyaśvinyādinakṣatrasandhau janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ bālye prathamavarṣeṣu, tatsandhigocare ca prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle bālāriṣṭam, ārogyabhayam, pitṛmātṛkleśaśca. Gaṇḍāntaśāntyā parihāraḥ.

GRAHAN_DOSHA.timing: Grahaṇadoṣaḥ sūryacandrarāhuketudaśāyāṃ grahaṇakāle ca tīvraṃ phalati.
GRAHAN_DOSHA.timingProse: Grahaṇadoṣasya (sūryacandrayoḥ rāhuketuyuteḥ) phalakālaḥ teṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ mahādaśāntardaśāsu, tathā pratyakṣagrahaṇakāle (sūryagrahaṇe candragrahaṇe vā) tīvratamaṃ prakaṭībhavati. Grasitasūrye pitṛātmabalakṣayaḥ, grasitacandre mātṛmanobalakṣayaśca sūcyate. Rāhuketugocare janmasūryacandropari phalodrekaḥ.

GURU_CHANDAL.timingProse: Gurucāṇḍālayogasya (gururāhuyuteḥ) phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ guru-rāhu mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ ca prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle vivekabhramaḥ, dharmavimukhatā, gurujanavirodhaḥ, anaitikamārgākarṣaṇaṃ ca sūcyate; kintu balini gurau apūrvā aparamparāgatā siddhirapi. Gurugocare svoccamitrarāśau śubhe śamanam.

KALA_AMRITA_YOGA.timingProse: Kālāmṛtayogasya (ketulagnataḥ rāhusaptamāntaṃ sarvagrahasamāveśasya, kālasarpasya śubhaprakārasya) phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu. Asmin kāle prārambhe vilambasaṅgharṣau, tataḥ paraṃ (prāyaḥ pañcatriṃśadvarṣānantaram) akasmāt asādhāraṇasiddhiḥ, ādhyātmikonnatiśca sūcyate. Dhairyeṇa phalaṃ madhuram.

KALSARPA.timing: Kālasarpadoṣaḥ rāhuketudaśāyāṃ śanigocare ca prabalaṃ phalati.
KALSARPA.timingProse: Kālasarpadoṣasya pradhānaphalakālaḥ rāhu-ketu mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ ca bhavati, yadā sarvagrahāṇāṃ rāhuketvakṣamadhyasthatvena sañcitaḥ doṣaḥ vipākaṃ yāti. Śaneḥ gocare viśeṣataḥ janmarāśitaḥ sāḍhesātīkāle, grahaṇakāle ca phalodrekaḥ. Prāyaḥ pañcaviṃśatitaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadvarṣamadhye jīvanasaṅgharṣaḥ prakaṭībhavati; tataḥ paraṃ krameṇa śamanam.

KALSARPA_ANANT.timingProse: Anantakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ lagne ketuḥ saptame tiṣṭhataḥ. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketu mahādaśāntardaśāsu, viśeṣataḥ pañcaviṃśativarṣānantaram. Asmin kāle ātmaviśvāsabhaṅgaḥ, svāsthyabādhā, dāmpatyakleśaśca; śanisāḍhesātīkāle phalodrekaḥ. Śanaiḥ paripakvatayā śamanam.

KALSARPA_GHATAK.timingProse: Ghātakakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ daśame ketuḥ caturthe. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle karmakṣetravighnaḥ, padapratiṣṭhābhaṅgaḥ, vyavasāyāniścayaḥ, uccādhikārivirodhaśca sūcyate. Tathāpi daśamastharāhuḥ rājanaitikonnatyarthamapi balī. Śanigocare daśame phalodrekaḥ.

KALSARPA_KARKOTAK.timingProse: Karkoṭakakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ aṣṭame ketuḥ dvitīye. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle āyukṣayabhayam, guhyarogaḥ, ākasmikavighnaḥ, mānasikāśāntiśca sūcyate. Tathāpi gūḍhavidyāsiddhyarthamapi kalpate. Śanigocare aṣṭame phalodrekaḥ.

KALSARPA_KULIK.timingProse: Kulikakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ dvitīye ketuḥ aṣṭame. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle dhanasañcayabādhā, vākkleśaḥ, kuṭumbavirodhaḥ, ākasmikavyayaśca sūcyate. Śanigocare dvitīye aṣṭame vā phalodrekaḥ.

KALSARPA_MAHAPADMA.timingProse: Mahāpadmakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ ṣaṣṭhe ketuḥ dvādaśe. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle śatrupīḍā, rogaḥ, ṛṇavṛddhiḥ, vyayādhikyaṃ ca sūcyate. Tathāpi ṣaṣṭhastharāhuḥ śatrujayāya api kalpate yadā balī. Śanigocare ṣaṣṭhe dvādaśe vā phalodrekaḥ.

KALSARPA_PADMA.timingProse: Padmakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ pañcame ketuḥ ekādaśe. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle santānotpattivilambaḥ, vidyāvyāghātaḥ, buddhibhramaśca sūcyate. Rāhugocare pañcame phalodrekaḥ; pañcameśabale śamanam.

KALSARPA_SHANKHACHUD.timingProse: Śaṅkhacūḍakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ navame ketuḥ tṛtīye. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle bhāgyavilambaḥ, dharmavibhramaḥ, pitṛkleśaḥ, dīrghayātrāvighnaśca sūcyate. Rāhugocare navame phalodrekaḥ; gurubale śamanam.

KALSARPA_SHANKHPAL.timingProse: Śaṅkhapālakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ caturthe ketuḥ daśame. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle mātṛsukhabādhā, gṛhavāhanakleśaḥ, mānasikāśāntiḥ, karmakṣetravighnaśca sūcyate. Kaṇṭakaśanigocare (caturthe) phalodrekaḥ.

KALSARPA_SHESHNAG.timingProse: Śeṣanāgakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ dvādaśe ketuḥ ṣaṣṭhe. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle vyayādhikyam, nidrābhaṅgaḥ, guptaśatrubhayam, videśavāsaḥ, mānasikāśāntiśca sūcyate. Tathāpi dvādaśastharāhuḥ mokṣādhyātmasādhanārthamapi kalpate.

KALSARPA_TAKSHAK.timingProse: Takṣakakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ saptame ketuḥ lagne. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu, viśeṣataḥ vivāhakāle. Asmin kāle dāmpatyakleśaḥ, bhāgīdārīvirodhaḥ, vivāhavilambaḥ, paradeśasambandhaśca sūcyate. Śanigocare saptame phalodrekaḥ.

KALSARPA_VASUKI.timingProse: Vāsukikālasarpayoge rāhuḥ tṛtīye ketuḥ navame. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle parākramabādhā, bhrātṛvirodhaḥ, bhāgyavilambaḥ, yātrākleśaśca sūcyate. Udyame tu rāhubalāt asādhāraṇasāhasam.

KALSARPA_VISHDHAR.timingProse: Viṣadharakālasarpayoge rāhuḥ ekādaśe ketuḥ pañcame. Phalakālaḥ rāhu-ketudaśāsu; asmin kāle lābhavilambaḥ, mitravirodhaḥ, icchāpūrtivighnaḥ, ākasmikalābhahānicakraṃ ca sūcyate. Tathāpi ekādaśastharāhuḥ ākasmikamahālābhāyāpi kalpate.

KEMDRUM_DOSHA.timing: Kemadrumadoṣaḥ candradaśāyāṃ candragocare ca mānasakleśadāridryaṃ sūcayati.
KEMDRUM_DOSHA.timingProse: Kemadrumadoṣasya (candrāt dvitīyadvādaśayoḥ grahābhāve) phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ candramahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ ca prakaṭībhavati. Candrasya durbalagocarakāle, amāvāsyāsannidhau ca mānasacañcalatā, ekākitvam, arthasaṅkaṭaṃ ca vardhate. Yadi candraḥ kendre śubhadṛṣṭe vā bhavati tadā bhaṅgaḥ; anyathā bālye yauvane vā kleśaḥ.

KENDRADHIPATI_DOSHA.timingProse: Kendrādhipatidoṣasya (śubhagrahasya kendreśatvena śubhatvahāneḥ) phalakālaḥ tasya śubhagrahasya (guruśukrādeḥ) kendreśasya mahādaśāntardaśāsu. Asmin kāle apekṣitaśubhaphalakṣayaḥ, miśraphalam, udyame aniścayaśca sūcyate. Kendreśasya anyaśubhasambandhe phalaṃ kiñcit sudharati.

KRISHNA_PAKSHA_DOSHA.timing: Kṛṣṇapakṣadoṣaḥ candradaśāyāṃ kṣīṇacandragocare ca manobalanyūnatāṃ sūcayati.
KRISHNA_PAKSHA_DOSHA.timingProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣadoṣasya (kṛṣṇapakṣe kṣīṇacandrajanmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ candramahādaśāntardaśāsu, kṛṣṇapakṣagocare ca. Asmin kāle manobalanyūnatā, ātmaviśvāsābhāvaḥ, cañcalatā, mātṛsukhabādhā ca sūcyate. Śuklapakṣagocare pūrṇimāsannidhau śubhagrahayoge ca śamanam.

KUJA_BHANGA_ABSENT.timingProse: Kujabhaṅgābhāvasya (maṅgaladoṣasya bhaṅgayogābhāvasya) phalakālaḥ kujamahādaśāntardaśāsu, vivāhakāle ca. Bhaṅgābhāvāt maṅgaladoṣaḥ anivāritaḥ pūrṇaphaladaḥ — dāmpatyakleśaḥ, vivāhavilambaśca prabalataraḥ. Ubhayoḥ doṣasāmye parihāraḥ; anyathā kujagocare saptame phalodrekaḥ.

MAHENDRA_ABSENCE.timingProse: Mahendrābhāvasya (varanakṣatrāt vadhūnakṣatrasya caturthasaptadaśādigaṇanāyā abhāvasya) phalakālaḥ vivāhottaraṃ prakaṭībhavati. Ayaṃ doṣo na prabalaḥ kintu śubhābhāvasūcakaḥ — dīrghāyuvaṃśasantānavṛddheḥ mahendrakṛtaśubhasya abhāvamātram. Anyakūṭabale phalaṃ sāmānyam.

MANGAL_DOSHA.timing: Maṅgaladoṣaḥ kujadaśāyāṃ kujagocare ca viśeṣataḥ vivāhakāle phalati.
MANGAL_DOSHA.timingProse: Maṅgaladoṣasya phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ kuja (maṅgala) mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ vā, tathā vivāhayogye vayasi (prāyaḥ caturviṃśatitaḥ triṃśadvarṣaparyantam) prakaṭībhavati. Kujasya saptamāṣṭamalagnādigocare dāmpatyakleśaḥ vardhate. Yadi aniṣṭakujaḥ saptameśadaśāṃ prāpnoti tadā vivāhavilambaḥ kalaho vā sambhavati. Bhaṅgayogasattve (kujabhaṅge) phalaṃ nyūnībhavati.

MATRI_DOSHA.timingProse: Mātṛdoṣasya phalakālaḥ caturtheśa (mātṛbhāveśa) mātṛkārakacandrayoḥ daśāsu. Asmin kāle mātṛārogyakleśaḥ, mātṛviyogabhayam, gṛhasukhabādhā ca sūcyate. Candragocare kṣīṇe caturthe vā phalodrekaḥ; candracaturtheśabale śamanam.

MOOL_DOSHA.timing: Mūladoṣaḥ bālye (viśeṣataḥ prathamavarṣe) pitṛmātṛsannidhau ariṣṭaṃ sūcayati.
MOOL_DOSHA.timingProse: Mūladoṣasya (mūlāśleṣājyeṣṭhārevatyādimūlasañjñakanakṣatre janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ bālye prathamavarṣeṣu prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle bālārogyakleśaḥ, pādacaraṇabhedānusāraṃ pitṛmātṛkulāriṣṭasūcanaṃ ca. Mūlaśāntikarmaṇā (saptaviṃśatidinottaraṃ nakṣatrajapena) parihāraḥ.

MRITYU_BHAGA_DOSHA.timingProse: Mṛtyubhāgadoṣasya (grahasya mṛtyubhāgāṃśe sthiteḥ) phalakālaḥ tasya grahasya mahādaśāntardaśāsu prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle tatkārakabhāvasambaddhāriṣṭam, ārogyakleśaḥ, tatkārakaviṣayavighnaśca sūcyate. Grahaśāntyā tadbhāvabale ca parihāraḥ.

NADI_DOSHA.timingProse: Nāḍīdoṣasya (vadhūvarayoḥ ekanāḍīsāmyasya, aṣṭakūṭe gurutamadoṣasya) phalakālaḥ vivāhottaraṃ santānārogyaviṣaye prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle santānotpattibādhā, dāmpatyārogyakleśaḥ, vaṃśavṛddhivighnaśca sūcyate. Nāḍībhede rāśīśaikye nakṣatrabhede vā śamanam.

NAGA_DOSHA.timing: Nāgadoṣaḥ rāhuketudaśāyāṃ pañcameśadaśāyāṃ ca santānabādhāṃ sūcayati.
NAGA_DOSHA.timingProse: Nāgadoṣasya (sarpaśāpasūcakasya) phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ rāhu-ketu mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ ca, tathā pañcameśa (santānabhāveśa) daśāyāṃ prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle santānotpattivilambaḥ, garbhabādhā, santānārogyakleśaśca sūcyate. Rāhuketugocare pañcame phalodrekaḥ; nāgapūjāsarpasaṃskārādibhiḥ śāntiḥ.

PATNI_DOSHA.timingProse: Patnīdoṣasya phalakālaḥ saptameśa (kalatrabhāveśa) dārakārakaśukrayoḥ daśāsu, viśeṣataḥ vivāhottarakāle. Asmin kāle dāmpatyavirodhaḥ, kalatrārogyakleśaḥ, viyogabhayaśca sūcyate. Śanigocare saptame śukre kṣīṇe vā phalodrekaḥ; saptameśaśukrabale śamanam.

PITRA_DOSHA.timing: Pitṛdoṣaḥ sūryarāhudaśāyāṃ navameśadaśāyāṃ ca, grahaṇakāle ca phalati.
PITRA_DOSHA.timingProse: Pitṛdoṣasya phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ sūrya-rāhu mahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ ca, tathā navameśa (bhāgyeśa) pitṛkārakasūryasambaddhadaśāyāṃ prakaṭībhavati. Sūryagrahaṇakāle, pitṛpakṣe, śanigocare ca pitṛṛṇaphalodrekaḥ. Santānasukhe, pitṛsukhe, vaṃśavṛddhau ca bādhā anena kālena sūcyate. Śrāddhatarpaṇādibhiḥ śāntiḥ.

PURNA_MANGAL.timing: Pūrṇamaṅgaladoṣaḥ kujadaśāyāṃ vivāhakāle ca prabaladāmpatyakleśaṃ sūcayati.
PURNA_MANGAL.timingProse: Pūrṇamaṅgaladoṣasya (prabalakujadoṣasya) phalakālaḥ kujamahādaśāntardaśāsu, vivāhayogye vayasi ca tīvratamam. Asmin kāle dāmpatyavirodhaḥ, vivāhavilambaḥ, kalatrārogyakleśaśca. Kujagocare saptamāṣṭame phalodrekaḥ; ubhayoḥ melane (vadhūvarayoḥ) doṣasāmye parasparaṃ śamanam.

PUTRA_DOSHA.timingProse: Putradoṣasya phalakālaḥ pañcameśa (santānabhāveśa) putrakārakaguruyoḥ daśāsu. Asmin kāle santānotpattivilambaḥ, garbhabādhā, santānārogyacintā ca sūcyate. Rāhuketugocare pañcame gurau kṣīṇe vā phalodrekaḥ; pañcameśagurubale santānasaukhyam.

RAJJU_DOSHA.timingProse: Rajjudoṣasya (vadhūvaranakṣatrayoḥ ekarajjusāmyasya) phalakālaḥ vivāhottaraṃ prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle dāmpatyadīrghāyurbādhā, viyogabhayam, sahajīvanakleśaśca sūcyate (rajjubhedānusāraṃ śiraḥkaṇṭhādiaṅgaphalam). Rajjubhede śubhagrahabale ca śamanam.

RIN_DOSHA_PITRI.timingProse: Pitṛṛṇadoṣasya phalakālaḥ sūrya (pitṛkāraka) navameśayoḥ daśāsu. Asmin kāle pitṛkulaṛṇajaḥ kleśaḥ, pitṛsukhabādhā, kartavyabhāraḥ, akāraṇavilambaśca sūcyate. Sūryagrahaṇapitṛpakṣayoḥ phalodrekaḥ; pitṛtarpaṇaśrāddhaiḥ śāntiḥ.

RIN_DOSHA_STRI.timingProse: Strīṛṇadoṣasya phalakālaḥ śukra (strīkāraka) saptameśayoḥ daśāsu. Asmin kāle strīvargasambandhita ṛṇajaḥ kleśaḥ, dāmpatyabādhā, strīśāpasūcakavighnaśca sūcyate. Śukragocare kṣīṇe saptame vā phalodrekaḥ; strīsammānadānadharmaiḥ śāntiḥ.

RIN_DOSHA_SWAJAN.timingProse: Svajanaṛṇadoṣasya phalakālaḥ tṛtīyeśa (bhrātṛbhāveśa) ekādaśeśa (lābhabandhubhāveśa) ca daśāsu. Asmin kāle bandhusvajanasambandhita ṛṇajaḥ kleśaḥ, bhrātṛvirodhaḥ, sahāyakavañcanā ca sūcyate. Śanigocare tṛtīyaikādaśe phalodrekaḥ; svajanasevādānaiḥ śāntiḥ.

SANKRANTI_DOSHA.timing: Saṅkrāntidoṣaḥ sūryadaśāyāṃ saṅkrāntigocarakāle ca kleśaṃ sūcayati.
SANKRANTI_DOSHA.timingProse: Saṅkrāntidoṣasya (sūryasaṅkrāntipuṇyakālasannidhau janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ sūryamahādaśāntardaśāsu, saṅkrāntigocarakāle ca prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle ārogyacañcalatā, pitṛsukhabādhā, miśraphalaṃ ca sūcyate (saṅkrāntiprakārānusāraṃ phalabhedaḥ). Sūryaśāntidānaiḥ parihāraḥ.

SHANI_DOSHA.timing: Śanidoṣaḥ śanimahādaśāyāṃ sāḍhesātīkāle ca śramavilambakleśaṃ sūcayati.
SHANI_DOSHA.timingProse: Śanidoṣasya phalakālaḥ prāyaḥ śanimahādaśāyām antardaśāyāṃ ca, viśeṣataḥ janmarāśitaḥ sāḍhesātī (sārdhasaptavarṣātmake śanigocare) tathā kaṇṭakaśani (caturthāṣṭamagocare) kāle prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle śramādhikyam, vilambaḥ, sthānabhraṃśaḥ, svajanaviyogaśca; kintu dhairyeṇa karmaṇā ca ante sthāyī phalaprāptiḥ.

SHRAPIT_DOSHA.timingProse: Śāpitadoṣasya (śanirāhuyuteḥ, pūrvajanmaśāpasūcakasya) phalakālaḥ śani-rāhu mahādaśāntardaśāsu, viśeṣataḥ sāḍhesātīkāle. Asmin kāle dīrghakālikavilambaḥ, akāraṇakleśaḥ, svajanaviyogaḥ, mānasikāvasādaḥ, karmabandhaśca sūcyate. Dhairyasevādānadharmaiḥ krameṇa śamanam.

STREE_DEERGH_ABSENCE.timingProse: Strīdīrghābhāvasya (varanakṣatrāt vadhūnakṣatrasya navādhikagaṇanāyā abhāvasya) phalakālaḥ vivāhottaraṃ prakaṭībhavati. Ayaṃ śubhābhāvasūcakaḥ — dāmpatyasaukhyasya dīrghatāyāḥ strīdīrghakṛtaśubhasya abhāvamātram, na prabaladoṣaḥ. Rāśīśamaitryāṃ grahabale ca phalaṃ sāmānyam.

TITHI_DOSHA.timingProse: Tithidoṣasya (riktā-kṣaya-dagdhāditithau janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ śubhakāryārambhakāle, tattithigocare ca prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle śubhakāryavighnaḥ, ārambhavilambaḥ, saṅkalpabhaṅgaśca sūcyate. Śubhatithimuhūrtacayanena parihāraḥ.

VAIDHRITI_DOSHA.timingProse: Vaidhṛtiyogadoṣasya (vaidhṛti-vyatīpātādiduṣṭayoge janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ śubhakāryārambhakāle, tadyogagocare ca prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle śubhakāryabādhā, akasmātvighnaḥ, saṅkalpavikṣepaśca sūcyate. Yogaśāntyā śubhamuhūrtacayanena ca parihāraḥ.

VEDHA_DOSHA.timingProse: Vedhadoṣasya (vadhūvarayoḥ nakṣatrayoḥ parasparavedhasya) phalakālaḥ vivāhottaraṃ prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle pārasparikabādhā, akāraṇavirodhaḥ, sahajīvanavighnaśca sūcyate. Vedhanakṣatrayoḥ rāśīśamaitryāṃ śubhagrahayoge ca śamanam.

VISHA_KANYA_DOSHA.timingProse: Viṣakanyādoṣasya (tithivāranakṣatraduṣṭasaṃyogajanmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ vivāhottaraṃ dāmpatyajīvane prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle dāmpatyavirodhaḥ, kalatrārogyakleśaḥ, vaivāhikasaukhyabādhā ca sūcyate. Śubhagrahayoge grahabale śāntikarmaṇā ca doṣo nyūnībhavati; adhunā ayaṃ doṣo vivādāspadaḥ bahubhiḥ khaṇḍitaśca.

VISH_YOGA_DOSHA.timingProse: Viṣayogadoṣasya (śanicandrayuteḥ) phalakālaḥ śani-candra mahādaśāntardaśāsu, tathā sāḍhesātīkāle. Asmin kāle mānasaviṣādaḥ, nirāśā, ekākitvam, utsāhakṣayaḥ, kaphavātarogaśca sūcyate. Śubhacandragocare gurudṛṣṭyā ca śamanam.

VYATIPATA_DOSHA.timingProse: Vyatīpātayogadoṣasya (saptadaśe vyatīpātayoge janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ śubhakāryārambhakāle, vyatīpātagocare ca prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle akasmātvighnaḥ, durghaṭanābhayam, saṅkalpabhaṅgaśca sūcyate. Yogaśāntyā śubhamuhūrtacayanena ca parihāraḥ.

YAMAGHANTA_DOSHA.timingProse: Yamaghaṇṭadoṣasya (vāranakṣatraduṣṭasaṃyoge, yamaghaṇṭayoge janmanaḥ) phalakālaḥ śubhakāryārambhakāle, tadyogagocare ca prakaṭībhavati. Asmin kāle śubhakāryabādhā, yātrāvighnaḥ, akasmātkleśaśca sūcyate. Śubhamuhūrtacayanena yogaśāntyā ca parihāraḥ.

DEVA.phalaProse: Devagaṇe nava nakṣatrāṇi (aśvinī, mṛgaśirā, punarvasu, puṣya, hasta, svāti, anurādhā, śravaṇa, revatī ca) antarbhavanti. Devagaṇajātaḥ sāttvikasvabhāvaḥ, saumyaḥ, paropakārī, ṛjuḥ, kṣamāśīlaḥ, devapūjādidharmakarmanirataśca bhavati. Śāntacittaḥ niyamapriyaḥ mitabhāṣī ca; krodhalobhādayo vikārāḥ alpāḥ. Gaṇakūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye ṣaṭ aṅkāḥ) devadevayoḥ melanamuttamam, devamanuṣyayoḥ madhyamam, devarākṣasayostu nikṛṣṭatamaṃ vaimanasyakaram.

MANUSHYA.phalaProse: Manuṣyagaṇe nava nakṣatrāṇi (bharaṇī, rohiṇī, ārdrā, pūrvāphālgunī, uttarāphālgunī, pūrvāṣāḍhā, uttarāṣāḍhā, pūrvābhādrapadā, uttarābhādrapadā ca) antarbhavanti. Manuṣyagaṇajātaḥ rājasasvabhāvaḥ, laukikādhyātmikayoḥ samanvayakārī, mahattvākāṅkṣī kintu naitikaḥ, vyāvahārikaḥ sāmājikaśca bhavati. Sukhaduḥkhe samatāṃ dhārayan puruṣārthacatuṣṭaye pravṛttaḥ. Gaṇakūṭe manuṣyamanuṣyayoḥ melanamuttamam, devamanuṣyayoḥ śubham, manuṣyarākṣasayostu alpaphalam.

RAKSHASA.phalaProse: Rākṣasagaṇe nava nakṣatrāṇi (kṛttikā, āśleṣā, maghā, citrā, viśākhā, jyeṣṭhā, mūlā, dhaniṣṭhā, śatabhiṣā ca) antarbhavanti. Rākṣasagaṇajātaḥ tāmasasvabhāvaḥ, dṛḍhasaṅkalpaḥ, spaṣṭavaktā, svatantraḥ prabhāvī ca. Kadācit ugraḥ haṭhī ca, kintu nirbhīkaḥ sāhasī anyāyapratirodhī ca. Gaṇakūṭe rākṣasarākṣasayoḥ melanaṃ sahyam, devarākṣasayostu nikṛṣṭatamaṃ vaimanasyakaram; manuṣyarākṣasayoḥ madhyamam.

JUPITER_IN_1.name: Gururlagne rājayogakārakaḥ. Prajñāvān, dhārmikaḥ, dīrghāyuḥ, saumya-ākṛtiḥ.
JUPITER_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururlagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ prajñāvantaṃ, dhārmikaṃ, dīrghāyuṣaṃ, saumya-ākṛtiṃ, guru-śiṣya-vatsalaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 adhyāye etatsthānaṃ śreṣṭha-rājayogakārakaṃ uktam — guruḥ kāraka-sthāne ātma-śuddhiṃ, vidyā-vardhanaṃ, guru-kṛpāṃ ca prāpayati.
JUPITER_IN_1.general: Rājayogaḥ, prajñā, dharmaniṣṭhā, dīrghāyuḥ, saumya-vyaktitvam, guru-kṛpā, sat-śāstrajñānam.

JUPITER_IN_10.name: Gururdaśame karma-dharma-rājayogaḥ. Ucca-pada-yaśasvī, dharma-vyavasāyī.
JUPITER_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururdaśamasthaḥ karma-kāraka-kendra-rājayogakārakaḥ — ucca-pada-yaśaṃ, dharma-vyavasāyaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, sat-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — kāraka-kendra-yogaḥ uccakarma-pradaḥ.

JUPITER_IN_11.name: Gururekādaśe lābha-dharmayogaḥ. Nirantara-dhana-vṛddhiḥ, dhārmika-mitra-kuṭumba-vardhanam.
JUPITER_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururekādaśasthaḥ lābha-dharma-yogakārakaḥ — nirantara-dhana-vṛddhiṃ, dhārmika-mitra-kuṭumba-vardhanaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — gururlābhasthāne sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

JUPITER_IN_12.name: Gururdvādaśe mokṣa-yogaḥ, dāna-śīlaḥ, tīrtha-vāsī, kintu vyaya-bāhulyam.
JUPITER_IN_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururdvādaśasthaḥ mokṣa-yogakārakaḥ — dāna-dharma-śīlaṃ, tīrtha-āśrama-vāsaṃ, ādhyātmika-vyayaṃ, videśa-dharma-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ vyaya-sthāne mokṣa-kārakaḥ, śubha-vyaye dharma-dāna-pravṛttiṃ, ante sad-gatiṃ ca dadāti. Vyaya-bāhulyaṃ tu dharma-kārye.

JUPITER_IN_2.name: Gururdvitīye dhana-vāk-yogaḥ. Samṛddhaḥ, madhura-satya-vāṇī, kuṭumba-poṣakaḥ.
JUPITER_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururdvitīyasthaḥ dhana-vāk-yogakārakaḥ — dhana-samṛddhiṃ, madhura-satya-vāṇīṃ, kuṭumba-poṣaṇaṃ, ucca-śikṣāṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ dhana-sthāne sarva-sampat-vardhakaḥ, vidyā-dhana-saṃyogaḥ. Vāṇyāṃ dharma-satya-prakaṭanam.

JUPITER_IN_3.name: Gurustṛtīye dhārmika-parākramaḥ, bhrātṛ-sukhī, kintu alpa-sva-parākrama-kāraka-hāniḥ.
JUPITER_IN_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gurustṛtīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ dhārmika-parākramiṇaṃ, bhrātṛ-sukhinaṃ, upadeśa-dāna-śīlaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ upacaya-tṛtīye sva-kārakatve īṣat-kṣīṇaḥ (guruḥ manda-sthāne na prakarṣeṇa phalati), tathāpi dharma-sañcāra-vṛttiṃ, sat-parāmarśa-kauśalaṃ, anuja-sukhaṃ ca dadāti. Upacaya-tvāt phalaṃ krameṇa vardhate.

JUPITER_IN_4.name: Guruścaturthe mātṛ-gṛha-vāhana-yogaḥ. Hṛdaya-sukhaṃ, dhārmika-gṛhasthaḥ.
JUPITER_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye guruścaturthasthaḥ jātakaṃ mātṛ-sukha-samṛddhaṃ, gṛha-vāhana-sampannaṃ, dhārmika-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ, hṛdaya-śāntiṃ ca prāpayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ sukhasthāne kendra-kāraka-yogakārakaḥ.

JUPITER_IN_5.name: Guruḥ pañcame putra-prajñā-yogaḥ. Santati-sukhī, mantra-siddhaḥ, vidvān.
JUPITER_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye guruḥ pañcamasthaḥ jātakaṃ putra-prajñā-saṃyoga-rājayogakārakaṃ — santati-sukhaṃ, mantra-siddhiṃ, vidyā-kauśalaṃ, rāja-kīrti-vardhanaṃ ca prāpayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ kāraka-kāraka-sthāne sarvottama rājayogaḥ.

JUPITER_IN_6.name: Guruḥ ṣaṣṭhe śatru-śamanam, dharmeṇa-vivāda-vijayaḥ, kintu kāraka-sthāna-hāniḥ.
JUPITER_IN_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye guruḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ jātakaṃ dharmeṇa-śatru-śamanaṃ, vivāda-vijayaṃ, ṛṇa-nivāraṇaṃ ca karoti, paraṃ guroḥ kāraka-sthāna-hāniṃ (śubha-kārakaḥ duḥsthāne pīḍitaḥ) sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ ripu-sthāne nyāya-dharma-balena śatru-nivārakaḥ, cikitsā-nyāya-sevā-kṣetre pratiṣṭhā-kārakaḥ, paraṃ sva-śubha-phale īṣat-nyūnatā. Upacaya-tvāt krameṇa vijayaḥ.

JUPITER_IN_7.name: Guruḥ saptame dhārmika-kalatrayogaḥ. Dāmpatya-sukhī, sad-vyāpārī.
JUPITER_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye guruḥ saptamasthaḥ jātakaṃ dhārmika-kalatra-yogayuktaṃ, dāmpatya-sukhinaṃ, sad-vyāpāriṇaṃ, videśa-yātra-lābhaṃ ca prāpayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ kalatra-sthāne jāyāṃ śāstrajñāṃ, sāttvika-vyavahāraṃ dadāti. Tathāpi avivāhita-yogaḥ kvacit jāyate yadā gururbrahmacarya-pūjana-vṛttiṃ prerayati.
JUPITER_IN_7.general: Dhārmika-dāmpatyam, śāstrajña-jāyā, sad-vyāpāraḥ, videśa-yātrā-lābhaḥ, kalatra-kāraṇena khyātiḥ.

JUPITER_IN_8.name: Gururaṣṭame dīrghāyuḥ, gūḍha-śāstra-jñaḥ, dāna-prāptiḥ, kintu śubha-kāraka-hāniḥ.
JUPITER_IN_8.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururaṣṭamasthaḥ jātakaṃ dīrghāyuṣaṃ, gūḍha-śāstra-darśana-jñaṃ, akasmāt-dhana-dāya-prāptaṃ ca karoti, paraṃ śubha-kārakatva-hāniṃ (guruḥ randhra-duḥsthāne) sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — guruḥ āyur-sthāne āyuṣ-vardhakaḥ, mokṣa-śāstra-pravṛttaḥ, dāya-vasīyata-lābhakārakaḥ; tathāpi gṛha-sukha-bhāgya-phale īṣat-nyūnatā. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā āyuṣ-dāna-yogaḥ.

JUPITER_IN_9.name: Gururnavame dharma-rājayogaḥ. Atyanta-bhāgyavān, guru-kṛpā-pātraḥ, śāstrajñaḥ.
JUPITER_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye gururnavamasthaḥ sarvocca-dharma-rājayogakārakaḥ — kāraka-kāraka-trikoṇayogaḥ. Jātakaḥ atyanta-bhāgyavān, guru-kṛpā-pātraḥ, sarva-śāstra-jñaḥ, dharmātmā ca bhavati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — etatsthānaṃ jyotiṣa-śāstre ati-ślāghitam.

KETU_IN_1.name: Keturlagne ātma-saṃśayaḥ, vairāgya-pravṛttiḥ, gūḍha-antardṛṣṭiḥ, śiro-carma-cintā.
KETU_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre keturlagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ ātma-saṃśaya-yuktaṃ, antarmukha-vairāgya-pravṛttaṃ, gūḍha-antardṛṣṭi-sampannaṃ, kintu ātma-paricaya-bhrama-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Ketuḥ tanu-sthāne mokṣa-kārakatvena sāṃsārika-anāsaktiṃ, śiro-carma-doṣa-sambhāvanāṃ, rahasya-vidyā-ākarṣaṇaṃ ca janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā ādhyātmika-antardṛṣṭi-yogaḥ; pīḍite ātma-viśvāsa-nyūnatā.

KETU_IN_10.name: Keturdaśame apāramparika-karma, karma-vairāgyam, gūḍha-śodha-vyavasāyaḥ, kīrti-cāñcalyam.
KETU_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre keturdaśamasthaḥ jātakaṃ apāramparika-karma-kṣetra-pravṛttaṃ, karma-phale anāsaktaṃ, gūḍha-śodha-tantra-jyotiṣa-cikitsā-vyavasāya-kuśalaṃ, kintu kīrti-sthiratāyāṃ cāñcalya-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Ketuḥ karma-sthāne pūrva-karma-dakṣatāṃ, akasmāt-karma-parivartanaṃ, yaśa-nirapekṣatāṃ ca janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā gūḍha-vidyā-karma-kīrti-yogaḥ; pīḍite karma-asthairya-māna-cāñcalye.

KETU_IN_11.name: Keturekādaśe akasmāt-lābhaḥ, apāramparika-mitraḥ, icchā-vairāgyam, gūḍha-neṭavarka.
KETU_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre keturekādaśasthaḥ śubha-sthāna-gataḥ — akasmāt-lābhaṃ, apāramparika-gūḍha-mitra-maṇḍalaṃ, icchā-pūrtau anāsaktiṃ ca karoti. Ketuḥ lābha-sthāne upacaya-tvena prabalaḥ — ādhyātmika-gūḍha-samudāya-sambandhaṃ, anapekṣita-dhana-lābhaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-sambandha-śaityaṃ vā dadāti. Etat ketoḥ śubha-sthānam. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā akasmāt-lābha-yogaḥ; pīḍite lābha-cāñcalya-mitra-viraktī.

KETU_IN_12.name: Keturdvādaśe mokṣa-yogaḥ. Mokṣa-yogyatā, sūkṣma-dṛṣṭiḥ, videśa-vāsaḥ, sāttvika-tyāgaḥ.
KETU_IN_12.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 29 adhyāye keturdvādaśasthaḥ sarvotkṛṣṭa-mokṣa-yogakārakaḥ — mokṣa-yogyatāṃ, sūkṣma-dṛṣṭiṃ, videśa-vāsaṃ, sāttvika-tyāgaṃ, gupta-dāna-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — ketoḥ vyaya-sthānaṃ mokṣa-kāraka-kāraka-saṃyogaḥ.
KETU_IN_12.general: Sarvotkṛṣṭa-mokṣa-yogaḥ, mokṣa-yogyatā, sūkṣma-dṛṣṭiḥ, videśa-vāsaḥ, sāttvika-tyāgaḥ, gupta-dāna-kīrtiḥ.

KETU_IN_2.name: Keturdvitīye anāsakta-vāṇī, dhana-aniścayaḥ, mantra-vāk-siddhiḥ, kuṭumba-viraktiḥ.
KETU_IN_2.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre keturdvitīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ alpa-vā-gūḍha-vāṇīyuktaṃ, dhana-viṣaye anāsakta-aniścayaṃ, kintu mantra-vāk-siddhi-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Ketuḥ dhana-sthāne dhana-saṅgrahe viraktiṃ, kuṭumba-sambandha-śaityaṃ, anna-mukha-doṣa-sambhāvanāṃ ca janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā mantra-tantra-vāk-siddhi-yogaḥ; pīḍite dhana-cāñcalya-vāk-doṣau.

KETU_IN_3.name: Ketustṛtīye nirbhīka-parākramaḥ, gūḍha-sañcāra-kauśalam, bhrātṛ-viraktiḥ.
KETU_IN_3.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ketustṛtīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ nirbhīka-parākramiṇaṃ, gūḍha-sañcāra-lekhana-kuśalaṃ, antarjñāna-sampannaṃ, kintu bhrātṛ-sambandha-śaitya-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Ketuḥ upacaya-tṛtīye sāhasa-vṛddhiṃ, sūkṣma-tarka-śaktiṃ, gupta-vidyā-pravṛttiṃ dadāti — upacaya-tvāt śubha-sthānam. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā anveṣaṇa-parākrama-yogaḥ; pīḍite bhrātṛ-kalaha-cāñcalye.

KETU_IN_4.name: Ketuścaturthe gṛha-anāsaktiḥ, mātṛ-viyoga-cintā, antarmukha-śānti-anveṣaṇam.
KETU_IN_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ketuścaturthasthaḥ jātakasya gṛha-sukha-anāsaktiṃ, mātṛ-sambandha-śaityaṃ vā viyoga-cintāṃ, antarmukha-śānti-anveṣaṇaṃ ca sūcayati. Ketuḥ sukha-sthāne sāṃsārika-gṛha-sukhe viraktiṃ, sthāna-calanaṃ, hṛdaya-asantoṣaṃ vā janayati, paraṃ ādhyātmika-śānti-tṛṣṇāṃ, gūḍha-vidyā-gṛha-sādhanāṃ ca. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā antaḥśānti-mokṣa-yogaḥ; pīḍite gṛha-aśānti-mātṛ-kaṣṭau.

KETU_IN_5.name: Ketuḥ pañcame mantra-siddhiḥ, gūḍha-prajñā, santati-cintā, pūrva-janma-saṃskāra-smṛtiḥ.
KETU_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ketuḥ pañcamasthaḥ jātakaṃ mantra-tantra-siddhi-pravaṇaṃ, gūḍha-prajñā-antarjñāna-sampannaṃ, pūrva-janma-saṃskāra-prabhāvitaṃ, kintu santati-viṣaye cintā-vilamba-yuktaṃ ca karoti. Ketuḥ putra-sthāne pūrva-puṇya-mokṣa-kārakatvena ādhyātmika-buddhiṃ dadāti, paraṃ santāna-kāraka-kṣobhaṃ (garbha-skhalana-vā-vilamba-sambhāvanāṃ) janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā mantra-siddhi-prajñā-yogaḥ; pīḍite santati-kaṣṭam.

KETU_IN_6.name: Ketuḥ ṣaṣṭhe śatru-nāśakaḥ, roga-nidāna-kuśalaḥ, ṛṇa-vijayī, gūḍha-cikitsā-śaktiḥ.
KETU_IN_6.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ketuḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ śubha-sthāna-gataḥ — śatru-nāśakaṃ, roga-nidāna-gūḍha-cikitsā-kuśalaṃ, ṛṇa-śatru-vijayinaṃ ca karoti. Ketuḥ ripu-sthāne upacaya-tvena prabalaḥ — sūkṣma-roga-nidānaṃ, tantra-mantra-cikitsāṃ, spardhā-vijayaṃ dadāti. Etat ketoḥ śreṣṭha-sthānam. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā vaidya-tāntrika-śodha-yogaḥ; pīḍite udara-gupta-roga-śaṅkā.

KETU_IN_7.name: Ketuḥ saptame dāmpatya-anāsaktiḥ, sambandha-vairāgyam, sāthī-gūḍha-svabhāvaḥ, vyāpāra-udāsīnatā.
KETU_IN_7.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre ketuḥ saptamasthaḥ jātakasya dāmpatye anāsaktiṃ, sambandha-vairāgyaṃ, sāthinaḥ gūḍha-antarmukha-svabhāvaṃ, vivāha-vilambaṃ vā sūcayati. Ketuḥ kalatra-sthāne sāṃsārika-dāmpatya-sukhe viraktiṃ, sājhedārī-viṣaye udāsīnatāṃ, gupta-sambandha-pravṛttiṃ vā janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā ādhyātmika-sahacara-yogaḥ; pīḍite dāmpatya-śaitya-vicheda-śaṅkā.

KETU_IN_8.name: Keturaṣṭame gūḍha-tantra-siddhiḥ, mokṣa-pravṛttiḥ, akasmāt-ghaṭanā, āyur-gūḍha-cintā.
KETU_IN_8.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre keturaṣṭamasthaḥ jātakaṃ gūḍha-tantra-yoga-siddhi-pravaṇaṃ, mokṣa-anveṣakaṃ, antarjñāna-dṛṣṭi-sampannaṃ, kintu akasmāt-ghaṭanā-āyur-gūḍha-cintā-yuktaṃ ca karoti. Ketuḥ randhra-sthāne mokṣa-kārakatvena kuṇḍalinī-yoga-gūḍha-vidyā-siddhiṃ dadāti (etat ketoḥ ati-śubha-sthānam iti kecit), paraṃ ākasmika-parivartana-bhaya-pravṛttiṃ ca. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā yoga-siddhi-mokṣa-yogaḥ; pīḍite durghaṭanā-gupta-roga-śaṅkā.

KETU_IN_9.name: Keturnavame mokṣa-dharma-yogaḥ. Ādhyātmikaḥ, guru-kṛpā-pātraḥ, antardṛṣṭimān.
KETU_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 29 adhyāye keturnavamasthaḥ mokṣa-dharma-yogakārakaḥ — ādhyātmika-vṛttiṃ, guru-kṛpā-yogaṃ, antardṛṣṭiṃ, sūkṣma-śāstra-jñānaṃ, pūrva-janma-smṛtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — ketorbhāgya-sthānaṃ ati-śubham.

MARS_IN_1.name: Maṅgalo lagne tejasvī, sāhasī, ugra-svabhāvaḥ, kṣata-cihnaḥ. (Māṅgalika-yogaḥ)
MARS_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalo lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ tejasvinaṃ, sāhasinaṃ, ugra-svabhāvaṃ, netṛtva-śīlaṃ, kintu krodha-pravaṇaṃ, kṣata-cihna-yuktaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — kujaḥ tanu-sthāne bala-vardhakaḥ, paraṃ kuja-doṣa-kārakaḥ (māṅgalika) — dāmpatya-sāmañjasye yatna-sādhyatā. Ucca-sva-rāśi-kuje sāhasaṃ netṛtve pariṇamate.
MARS_IN_1.general: Tejasvitā, sāhasam, netṛtvam, ugra-svabhāvaḥ, krodha-pravṛttiḥ, māṅgalika-yogaḥ.

MARS_IN_10.name: Maṅgalo daśame rucaka-samāna-rājayogaḥ. Ati-karmaṭhaḥ, senā-nāyakatvam, rāja-sammānam.
MARS_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalo daśamasthaḥ karma-viśeṣa-rājayogakārakaḥ — kujaḥ karma-sthānātmakena ucca-sthānena vā senā-nāyakatvaṃ, ati-karmaṭhatāṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, sāhasika-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — digbalī kujaḥ karma-yaśaṃ vardhayati.

MARS_IN_11.name: Maṅgala ekādaśe lābha-śaurya-yogaḥ. Sāhasena-nirantara-lābhaḥ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-vṛddhiḥ.
MARS_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgala ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-śaurya-yogakārakaḥ — sāhasena nirantara-lābhaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-vardhanaṃ, udyamaśīlatayā-iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — kuja ekādaśasthaḥ sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

MARS_IN_12.name: Maṅgalo dvādaśe vyaya-bāhulyam, gupta-śatruḥ, śastra-agni-vyayaḥ, māṅgalika-yogaḥ.
MARS_IN_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalo dvādaśasthaḥ jātakasya vyaya-bāhulyaṃ, gupta-śatru-pīḍāṃ, śayyā-sukha-nyūnatāṃ, śastra-agni-kāraṇena vyayaṃ ca sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — kujaḥ vyaya-sthāne ūrjā-vyayaṃ, krodha-janya-hāniṃ, kuja-doṣaṃ (māṅgalika) ca janayati. Tathāpi videśa-parākrameṇa lābhaḥ, gupta-kārya-senā-śalya-kṣetre prāvīṇyaṃ ca. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā vyaya-niyantraṇam.

MARS_IN_2.name: Maṅgalo dvitīye kaṭhora-vāṇī, kuṭumba-kalahaḥ, sāhasena-dhanam, māṅgalika-yogaḥ.
MARS_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalo dvitīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ kaṭhora-vāṇīyuktaṃ, kuṭumba-kalaha-pravaṇaṃ, sāhasena-arjita-dhanaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — kujaḥ dhana-sthāne vāṇī-tīkṣṇatāṃ, anna-viṣaye uṣṇatāṃ, kuja-doṣaṃ (māṅgalika) ca janayati. Bhūmi-dhātu-yantra-vyāpāreṇa artha-lābhastu bhavati.

MARS_IN_3.name: Maṅgalastṛtīye parākrama-yogaḥ. Mahā-śūraḥ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaḥ, sva-bala-samṛddhaḥ.
MARS_IN_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalastṛtīyasthaḥ parākrama-yogakārakaḥ — kāraka-kāraka-saṃyogaḥ. Mahā-śauryaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaḥ, sva-bala-samṛddhiṃ, udyamaśīlatāṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — maṅgalasya upacaya-sthāneṣu eva śreṣṭha-phalaṃ uktam.

MARS_IN_4.name: Maṅgalaścaturthe gṛha-aśāntiḥ, mātṛ-kaṣṭam, bhūmi-vāhana-saṅgharṣaḥ, māṅgalika-yogaḥ.
MARS_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalaścaturthasthaḥ jātakasya gṛha-aśāntiṃ, mātṛ-sukha-hāniṃ, bhūmi-vāhana-viṣaye saṅgharṣaṃ, hṛdaya-tāpaṃ ca sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — kujaḥ sukha-sthāne kāraka-virodhaṃ (kujaḥ sukha-kāraka-candra-viruddhaḥ) janayati, yena gṛha-śānti-kṣayaḥ, sthāna-calanaṃ ca bhavati. Kuja-doṣo'pi (māṅgalika). Bhūmi-dhātu-vyavasāyena tu lābhaḥ.

MARS_IN_5.name: Maṅgalaḥ pañcame tīkṣṇa-buddhiḥ, santati-viṣaye yatnaḥ, sāhasī, spardhā-vijayī.
MARS_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalaḥ pañcamasthaḥ jātakaṃ tīkṣṇa-buddhiṃ, sāhasinaṃ, spardhā-vijayinaṃ, kintu santati-viṣaye kaṣṭa-vā-vilamba-yuktaṃ karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — kujaḥ putra-sthāne manasaḥ uṣṇatāṃ, gaṇita-yantra-kauśalaṃ, saṭṭā-sāhasaṃ dadāti, paraṃ santāna-kārakatve kṣobhaṃ — ataḥ santati-rakṣāyāṃ yatnaḥ. Ucca-kuje buddhi-tejaḥ netṛtve phalati.

MARS_IN_6.name: Maṅgalaḥ ṣaṣṭhe śatru-jaya-yogaḥ. Roga-nivṛttiḥ, ṛṇa-kṣayaḥ, balavān.
MARS_IN_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalaḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ śatru-jaya-viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — ṣaṣṭha-sthānātmakena kujena śatravo jitā bhavanti, rogā nivṛttāḥ, ṛṇāni ca kṣīyante. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — upacaya-kujaḥ ari-sthāne ati-balapradaḥ.

MARS_IN_7.name: Maṅgalaḥ saptame dāmpatya-kalahaḥ, kuja-doṣaḥ (māṅgalika), sāthī-tejasvī, vyāpāra-sāhasam.
MARS_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalaḥ saptamasthaḥ prabala-kuja-doṣa-kārakaḥ (māṅgalika) — dāmpatye kalahaṃ, mata-bhedaṃ, vivāha-vilambaṃ vā sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — kujaḥ kalatra-sthāne sāthinaḥ tejasvitāṃ, svātantrya-priyatāṃ, vyāpāre sāhasaṃ dadāti, paraṃ sāmañjasye yatna-sādhyatā. Ubhayoḥ kuṇḍalyoḥ kuja-sāmye doṣa-śamanam; ucca-sva-rāśi-kuje vā kalatra-kāraka-dṛṣṭyā nyūnatā.

MARS_IN_8.name: Maṅgalo'ṣṭame alpāyu-śaṅkā, śastra-agni-bhayam, rakta-vikāraḥ, māṅgalika-yogaḥ.
MARS_IN_8.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalo'ṣṭamasthaḥ jātakasya āyur-viṣaye śaṅkāṃ, śastra-agni-durghaṭanā-bhayaṃ, rakta-pitta-vikāraṃ, krodha-pravṛttiṃ ca sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — kujaḥ randhra-sthāne māraka-sūcakaḥ, śalya-kriyā-sambhāvanāṃ, gūḍha-śodha-śaktiṃ ca dadāti. Kuja-doṣo'pi (māṅgalika). Tathāpi ucca-kuje śalya-cikitsā-śodha-kṣetre prāvīṇyam; śubha-dṛṣṭyā mārakatva-śamanam.

MARS_IN_9.name: Maṅgalo navame sāhasa-dharmaḥ, pitṛ-mata-bhedaḥ, udyamī-bhāgyam, senā-nīti-kauśalam.
MARS_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye maṅgalo navamasthaḥ jātakaṃ udyama-śīla-bhāgyavantaṃ, dharma-rakṣakaṃ, senā-nīti-kuśalaṃ, kintu pitṛ-mata-bheda-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — kujaḥ bhāgya-trikoṇe parākrameṇa bhāgyodayaṃ, dharma-yuddha-vṛttiṃ, guru-viṣaye ugra-mataṃ ca dadāti. Ucca-kuje dharma-senā-netṛtvam; pīḍite pitṛ-sukha-hāniḥ.

MERCURY_IN_1.name: Budho lagne vākpaṭuḥ, buddhimān, hāsya-priyaḥ, yuvaka-tejaḥ.
MERCURY_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budho lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ vākpaṭuṃ, buddhimantaṃ, hāsya-priyaṃ, yuvaka-samāna-tejasaṃ, gaṇita-śāstra-kauśalinaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ kāraka-tanu-saṃyogāt buddhimattāṃ, sañcāra-kauśalaṃ ca dadāti.

MERCURY_IN_10.name: Budho daśame karma-vāk-yogaḥ. Buddhi-sañcāra-kauśalena-yaśam, ucca-pada-prāptiḥ.
MERCURY_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budho daśamasthaḥ karma-vāk-rājayogakārakaḥ — kāraka-kendra-yogaḥ. Buddhi-sañcāra-kauśalena yaśaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, ucca-pada-prāptiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — karma-kārakeṇa karma-sthānātmanā saṃyogaḥ.

MERCURY_IN_11.name: Budha ekādaśe lābha-vāk-yogaḥ. Nirantara-vyāpāra-lābhaḥ, mitra-sañcāra-kuśalaḥ.
MERCURY_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budha ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-vāk-yogakārakaḥ — nirantara-vyāpāra-lābhaṃ, mitra-sañcāra-kauśalaṃ, saṭṭā-śeyara-vardhanaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budho lābhasthāne sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

MERCURY_IN_12.name: Budho dvādaśe vyaya-gaṇanā, gupta-lekhanam, mauna-priyaḥ, videśa-sañcāraḥ.
MERCURY_IN_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budho dvādaśasthaḥ jātakaṃ vyaya-śīlaṃ, gupta-lekhana-kuśalaṃ, mauna-priyaṃ, alpa-sambhāṣaṇaṃ, kintu kalpanā-śīlaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ vyaya-sthāne sañcāra-kārakatva-nyūnatāṃ, videśa-vyāpāra-sañcāraṃ, gupta-śodha-lekhanaṃ dadāti. Pīḍite vāk-saṅkocaḥ, śubha-dṛṣṭyā videśa-lekhana-kīrtiḥ.

MERCURY_IN_2.name: Budho dvitīye vāk-dhana-yogaḥ. Madhura-vacanaḥ, sva-kuṭumba-poṣakaḥ, vyāpāra-kuśalaḥ.
MERCURY_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budho dvitīyasthaḥ vāk-dhana-yogakārakaḥ — madhura-vacanaṃ, kuṭumba-poṣaṇaṃ, vyāpāra-kauśalena-dhanārjanaṃ, manojña-vyavahāraṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — vāk-kārakaḥ dhanasthāne arthārjana-vāṇīṃ dadāti.

MERCURY_IN_3.name: Budhastṛtīye lekhana-sañcāra-kauśalam, bhrātṛ-sukhī, buddhi-parākramaḥ.
MERCURY_IN_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budhastṛtīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ lekhana-sañcāra-kuśalaṃ, bhrātṛ-sukhinaṃ, buddhi-parākramiṇaṃ, bahu-kalā-nipuṇaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ upacaya-tṛtīye sañcāra-kārakatva-vṛddhiṃ, lekhana-sampādana-vāṇijya-kauśalaṃ, mitra-bāhulyaṃ ca dadāti. Upacaya-tvāt phalaṃ kāla-krameṇa vardhate.

MERCURY_IN_4.name: Budhaścaturthe vidyā-gṛha-yogaḥ. Mātṛ-sukhī, vidvān-gṛhasthaḥ.
MERCURY_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budhaścaturthasthaḥ vidyā-gṛha-yogakārakaḥ — mātṛ-sukhī, vidvān-gṛhasthaḥ, gṛha-vāhana-sampannaḥ, sad-vyavahārī ca bhavati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ sukha-sthāne vidyā-vardhanaṃ dadāti.

MERCURY_IN_5.name: Budhaḥ pañcame prajñā-yogaḥ. Buddhimān, mantra-siddhaḥ, saṭṭā-śeyara-kuśalaḥ.
MERCURY_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budhaḥ pañcamasthaḥ prajñā-rājayogakārakaḥ — kāraka-trikoṇa-yogaḥ. Buddhimattā, mantra-siddhiḥ, saṭṭā-śeyara-kauśalaṃ, gaṇita-śāstra-kīrtiḥ, santati-sukhaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — vidyā-kārakaḥ pūrva-puṇye phalitaḥ.

MERCURY_IN_6.name: Budhaḥ ṣaṣṭhe tarka-vijayī, cikitsā-gaṇita-kuśalaḥ, kintu snāyu-cintā.
MERCURY_IN_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budhaḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ jātakaṃ tarka-vivāda-vijayinaṃ, cikitsā-gaṇita-kuśalaṃ, sevā-kṣetra-nipuṇaṃ, kintu snāyu-carma-cintā-yuktaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ upacaya-ṣaṣṭhe śatru-tarka-vijayaṃ, viśleṣaṇa-kauśalaṃ, lekhā-gaṇita-prāvīṇyaṃ dadāti, paraṃ adhika-cintanena snāyu-daurbalyaṃ vā. Upacaya-tvāt krameṇa vijayaḥ.

MERCURY_IN_7.name: Budhaḥ saptame vyāpāra-kalatrayogaḥ. Buddhimatī-jāyā, sad-vyavasāyī.
MERCURY_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budhaḥ saptamasthaḥ vyāpāra-kalatrayoga-kārakaḥ — buddhimatī-jāyāṃ, sad-vyavasāya-kauśalaṃ, sājhedārī-vyāpāreṇa-vardhanaṃ, yātrā-lābhaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ kalatra-sthāne vyāpāra-vāṇīṃ vardhayati.

MERCURY_IN_8.name: Budho'ṣṭame gūḍha-vidyā-kuśalaḥ, anusandhāna-śīlaḥ, snāyu-vāk-cintā.
MERCURY_IN_8.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budho'ṣṭamasthaḥ jātakaṃ gūḍha-vidyā-anusandhāna-kuśalaṃ, jyotiṣa-tantra-gaṇita-śodha-pravṛttaṃ, kintu snāyu-daurbalya-vāk-cintā-yuktaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ randhra-sthāne manasaḥ gahana-śodha-śaktiṃ, gupta-jñānaṃ dadāti, paraṃ cintā-bāhulyaṃ, sambhāṣaṇe saṅkocaṃ vā. Dīrghāyur-yogastu bahudhā. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā śodha-vaijñānika-yogaḥ.

MERCURY_IN_9.name: Budho navame śāstra-jñaḥ, dharma-darśana-kuśalaḥ, bhāgya-vān, upadeśakaḥ.
MERCURY_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye budho navamasthaḥ jātakaṃ śāstra-jñaṃ, dharma-darśana-kuśalaṃ, bhāgya-vantaṃ, sad-upadeśakaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 23 — budhaḥ bhāgya-trikoṇe buddhi-dharma-saṃyogaṃ, tarka-sahita-dharma-jñānaṃ, lekhana-pravacana-kauśalaṃ, yātrā-lābhaṃ ca dadāti. Guru-budha-sambandhe vidvattā prakarṣeṇa.

MOON_IN_1.name: Candro lagne manasvī, saumya-kāntiḥ, mātṛ-vatsalaḥ, bhoga-samṛddhaḥ.
MOON_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ manasvinaṃ, saumya-kāntiṃ, mātṛ-vatsalaṃ, bhoga-samṛddhaṃ, samvedanaśīlaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candra-lagnāt bhāva-kāraka-yogāḥ bahavaḥ utpadyante.

MOON_IN_10.name: Candro daśame karma-kāraka-rājayogaḥ. Jana-priya-karma, manorañjaka-vyavasāyaḥ.
MOON_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro daśamasthaḥ karma-kāraka-rājayogakārakaḥ — jana-priya-karma, manorañjaka-vyavasāyaṃ, mātṛ-karma-saṃyogaṃ, ati-karmaṭhatāṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ karma-sthāne jana-samūha-kīrtiṃ vardhayati.

MOON_IN_11.name: Candra ekādaśe lābha-mano-yogaḥ. Nirantara-dhana-lābhaḥ, mitra-mano-kīrtiḥ.
MOON_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candra ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-mano-yogakārakaḥ — nirantara-dhana-lābhaṃ, mitra-kuṭumbena-mano-vardhanaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candro lābhasthāne sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

MOON_IN_12.name: Candro dvādaśe vyaya-śīlaḥ, mano-ekānta-priyaḥ, nidrā-svapna-bahulaḥ, mokṣa-pravṛttiḥ.
MOON_IN_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro dvādaśasthaḥ jātakaṃ vyaya-śīlaṃ, ekānta-priyaṃ, nidrā-svapna-bahulaṃ, paradeśa-vāsa-pravṛttaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ vyaya-sthāne manasaḥ antarmukhatāṃ, kalpanā-śīlatāṃ, vyaya-bāhulyaṃ dadāti, paraṃ mokṣa-sādhanāyāṃ, śayyā-sukhe, gūḍha-kalpanāyāṃ ca pravṛttim — kavi-kalākāra-yogakārakaḥ. Kṣīṇa-candre mānasika-cintā vardhate.

MOON_IN_2.name: Candro dvitīye madhura-vāṇī, dhana-sañcayaḥ, kuṭumba-vatsalaḥ, anna-priyaḥ.
MOON_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro dvitīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ madhura-vāṇīyuktaṃ, dhana-sañcaya-śīlaṃ, kuṭumba-vatsalaṃ, anna-rasa-priyaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ dhana-sthāne pūrṇa-bale dhana-samṛddhiṃ, kṣīṇa-bale dhana-cāñcalyaṃ dadāti. Mano-madhuratā vāṇyāṃ prakaṭate.

MOON_IN_3.name: Candrastṛtīye bhrātṛ-sukhī, sāhasī, yātrā-priyaḥ, cañcala-manāḥ.
MOON_IN_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candrastṛtīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ bhrātṛ-sukhinaṃ (viśeṣataḥ bhaginī-sukhinaṃ), sāhasinaṃ, yātrā-priyaṃ, cañcala-manasaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ upacaya-tṛtīye parākrama-vardhakaḥ, kalā-sañcāra-kuśalaḥ, mitra-bahulaśca. Manasaḥ utsāhaḥ udyame prakaṭate.

MOON_IN_4.name: Candraścaturthe digbalī mātṛ-gṛha-rājayogaḥ. Ati-mātṛ-sukhī, hṛdaya-śāntiḥ.
MOON_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candraścaturthasthaḥ digbalī mātṛ-gṛha-rājayogakārakaḥ — mātṛ-sukhaṃ, gṛha-śāntiṃ, hṛdaya-prasannatāṃ, dhārmika-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candrasya caturthaṃ digbala-sthānaṃ sarvottamam.
MOON_IN_4.general: Digbalī mātṛ-gṛha-rājayogaḥ, ati-mātṛ-sukham, hṛdaya-śāntiḥ, gṛha-vaibhavam, dhārmika-gṛhasthaḥ.

MOON_IN_5.name: Candraḥ pañcame mano-prajñā-yogaḥ. Buddhimān, santati-sukhī, mantra-kuśalaḥ.
MOON_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candraḥ pañcamasthaḥ mano-prajñā-rājayogakārakaḥ — mano-kārakaḥ pūrva-puṇya-sthāne tiṣṭhan buddhimattāṃ, santati-sukhaṃ, mantra-kauśalaṃ, samvedanaśīla-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — kāraka-trikoṇa-yogaḥ.

MOON_IN_6.name: Candraḥ ṣaṣṭhe mano-vyākulatā, udara-rogaḥ, ṛṇa-śatru-cintā, sevā-vṛttiḥ.
MOON_IN_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candraḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ jātakasya mano-vyākulatāṃ, udara-jala-roga-pravṛttiṃ, ṛṇa-śatru-cintāṃ, sevā-vṛttiṃ ca sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ ripu-sthāne kāraka-hāniṃ (manaḥ ṣaṣṭha-duḥsthāne pīḍitam) janayati, yena mānasika-asthairyaṃ, mātā-svāsthya-cintā ca bhavati. Tathāpi upacaya-tvāt śatru-vijayaḥ, sevā-kṣetre pratiṣṭhā ca labhyate.

MOON_IN_7.name: Candraḥ saptame samvedanaśīla-kalatrayogaḥ. Saumya-jāyā, yātrā-lābhaḥ, sahayogi-svabhāvaḥ.
MOON_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candraḥ saptamasthaḥ samvedanaśīla-kalatrayoga-kārakaḥ — saumya-jāyāṃ, yātrā-lābhaṃ, sahayogi-vyāpāraṃ, mano-vaidyatā-guṇaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ kalatra-sthāne manorañjaka-vyavahāraṃ dadāti.

MOON_IN_8.name: Candro'ṣṭame mano-daurbalyam, mātā-svāsthya-cintā, gūḍha-vidyā-pravṛttiḥ.
MOON_IN_8.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro'ṣṭamasthaḥ jātakasya mano-daurbalyaṃ, avasāda-pravṛttiṃ, mātā-āyur-viṣaye cintāṃ, jala-roga-sambhāvanāṃ ca sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ randhra-sthāne manasaḥ asthairyaṃ, bhaya-śīlatāṃ janayati, paraṃ gūḍha-vidyā-tantra-jyotiṣa-pravṛttiṃ, āyuṣ-anveṣaṇaṃ ca dadāti. Pūrṇa-candraḥ śubha-dṛṣṭyā doṣaṃ śamayati.

MOON_IN_9.name: Candro navame bhāgya-vān, dhārmikaḥ, tīrtha-yātrā-priyaḥ, mātṛ-dharma-niṣṭhaḥ.
MOON_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye candro navamasthaḥ jātakaṃ bhāgya-vantaṃ, dhārmikaṃ, tīrtha-yātrā-priyaṃ, sad-guru-bhaktaṃ, mātṛ-dharma-niṣṭhaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — candraḥ bhāgya-trikoṇe śubhadaḥ — manasaḥ dharma-pravṛttiṃ, jana-priyatāṃ, yātrā-sukhaṃ, sad-bhāvanā ca dadāti. Pūrṇa-candre bhāgyodayaḥ suspaṣṭaḥ.

RAHU_IN_1.name: Rāhurlagne ati-mahattvākāṅkṣā, asāmānya-vyaktitvam, māyā-prabhāvaḥ, bhrama-pravṛttiḥ.
RAHU_IN_1.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre rāhurlagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ ati-mahattvākāṅkṣiṇaṃ, asāmānya-ākarṣaka-vyaktitvaṃ, videśa-vilakṣaṇa-viṣaya-priyaṃ, kintu bhrama-ahaṅkāra-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Rāhuḥ tanu-sthāne ātma-pradarśana-tīvratāṃ, akasmāt-utthāna-patanaṃ, carma-śiro-vikāra-sambhāvanāṃ ca janayati. Śubha-rāśi-dṛṣṭyā jana-prabhāva-yogaḥ; pīḍite bhrama-māna-hāniḥ.

RAHU_IN_10.name: Rāhurdaśame akalpita-karma-rājayogaḥ. Videśa-vyāpāreṇa-yaśam, adhikāraḥ, ucca-pada-prāptiḥ.
RAHU_IN_10.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 28 adhyāye rāhurdaśamasthaḥ akalpita-karma-rājayogakārakaḥ — videśa-vyāpāreṇa yaśaṃ, akalpita-adhikāraṃ, sahasā ucca-pada-prāptiṃ, anūṭha-karma-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — rāhoḥ karma-sthānaṃ ati-śubham.

RAHU_IN_11.name: Rāhurekādaśe akalpita-lābha-yogaḥ. Videśa-srotena-dhanam, akalpita-iṣṭa-siddhiḥ.
RAHU_IN_11.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 28 adhyāye rāhurekādaśasthaḥ akalpita-lābha-yogakārakaḥ — videśa-srotena-dhana-lābhaṃ, akalpita-iṣṭa-siddhiṃ, mitra-kuṭumba-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — rāhoḥ lābhasthānaṃ ati-śubham.

RAHU_IN_12.name: Rāhurdvādaśe videśa-vāsa-yogaḥ, vyaya-bāhulyam, gupta-kāryam, mokṣa-bhrama-dvandvam.
RAHU_IN_12.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre rāhurdvādaśasthaḥ jātakaṃ videśa-vāsa-yoga-yuktaṃ, vyaya-bāhulyaṃ, gupta-kārya-kuśalaṃ, kintu anidrā-bhrama-gupta-śatru-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Rāhuḥ vyaya-sthāne mokṣa-vā-māyā-dvandvaṃ, videśa-kāraṇena-vyaya-lābhaṃ, gupta-śodha-tantra-pravṛttiṃ ca janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā videśa-sthira-vāsa-ādhyātmika-yogaḥ; pīḍite anidrā-bhaya-vyaya-hānī.

RAHU_IN_2.name: Rāhurdvitīye kuṭumba-bāhya-dhanam, aniyamita-vāṇī, videśa-āya, dhana-cāñcalyam.
RAHU_IN_2.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre rāhurdvitīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ apāramparika-srota-dhana-arjinaṃ, videśa-vā-takanīkī-āya-yuktaṃ, kintu aniyamita-vāṇīṃ, kuṭumba-bāhya-sambandha-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Rāhuḥ dhana-sthāne dhana-cāñcalyaṃ, akasmāt-lābha-hāniṃ, anna-mukha-doṣa-sambhāvanāṃ ca janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā asāmānya-vyāpāreṇa mahā-dhanam; pīḍite mithyā-bhāṣaṇa-dhana-kalahau.

RAHU_IN_3.name: Rāhustṛtīye ati-parākrama-yogaḥ. Sāhasena-yaśam, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaḥ, videśa-gamanam.
RAHU_IN_3.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 28 adhyāye rāhustṛtīyasthaḥ ati-parākrama-yogakārakaḥ — asādhāraṇa-sāhasaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaṃ, videśa-gamanaṃ, akalpita-yaśaṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — rāhusyopacaya-sthāne (3/6/10/11) sarvottama-phalam.

RAHU_IN_4.name: Rāhuścaturthe gṛha-aśāntiḥ, mātṛ-viyogaḥ, videśa-gṛha-yogaḥ, mano-vyākulatā.
RAHU_IN_4.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre rāhuścaturthasthaḥ jātakasya gṛha-aśāntiṃ, mātṛ-sukha-hāniṃ vā mātṛ-viyogaṃ, videśa-gṛha-vāsa-yogaṃ, mano-vyākulatāṃ ca sūcayati. Rāhuḥ sukha-sthāne bhūmi-vāhana-viṣaye aniścayaṃ, sthāna-calanaṃ, apāramparika-gṛha-vātāvaraṇaṃ ca janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā videśa-bhūmi-lābha-yogaḥ; pīḍite gṛha-kalaha-mano-aśāntī.

RAHU_IN_5.name: Rāhuḥ pañcame apāramparika-buddhiḥ, santati-cintā, mantra-tantra-pravṛttiḥ, saṭṭā-sāhasam.
RAHU_IN_5.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre rāhuḥ pañcamasthaḥ jātakaṃ apāramparika-tīkṣṇa-buddhiṃ, saṭṭā-śeyara-sāhasinaṃ, mantra-tantra-gūḍha-vidyā-pravṛttaṃ, kintu santati-viṣaye cintā-vilamba-yuktaṃ ca karoti. Rāhuḥ putra-sthāne pūrva-karma-gata-asāmānya-pravṛttiṃ, garbha-sambandha-kaṣṭaṃ vā janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā takanīkī-prajñā-dhana-yogaḥ; pīḍite santati-kaṣṭa-durvyasana-śaṅkā.

RAHU_IN_6.name: Rāhuḥ ṣaṣṭhe śatru-nāśa-yogaḥ. Rājakīya-śatrujayaḥ, ṛṇa-nāśaḥ, śaktimān.
RAHU_IN_6.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 28 adhyāye rāhuḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ śatru-nāśa-viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — rāhurduṣṭa-sthāne tiṣṭhan rāja-śatrujayaṃ, ṛṇa-nāśaṃ, akalpita-śaktiṃ, adhikāra-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Phaladīpikā 8 — rāhoḥ ṣaṣṭha-sthānaṃ sarvottama-śubhadam.

RAHU_IN_7.name: Rāhuḥ saptame apāramparika-dāmpatyam, videśa-sāthī, vyāpāra-cāñcalyam, sambandha-bhramaḥ.
RAHU_IN_7.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre rāhuḥ saptamasthaḥ jātakasya apāramparika-vā-videśa-kalatra-sambandhaṃ, dāmpatye bhrama-aniścayaṃ, vyāpāra-cāñcalyaṃ ca sūcayati. Rāhuḥ kalatra-sthāne bhinna-saṃskṛti-vā-asāmānya-sāthinaṃ, sājhedārī-viṣaye akasmāt-parivartanaṃ janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā videśa-sājhedārī-vyāpāra-yogaḥ; pīḍite dāmpatya-bhrama-vicheda-śaṅkā.

RAHU_IN_8.name: Rāhuraṣṭame gūḍha-tantra-śaktiḥ, akasmāt-ghaṭanā-pravṛttiḥ, gupta-dhana-lābhaḥ, āyur-cintā.
RAHU_IN_8.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre rāhuraṣṭamasthaḥ jātakaṃ gūḍha-tantra-jyotiṣa-śodha-śaktiṃ, akasmāt-ghaṭanā-pravṛttiṃ, gupta-vā-dāya-dhana-lābhaṃ, kintu āyur-svāsthya-cintā-yuktaṃ ca karoti. Rāhuḥ randhra-sthāne ākasmika-utthāna-patanaṃ, rahasya-vidyā-ākarṣaṇaṃ, mānasika-gūḍha-bhayaṃ ca janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā śodha-tantra-dhana-yogaḥ; pīḍite durghaṭanā-gupta-śatru-śaṅkā.

RAHU_IN_9.name: Rāhurnavame apāramparika-dharmaḥ, videśa-bhāgyodayaḥ, guru-mata-bhedaḥ, darśana-jijñāsā.
RAHU_IN_9.prose: Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre rāhurnavamasthaḥ jātakaṃ apāramparika-dharma-darśana-jijñāsuṃ, videśa-kāraṇena-bhāgyodayaṃ, kintu pāramparika-guru-mata-bheda-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Rāhuḥ bhāgya-trikoṇe vilakṣaṇa-vicāra-dhārāṃ, dūra-deśa-yātrā-yogaṃ, pitṛ-vā-guru-viṣaye bhrama-saṃśayaṃ ca janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā videśa-darśana-kīrti-yogaḥ; pīḍite dharma-bhrama-pitṛ-kaṣṭau.

SATURN_IN_1.name: Śanirlagne manda-ārambhaḥ, gambhīraḥ, śramī, vilambita-unnatiḥ, vāta-rogaḥ.
SATURN_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śanirlagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ gambhīraṃ, śrama-śīlaṃ, alpa-bhāṣiṇaṃ, manda-ārambhaṃ, kintu dhairyavantaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — śaniḥ tanu-sthāne bālye kaṣṭaṃ, vilambita-unnatiṃ, vāta-roga-pravṛttiṃ dadāti, paraṃ uttara-āyuṣi sthira-pratiṣṭhāṃ, karmaṭhatāṃ ca. Sva-ucca-rāśi-śanau dhīra-netṛtvaṃ; pīḍite dīrgha-saṅgharṣaḥ.

SATURN_IN_10.name: Śanirdaśame śaśa-samāna-karma-rājayogaḥ. Dīrgha-karma-yaśam, rāja-sammānam, sevā-nāyakatvam.
SATURN_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śanirdaśamasthaḥ karma-viśeṣa-rājayogakārakaḥ — śaniḥ karma-sthānātmakena digbalī dīrgha-karma-yaśaṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, sevā-nāyakatvaṃ, sthira-ucca-padaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 25 — digbalī śaniḥ karma-yaśaṃ vardhayati.

SATURN_IN_11.name: Śaniḥ ekādaśe lābha-sthairya-yogaḥ. Dīrghakālika-dhana-sañcayaḥ, sevā-varga-kīrtiḥ.
SATURN_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śaniḥ ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-sthairya-yogakārakaḥ — dīrghakālika-dhana-sañcayaṃ, sevā-varga-kīrtiṃ, sthira-iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 25 — śaneḥ sarvottama-sthānam ekādaśam.

SATURN_IN_12.name: Śanirdvādaśe vyaya-saṃyamaḥ, ekānta-vairāgyam, videśa-vāsaḥ, mokṣa-pravṛttiḥ.
SATURN_IN_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śanirdvādaśasthaḥ jātakaṃ vyaya-śīlaṃ (kintu saṃyamena-niyantritaṃ), ekānta-vairāgya-pravṛttaṃ, videśa-vāsa-priyaṃ, gupta-kārya-kuśalaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — śaniḥ vyaya-sthāne mokṣa-kārakatvena tyāga-vairāgya-yoga-sādhanāṃ, gupta-sevā-kārāgāra-āśrama-sambaddha-karma ca dadāti. Pīḍite nidrā-nāśaḥ, gupta-śatruḥ; śubha-dṛṣṭyā mokṣa-tapa-yogaḥ, videśa-sthira-karma ca.

SATURN_IN_2.name: Śanirdvitīye dhana-sañcaya-vilambaḥ, mita-vāṇī, śrameṇa-dhanam, kuṭumba-bhāraḥ.
SATURN_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śanirdvitīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ mita-kaṭhora-vāṇīyuktaṃ, śrameṇa-dhana-arjinaṃ, dhana-sañcaya-vilambaṃ, kuṭumba-bhāra-vahanaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — śaniḥ dhana-sthāne ārambhe dhana-kaṣṭaṃ, paraṃ pariśrama-saṃyamena uttara-kāle sthira-sañcayaṃ dadāti. Pīḍite netra-danta-cintā; ucca-śanau śrameṇa mahā-dhana-sañcayaḥ.

SATURN_IN_3.name: Śanistṛtīye dhairya-parākrama-yogaḥ. Dīrgha-pariśrameṇa-yaśam, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-dīrghāyuḥ.
SATURN_IN_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śanistṛtīyasthaḥ dhairya-parākrama-yogakārakaḥ — dīrgha-pariśrameṇa-yaśaṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-dīrghāyuṃ, sthira-udyamaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 25 — śaniḥ upacaya-sthāneṣu ati-śubhadaḥ.

SATURN_IN_4.name: Śaniścaturthe gṛha-sukha-hāniḥ, mātṛ-kaṣṭam, hṛdaya-asantoṣaḥ, sthāna-tyāgaḥ.
SATURN_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śaniścaturthasthaḥ jātakasya gṛha-sukha-hāniṃ, mātṛ-kaṣṭaṃ, hṛdaya-asantoṣaṃ, sthāna-tyāga-pravṛttiṃ ca sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — śaniḥ sukha-sthāne kāraka-virodhaṃ (śaniḥ sukha-kāraka-candra-viruddhaḥ) janayati, yena gṛha-śānti-nyūnatā, bālye mātṛ-viyoga-kaṣṭaṃ vā. Tathāpi bhūmi-khanija-purātana-vyavasāyena uttara-kāle sthira-sampattiḥ. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā doṣa-śamanam.

SATURN_IN_5.name: Śaniḥ pañcame santati-vilambaḥ, gambhīra-buddhiḥ, mantra-dhairyam, cintā-pravṛttiḥ.
SATURN_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śaniḥ pañcamasthaḥ jātakaṃ gambhīra-dīrgha-dṛṣṭi-buddhiṃ, kintu santati-vilamba-vā-alpa-santati-yuktaṃ, cintā-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — śaniḥ putra-sthāne pūrva-puṇya-phala-vilambaṃ, santāna-kāraka-kṣobhaṃ dadāti, paraṃ gahana-śodha-buddhiṃ, dhairya-śīla-mantra-sādhanāṃ ca. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā vilambena santati-sukham; ucca-śanau dīrgha-dṛṣṭi-nīti-prajñā.

SATURN_IN_6.name: Śaniḥ ṣaṣṭhe śatru-roga-jaya-yogaḥ. Dīrgha-saṅgharṣeṇa-vijayaḥ, sevā-kīrtiḥ.
SATURN_IN_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śaniḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ śatru-roga-jaya-viparīta-rājayogakārakaḥ — dīrgha-saṅgharṣeṇa śatru-jayaṃ, roga-nivṛttiṃ, ṛṇa-kṣayaṃ, sevā-kīrtiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 25 — śaneḥ upacaya-sthānāt śreṣṭha-phalam.

SATURN_IN_7.name: Śaniḥ saptame vilamba-vivāhaḥ, sthira-dāmpatyam, vayo-adhika-sāthī, vyāpāra-dhairyam.
SATURN_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śaniḥ saptamasthaḥ jātakasya vivāha-vilambaṃ, kintu dīrgha-sthira-dāmpatyaṃ, vayo-adhika-vā-gambhīra-sāthinaṃ, vyāpāre dhairya-kauśalaṃ ca sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — śaniḥ kalatra-sthāne ārambhe sambandha-śaityaṃ, paraṃ uttara-kāle niṣṭhāṃ, dīrgha-sājhedārī-sthairyaṃ dadāti. Ucca-sva-rāśi-śanau sthira-dāmpatyaṃ; pīḍite dāmpatya-śaityaṃ vā vicheda-śaṅkā.

SATURN_IN_8.name: Śaniraṣṭame dīrghāyu-yogaḥ, gūḍha-śodhaḥ, manda-svāsthyam, vilambita-dāya-lābhaḥ.
SATURN_IN_8.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śaniraṣṭamasthaḥ jātakaṃ dīrghāyuṣaṃ, gūḍha-vidyā-śodha-śīlaṃ, kintu manda-svāsthya-vāta-roga-pravṛttaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — śaniḥ randhra-sthāne āyuṣ-kārakatvena dīrghāyuṃ dadāti (āyuṣ-kārakaḥ āyuṣ-sthāne), tathāpi cira-sthāyi-roga-kaṣṭaṃ, vilambita-dāya-vasīyata-lābhaṃ, gupta-śatru-cintāṃ ca. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā gahana-anusandhāna-dīrghāyu-yogaḥ.

SATURN_IN_9.name: Śanirnavame vilambita-bhāgyam, pitṛ-kaṣṭam, karma-dharma-niṣṭhā, nyāya-priyaḥ.
SATURN_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śanirnavamasthaḥ jātakaṃ karma-dharma-niṣṭhaṃ, nyāya-priyaṃ, pariśrameṇa-bhāgyodayaṃ, kintu vilambita-bhāgyaṃ, pitṛ-kaṣṭa-pravaṇaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 24 — śaniḥ bhāgya-trikoṇe pūrva-bhāgya-phala-vilambaṃ, pitṛ-sukha-nyūnatāṃ dadāti, paraṃ kaṭhora-śrama-nyāya-niṣṭhayā uttara-kāle sthira-bhāgyaṃ, dharma-pratiṣṭhāṃ ca. Ucca-śanau vidhi-nyāya-netṛtvam.

SUN_IN_1.name: Sūryo lagne pittaprakṛtiḥ, tejasvī, svābhimānī, ugraḥ, rāja-sammānitaḥ.
SUN_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ tejasvinaṃ, svābhimāninaṃ, pitta-prakṛtiṃ, ugra-svabhāvaṃ, rāja-sammānitaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — ātma-kārakaḥ tanu-sthāne ātma-tejaḥ vardhayati kintu pitṛ-sukhaṃ kiñcit nyūnayati.

SUN_IN_10.name: Sūryo daśame digbalī rājayogakārakaḥ. Ucca-rāja-padaṃ, adhikāraṃ, yaśaṃ dadāti.
SUN_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo daśamasthaḥ digbalī karma-rājayogakārakaḥ — ucca-rāja-padaṃ, adhikāraṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ, sthira-yaśaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raveḥ karma-sthānaṃ sarvottamaṃ uktam. Amalā-yoga-kārakaśca.
SUN_IN_10.general: Digbalī karma-rājayogaḥ, ucca-rāja-padam, adhikāraḥ, rāja-sammānam, sthira-yaśam, amalā-kīrtiḥ.

SUN_IN_11.name: Sūryo lābhasthāne rāja-lābha-yogaḥ. Rāja-sammānena-dhana-vṛddhiḥ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaḥ.
SUN_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo lābhasthāne rāja-lābha-yogakārakaḥ — rāja-sammānena dhana-vṛddhiṃ, jyeṣṭha-bhrātṛ-tejaṃ, adhikāra-kīrtiṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — sūryo upacaya-lābhasthānāt sarvārtha-vardhakaḥ.

SUN_IN_12.name: Sūryo dvādaśe vyaya-bāhulyam, pitṛ-viyogaḥ, netra-doṣaḥ, mokṣa-pravṛttiḥ.
SUN_IN_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo dvādaśasthaḥ jātakasya vyaya-bāhulyaṃ, pitṛ-sukha-hāniṃ, netra-doṣaṃ, māna-hāniṃ vā sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raviḥ vyaya-sthāne tejo-vyayaṃ, rāja-kopa-sambhāvanāṃ, videśa-vāsaṃ ca dadāti. Tathāpi mokṣa-pravṛttiḥ, ekānta-sādhanā, ādhyātmika-vyayaśca kvacit śubhaḥ. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā videśa-kīrti-yogaḥ.

SUN_IN_2.name: Sūryo dvitīye kaṭhora-vāṇī, kuṭumba-kalahaḥ, netra-dhana-viṣaye yatnaḥ.
SUN_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo dvitīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ kaṭhora-vāṇīyuktaṃ, rāja-sevayā dhanārjinaṃ, kintu kuṭumbe māna-bheda-pravaṇaṃ karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raviḥ dhanasthāne netra-pīḍāṃ, mukha-doṣaṃ, kuṭumba-viṣaye ahaṅkāra-janita-kalahaṃ ca sūcayati. Rāja-kāryeṇa artha-lābhastu bhavati.

SUN_IN_3.name: Sūryastṛtīye parākrama-yogaḥ. Sāhasī, bhrātṛ-śreṣṭhaḥ, sva-bala-vijayī.
SUN_IN_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryastṛtīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ parākramiṇaṃ, sāhasinaṃ, sva-bala-vijayinaṃ, alpa-bhrātṛ-sukhaṃ kintu bhrātṛṣu śreṣṭhaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raviḥ upacaya-tṛtīye bala-vardhakaḥ, udyama-śīlaḥ, śatru-nivārakaśca. Parākrameṇa kīrtiṃ dadāti.
SUN_IN_3.general: Parākramaḥ, sāhasam, sva-bala-vijayaḥ, bhrātṛṣu śreṣṭhatā, udyama-śīlatā.

SUN_IN_4.name: Sūryaścaturthe mātṛ-sukha-hāniḥ, gṛha-aśāntiḥ, hṛdaya-tāpaḥ.
SUN_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryaścaturthasthaḥ jātakasya mātṛ-sukha-hāniṃ, gṛha-aśāntiṃ, hṛdaya-tāpaṃ, sukha-sthāna-kṣayaṃ ca sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raviḥ sukha-sthāne kāraka-virodhaṃ (sūryaḥ sukha-kāraka-candra-viruddhaḥ) janayati, yena gṛha-vāhana-saukhye nyūnatā, mātṛ-svāsthya-cintā ca bhavati. Tathāpi paitṛka-pada-pratiṣṭhā kvacit labhyate.

SUN_IN_5.name: Sūryaḥ pañcame buddhi-mān, alpa-santatiḥ, rāja-kṛpā, ucca-śikṣā.
SUN_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryaḥ pañcamasthaḥ jātakaṃ buddhimantaṃ, mantra-vidyā-kuśalaṃ, rāja-kṛpā-pātraṃ, kintu alpa-santatiṃ vā santati-vilambaṃ karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raviḥ putra-sthāne prakhara-buddhiṃ, pitrā-sambaddha-kīrtiṃ dadāti, paraṃ santāna-kāraka-tve kṣīṇaḥ — ataḥ santati-viṣaye yatna-sādhyatā.

SUN_IN_6.name: Sūryaḥ ṣaṣṭhe śatru-vijayī, roga-nāśakaḥ, bala-vān, ari-bhañjanaḥ.
SUN_IN_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryaḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ jātakaṃ śatru-vijayinaṃ, roga-nāśakaṃ, bala-vantaṃ, ṛṇa-muktaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raviḥ upacaya-ṣaṣṭhe prabalaḥ — ari-vargaṃ bhanakti, sva-tejasā rogān kṣiṇoti, spardhāyāṃ vijayaṃ dadāti. Etat śubha-sthānaṃ raveḥ balāya.

SUN_IN_7.name: Sūryaḥ saptame dāmpatye māna-bhedaḥ, kalatra-svātantryam, rāja-dvārā-yaśaḥ.
SUN_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryaḥ saptamasthaḥ jātakasya dāmpatye māna-bhedaṃ, kalatra-svābhimāna-saṅgharṣaṃ, vilamba-vivāhaṃ vā sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raviḥ kalatra-sthāne ahaṅkāra-kārakatvena dāmpatya-sāmañjasye bādhāṃ janayati, tathāpi rāja-sevā-vyāpāreṇa yaśo-lābhaṃ dadāti. Kalatra-kāraka-śukra-dṛṣṭyā doṣa-śamanam.

SUN_IN_8.name: Sūryo'ṣṭame alpa-netra-tejaḥ, pitṛ-kaṣṭam, svāsthya-cintā, manda-kīrtiḥ.
SUN_IN_8.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo'ṣṭamasthaḥ jātakasya netra-teja-hāniṃ, pitṛ-kaṣṭaṃ, akasmāt-svāsthya-cintāṃ, manda-kīrtiṃ ca sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raviḥ randhra-sthāne tejo-hāniṃ, pituḥ āyur-viṣaye doṣaṃ, māna-kṣayaṃ ca janayati. Āyuṣ-dīrghatā tu kvacit, paraṃ pratiṣṭhā-prāptau bahu-yatnaḥ apekṣyate. Dṛṣṭi-śubha-yoge doṣa-śamanam.

SUN_IN_9.name: Sūryo navame pitṛ-bhāgya-yogaḥ. Pitṛ-sukhī, dhārmikaḥ, rāja-kīrtimān.
SUN_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye sūryo navamasthaḥ pitṛ-bhāgya-yogakārakaḥ — pitṛ-sukhaṃ, dharma-niṣṭhāṃ, rāja-kīrtiṃ, guru-kṛpāṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 21 — raverbhāgya-sthānāt pitṛ-kāraka-trikoṇa-yogaḥ.

VENUS_IN_1.name: Śukro lagne sundara-kāntiḥ, kalāpriyaḥ, bhoga-samṛddhaḥ, sukha-vān.
VENUS_IN_1.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro lagnasthaḥ jātakaṃ sundara-kāntiṃ, kalāpriyaṃ, bhoga-samṛddhaṃ, sukhinaṃ, strī-sammānitaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ kāraka-tanu-saṃyogāt kalātmaka-vyaktitvaṃ dadāti.

VENUS_IN_10.name: Śukro daśame kalā-karma-yaśaḥ. Saundarya-vilāsa-vyavasāyaḥ, madhura-kīrtiḥ.
VENUS_IN_10.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro daśamasthaḥ kalā-karma-yaśa-kārakaḥ — saundarya-kalā-vilāsa-vastra-ābhūṣaṇa-manorañjana-kṣetre yaśaṃ, madhura-kīrtiṃ, rāja-sammānaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ karma-kendre digbala-samīpe kalā-vyavasāyena pratiṣṭhāṃ janayati. Strī-sahayogena-karma-vṛddhiḥ.

VENUS_IN_11.name: Śukra ekādaśe lābha-kalā-yogaḥ. Nirantara-lābhaḥ, strī-mitradvārā-dhanam.
VENUS_IN_11.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukra ekādaśasthaḥ lābha-kalā-yogakārakaḥ — nirantara-dhana-lābhaṃ, strī-mitra-dvārā-dhana-vardhanaṃ, kalātmaka-vyāpāreṇa-yaśaṃ, iṣṭa-siddhiṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukro lābhasthāne sarvārtha-lābhakārakaḥ.

VENUS_IN_12.name: Śukro dvādaśe śayyā-sukha-yogaḥ, bhoga-vyayaḥ, mokṣa-kalā-pravṛttiḥ.
VENUS_IN_12.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro dvādaśasthaḥ jātakaṃ śayyā-sukha-samṛddhaṃ, bhoga-vilāsa-vyaya-śīlaṃ, videśa-vāsa-priyaṃ, gupta-prema-pravṛttaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ vyaya-sthāne bhoga-vyaya-kārakaḥ, paraṃ śayyā-sukhe (bhoga-kārakaḥ vyaya-sthāne) śreṣṭha-phalaṃ, mokṣa-kalā-pravṛttiṃ ca dadāti — etat "śayyā-sukha-yogaḥ" iti prasiddham. Vilāsa-vyaya-niyantraṇaṃ tu apekṣyate.

VENUS_IN_2.name: Śukro dvitīye dhana-kalā-yogaḥ. Madhura-vāṇī, sundara-vastu-saṅgrahaḥ, kuṭumba-sukhī.
VENUS_IN_2.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro dvitīyasthaḥ dhana-kalā-yogakārakaḥ — madhura-vāṇīṃ, dhana-samṛddhiṃ, sundara-vastu-ābhūṣaṇa-saṅgrahaṃ, kuṭumba-sukhaṃ ca dadāti.
