Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ dhana-sthāne kalā-vāṇijyena-dhanārjanaṃ, manojña-bhāṣaṇaṃ ca janayati. Strī-kāraṇena-dhana-vṛddhiḥ kvacit.

VENUS_IN_3.name: Śukrastṛtīye kalā-sañcāra-kauśalam, bhaginī-sukhī, sukha-yātrā-priyaḥ.
VENUS_IN_3.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukrastṛtīyasthaḥ jātakaṃ kalā-sañcāra-kuśalaṃ, bhaginī-sukhinaṃ, sukha-yātrā-priyaṃ, madhura-vyavahāriṇaṃ ca karoti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ upacaya-tṛtīye kalā-nṛtya-saṅgīta-parākramaṃ, mitra-sukhaṃ, saundarya-pracāra-kauśalaṃ ca dadāti. Sva-kārakatve īṣat-nyūnatā, paraṃ upacaya-vṛddhiḥ.

VENUS_IN_4.name: Śukraścaturthe gṛha-vāhana-bhoga-yogaḥ. Mātṛ-sukhī, sundara-gṛhasthaḥ.
VENUS_IN_4.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukraścaturthasthaḥ gṛha-vāhana-bhoga-samṛddhiṃ, sundara-gṛhastha-vṛttiṃ, mātṛ-sukhaṃ, strī-sahayogena-dhana-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ sukha-sthāne bhoga-kendra-rājayogakārakaḥ.

VENUS_IN_5.name: Śukraḥ pañcame kāvya-kalā-santati-yogaḥ. Buddhimān, kalākāraḥ, santati-sukhī.
VENUS_IN_5.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukraḥ pañcamasthaḥ kāvya-kalā-santati-yogakārakaḥ — buddhimattā, kalātmaka-vṛttiḥ, santati-sukhaṃ, sundara-strī-sambandhaṃ, rāja-kīrti-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — kāraka-trikoṇa-rājayogaḥ.

VENUS_IN_6.name: Śukraḥ ṣaṣṭhe kalatra-sukha-hāniḥ, bhoga-vighnaḥ, sevā-kalā-vṛttiḥ.
VENUS_IN_6.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukraḥ ṣaṣṭhasthaḥ jātakasya kalatra-sukha-hāniṃ, bhoga-vighnaṃ, sambandha-kalahaṃ vā sūcayati, paraṃ sevā-kalā-cikitsā-kṣetre prāvīṇyaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ ripu-sthāne kāraka-hāniṃ (kalatra-kārakaḥ duḥsthāne pīḍitaḥ) janayati, yena dāmpatye bādhā, ṛṇa-vivāda-sambhāvanā ca. Upacaya-tvāt śatru-vijayaḥ, kalā-sevayā jīvikā ca.

VENUS_IN_7.name: Śukraḥ saptame kāraka-kāraka-yogaḥ. Sundara-jāyādvārā-vṛddhiḥ, dāmpatya-sukhī.
VENUS_IN_7.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukraḥ saptamasthaḥ kāraka-kāraka-yogakārakaḥ — śukraḥ kalatra-kārakaḥ kalatra-sthāne tiṣṭhan sundara-jāyāṃ, dāmpatya-sukhaṃ, strī-sahayogena-vardhanaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śreṣṭha-kalatra-yogaḥ.

VENUS_IN_8.name: Śukro'ṣṭame dāya-dhana-lābhaḥ, gūḍha-bhoga-pravṛttiḥ, kintu kalatra-āyur-cintā.
VENUS_IN_8.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro'ṣṭamasthaḥ jātakaṃ dāya-vasīyata-dhana-lābhaṃ, gūḍha-bhoga-pravṛttiṃ, dīrgha-bhoga-śaktiṃ ca dadāti, paraṃ kalatra-āyur-viṣaye cintāṃ, sambandha-gopanaṃ vā sūcayati. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — śukraḥ randhra-sthāne kalatra-kārakatva-kṣobhaṃ, paraṃ akasmāt-dhana-strī-dhana-lābhaṃ, gupta-kalā-pravṛttiṃ ca janayati. Śubha-dṛṣṭyā dāya-yogaḥ.

VENUS_IN_9.name: Śukro navame bhāgya-kalā-yogaḥ. Dhārmika-kalākāraḥ, strī-kāraṇena-bhāgyodayaḥ.
VENUS_IN_9.prose: Phaladīpikāyām aṣṭame adhyāye śukro navamasthaḥ bhāgya-kalā-yogakārakaḥ — dhārmika-kalākāritvaṃ, strī-kāraṇena-bhāgyodayaṃ, sundara-dharma-yātrāṃ, guru-kṛpā-sahitaṃ bhāgyaṃ ca dadāti. Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstre 22 — kāraka-trikoṇa-rājayogaḥ.

GULIKA_KAALA.phalaProse: Gulikakālaḥ (māndiḥ) śaniputragulikena śāsitaḥ dinamānāṣṭamāṃśaḥ, vārānusāraṃ bhinnasamayasthaḥ. Ayaṃ śubhakāryārambhe varjyaḥ; asmin ārabdhaṃ karma punaḥpunaḥ āvartate (gulikaḥ yat spṛśati tat vardhate iti) — ataḥ śubhe āvartanaṃ, aśubhe ca āvartanaṃ vardhate. Śubhakarma na kuryāt; ṛṇadānādi niṣiddham.

RAHU_KAALA.phalaProse: Rāhukālaḥ dinamānasya aṣṭamo bhāgaḥ (prāyaḥ dīḍaghaṭikā, sārdhahorātmakaḥ), vārānusāraṃ bhinnasamayasthaḥ. Ayaṃ śubhakāryārambhe sarvathā varjyaḥ — yātrā, krayavikrayaḥ, gṛhapraveśaḥ, vivāhasaṅkalpādi asmin na kuryāt. Tathāpi śatrunāśābhicārakarmaṇi, śanirāhupūjane ca kecit grāhyaṃ manyante. Ārabdhakārye vighnavilambau.

YAMAGHANDA.phalaProse: Yamagaṇḍakālaḥ yamena śāsitaḥ dinamānāṣṭamāṃśaḥ, vārānusāraṃ bhinnasamayasthaḥ. Ayaṃ śubhakāryārambhe varjyaḥ, viśeṣato yātrārambhe niṣiddhaḥ — asmin ārabdhā yātrā vighnakleśakarī, kāryaṃ ca niṣphalaprāyam. Mṛtyukārakayamasambaddhatvāt maṅgalakārye tyājyaḥ.

AQUARIUS.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe kumbharāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ śaniḥ śivo vā; vairāgyasevājñānamuktipradā upāsanā praśastā.
AQUARIUS.lagnaPhala: Kumbhalagne vicāraśīlaḥ, mānavatā-priyaḥ, svatantra-cittaḥ, gambhīraḥ. Śani-prabhāvāt dūra-darśī.
AQUARIUS.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Vicāra-śīlatā, mānavatā-priyatā, svātantryam, dūra-darśitā, mitratā, haṭha, dīrgha-dehaḥ.
AQUARIUS.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye kumbhalagno jātakaḥ dīrgha-madhyama-dehaḥ, gambhīra-mukhaḥ, vicāra-śīlaḥ, mānavatā-hita-rataḥ, svatantra-cittaḥ, mitra-priyaḥ ca bhavati. Śani-svāmitvāt dūra-darśitā, sahana-śīlatā, sāmājika-cintanaṃ ca prabalāḥ; ekākitva-haṭha-doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ vāyu-sthira-rāśiḥ sudhārakaṃ, gahana-vicārakaṃ, jana-kalyāṇa-rataṃ karoti.

ARIES.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe meṣarāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ sūryaḥ kārtikeyo vā; tejobalasāhasapradā upāsanā praśastā.
ARIES.lagnaPhala: Meṣalagne capalaḥ, sāhasī, kṛśadehaḥ, raktavarṇaḥ. Netṛtvaśīlaḥ, krodhī, svatantraḥ.
ARIES.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Sāhasam, netṛtvam, svātantryam, śīghra-nirṇayaḥ, spardhā, krodha-cāpalyam, kṛśa-tejasvi-dehaḥ.
ARIES.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye meṣalagno jātakaḥ kṛśa-madhyama-dehaḥ, raktābha-gauraḥ, capala-netraḥ, sāhasī, ugra-svabhāvaḥ, netṛtva-priyaḥ, svatantra-vṛttiḥ ca bhavati. Kuja-svāmitvāt ātmani tejaḥ, spardhā, śīghra-nirṇayaḥ prabalāḥ; krodha-cāpalye doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ pañcame adhyāye ayaṃ agni-cara-rāśiḥ udyama-śīlaṃ, agragāminaṃ, raṇa-dakṣaṃ karoti.

CANCER.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe karkarāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ pārvatī candro vā; manaḥśāntimātṛsaukhyabhāvanāsthairyapradā upāsanā praśastā.
CANCER.lagnaPhala: Karkalagne bhāvukaḥ, mātṛ-bhaktaḥ, gṛha-priyaḥ, saṃvedanaśīlaḥ. Candra-prabhāvāt capala-manāḥ.
CANCER.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Bhāvukatā, mātṛ-gṛha-bhaktiḥ, saṃvedanā, smṛtiḥ, kalpanā, manaścāpalyam, gaura-dehaḥ.
CANCER.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye karkalagno jātakaḥ sthūla-madhyama-dehaḥ, gaura-varṇaḥ, bhāvuka-hṛdayaḥ, mātṛ-gṛha-jala-priyaḥ, saṃvedanaśīlaḥ, kalpanā-śīlaḥ ca bhavati. Candra-svāmitvāt bhāva-pravaṇatā, smṛti-śaktiḥ, poṣaṇa-vṛttiḥ ca prabalāḥ; manaścāpalya-ati-bhāvukate doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ jala-cara-rāśiḥ parivartana-śīlaṃ, sneha-pradhānaṃ, jana-sevā-rataṃ karoti.

CAPRICORN.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe makararāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ śaniḥ kṛṣṇo vā; dhairyakarmanyāyaśaniśāntipradā upāsanā praśastā.
CAPRICORN.lagnaPhala: Makaralagne karma-niṣṭhaḥ, dhairyavān, mahattvākāṅkṣī, gambhīraḥ. Śani-prabhāvāt śrama-śīlaḥ.
CAPRICORN.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Karma-niṣṭhā, dhairyam, mahattvākāṅkṣā, śrama-śīlatā, sahana-śaktiḥ, ati-cintā, kṛśa-dehaḥ.
CAPRICORN.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye makaralagno jātakaḥ kṛśa-dīrgha-dehaḥ, gambhīra-mukhaḥ, karma-niṣṭhaḥ, dhairyavān, mahattvākāṅkṣī, vyavahāra-kuśalaḥ ca bhavati. Śani-svāmitvāt śrama-śīlatā, sahana-śaktiḥ, dīrgha-kālika-dṛṣṭiḥ ca prabalāḥ; ati-cintā-nairāśya-doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ pṛthvī-cara-rāśiḥ udyaminaṃ, sopāna-krama-ārohiṇaṃ, uttara-vayasi-samṛddhaṃ karoti.

GEMINI.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe mithunarāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ viṣṇuḥ sarasvatī vā; buddhividyāsaṃvādapradā upāsanā praśastā.
GEMINI.lagnaPhala: Mithunalagne buddhimān, vāk-paṭuḥ, capala-manāḥ, dvi-svabhāvaḥ. Budha-prabhāvāt kuśala-vyavahārī.
GEMINI.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Buddhiḥ, vāk-kauśalam, tarkaḥ, bahu-kārya-dakṣatā, hāsya-rasaḥ, manaścāpalyam, sūkṣma-dehaḥ.
GEMINI.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye mithunalagno jātakaḥ madhyama-tanu-dehaḥ, capala-netraḥ, vāk-paṭuḥ, buddhimān, hāsya-rasikaḥ, dvi-svabhāva-cittaḥ ca bhavati. Budha-svāmitvāt tarka-śaktiḥ, sambhāṣaṇa-kauśalam, bahu-viṣaya-grahaṇaṃ ca prabalāḥ; asthiratā-saṃśayau doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ vāyu-dvi-svabhāva-rāśiḥ lekhana-vāṇijya-sañcāra-dakṣaṃ karoti.

LEO.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe siṃharāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ śivaḥ sūryo vā; ātmabalanetṛtvatejaḥpradā upāsanā praśastā.
LEO.lagnaPhala: Siṃhalagne tejasvī, mānī, netṛ-śīlaḥ, udāraḥ. Sūrya-prabhāvāt rāja-tulya-vyaktitvam.
LEO.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Tejaḥ, mānaḥ, netṛtvam, audāryam, sthira-saṅkalpaḥ, ahaṅkāraḥ, unnata-dehaḥ.
LEO.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye siṃhalagno jātakaḥ unnata-dṛḍha-dehaḥ, tejasvi-mukhaḥ, mānī, udāra-hṛdayaḥ, netṛtva-priyaḥ, sthira-saṅkalpaḥ ca bhavati. Sūrya-svāmitvāt ātma-gauravam, adhikāra-vṛttiḥ, audāryaṃ ca prabalāḥ; ahaṅkāra-darpa-doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ agni-sthira-rāśiḥ rāja-tulyaṃ, yaśa-kāminaṃ, sattva-pradhānaṃ karoti.

LIBRA.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe tulārāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī vā; santulanasaubhāgyakalānyāyapradā upāsanā praśastā.
LIBRA.lagnaPhala: Tulālagne nyāya-priyaḥ, sama-darśī, kalā-rasikaḥ, saumyaḥ. Śukra-prabhāvāt sambandha-kuśalaḥ.
LIBRA.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Nyāya-priyatā, santulanam, kalā-rasaḥ, sambandha-kauśalam, saumyatā, nirṇaya-dvaidham, sama-dehaḥ.
LIBRA.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye tulālagno jātakaḥ sama-dīrgha-dehaḥ, saumya-mukhaḥ, nyāya-priyaḥ, sama-darśī, kalā-vyavahāra-kuśalaḥ, sandhi-priyaḥ ca bhavati. Śukra-svāmitvāt saundarya-rasaḥ, sama-buddhiḥ, sambandha-nipuṇatā ca prabalāḥ; nirṇaya-dvaidhe vilambe doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ vāyu-cara-rāśiḥ vyavahāra-dakṣaṃ, sahakāra-priyaṃ, santulana-śīlaṃ karoti.

PISCES.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe mīnarāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ viṣṇurbṛhaspatirvā; jñānamokṣabhaktikaruṇāpradā upāsanā praśastā.
PISCES.lagnaPhala: Mīnalagne bhāvukaḥ, dayāluḥ, ādhyātmikaḥ, kalpanā-śīlaḥ. Guru-prabhāvāt śraddhāvān.
PISCES.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Bhāvukatā, dayā, ādhyātmikatā, kalpanā, śraddhā, palāyana-vṛttiḥ, mṛdu-dehaḥ.
PISCES.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye mīnalagno jātakaḥ sthūla-mṛdu-dehaḥ, saumya-netraḥ, bhāvukaḥ, dayāluḥ, ādhyātmikaḥ, kalpanā-śīlaḥ, śraddhāvān ca bhavati. Guru-svāmitvāt dharma-śraddhā, paropakāra-vṛttiḥ, antar-dṛṣṭiḥ ca prabalāḥ; ati-bhāvukatā-palāyana-vṛtti-doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ jala-dvi-svabhāva-rāśiḥ karuṇā-pradhānaṃ, sevā-tyāga-rataṃ, adhyātma-abhimukhaṃ karoti.

SAGITTARIUS.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe dhanurāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ viṣṇurdattātreyo vā; jñānadharmagurukṛpāpradā upāsanā praśastā.
SAGITTARIUS.lagnaPhala: Dhanurlagne dhārmikaḥ, āśāvādī, spaṣṭa-vaktā, jñāna-priyaḥ. Guru-prabhāvāt nīti-niṣṭhaḥ.
SAGITTARIUS.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Dhārmikatā, āśāvādaḥ, jñāna-priyatā, nīti-niṣṭhā, spaṣṭa-vacanam, ati-āśā, unnata-dehaḥ.
SAGITTARIUS.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye dhanurlagno jātakaḥ unnata-dṛḍha-dehaḥ, tejasvi-mukhaḥ, dhārmikaḥ, āśāvādī, spaṣṭa-vaktā, jñāna-dharma-priyaḥ ca bhavati. Guru-svāmitvāt nīti-niṣṭhā, udāra-dṛṣṭiḥ, guru-śiṣya-vṛttiḥ ca prabalāḥ; ati-spaṣṭa-vacane ati-āśāyāṃ doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ agni-dvi-svabhāva-rāśiḥ dharma-darśana-yātrā-priyaṃ, upadeśakaṃ, satya-niṣṭhaṃ karoti.

SCORPIO.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe vṛścikarāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ nṛsiṃho hanumān vā; śatrujayasāhasarakṣaṇapradā upāsanā praśastā.
SCORPIO.lagnaPhala: Vṛścikalagne gūḍhaḥ, tīvraḥ, saṅkalpa-dṛḍhaḥ, rahasya-priyaḥ. Kuja-prabhāvāt adamya-icchā-śaktiḥ.
SCORPIO.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Icchā-śaktiḥ, gūḍhatā, saṅkalpa-dṛḍhatā, anveṣaṇam, sahana-śīlatā, īrṣyā, dṛḍha-dehaḥ.
SCORPIO.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye vṛścikalagno jātakaḥ dṛḍha-gupta-dehaḥ, tīkṣṇa-netraḥ, gūḍha-svabhāvaḥ, saṅkalpa-dṛḍhaḥ, rahasya-priyaḥ, gambhīraḥ ca bhavati. Kuja-svāmitvāt tīvra-icchā-śaktiḥ, anveṣaṇa-vṛttiḥ, sahana-śīlatā ca prabalāḥ; īrṣyā-pratiśodha-doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ jala-sthira-rāśiḥ gahana-śodhakaṃ, parivartana-samarthaṃ, adhyātma-rahasya-rataṃ karoti.

TAURUS.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe vṛṣarāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ gaurī lakṣmīrvā; saubhāgyasamṛddhisaundaryapradā upāsanā praśastā.
TAURUS.lagnaPhala: Vṛṣalagne sthiraḥ, dhairyavān, sukha-bhoga-priyaḥ, ākarṣakaḥ. Śukra-prabhāvāt kalā-rasikaḥ.
TAURUS.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Sthairyam, dhairyam, kalā-saundarya-rasaḥ, dhana-saṅgrahaḥ, bhoga-priyatā, haṭhaḥ, dṛḍha-dehaḥ.
TAURUS.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye vṛṣalagno jātakaḥ sthūla-dṛḍha-dehaḥ, medhura-vāk, ākarṣaka-mukhaḥ, dhairyavān, sukha-bhoga-kalā-priyaḥ, sthira-cittaḥ ca bhavati. Śukra-svāmitvāt saundarya-rasaḥ, dhana-saṅgraha-śaktiḥ, bhoga-vāsanā ca prabalāḥ; ālasya-haṭha-doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ pṛthvī-sthira-rāśiḥ sahana-śīlaṃ, pariśramiṇaṃ, artha-sañcaya-dakṣaṃ karoti.

VIRGO.ishtaDevataProse: Kārakāṃśe kanyārāśau iṣṭadevatā prāyaḥ viṣṇuḥ sarasvatī vā; vivekavidyāsevāśuddhipradā upāsanā praśastā.
VIRGO.lagnaPhala: Kanyālagne viśleṣakaḥ, sevā-śīlaḥ, śuci-priyaḥ, buddhimān. Budha-prabhātāt sūkṣma-dṛṣṭiḥ.
VIRGO.lagnaPhalaGeneral: Viśleṣaṇam, sevā-vṛttiḥ, śucitā, sūkṣma-buddhiḥ, kārya-kauśalam, ati-cintā, madhyama-dehaḥ.
VIRGO.lagnaPhalaProse: Bṛhajjātake prathame adhyāye kanyālagno jātakaḥ madhyama-tanu-dehaḥ, śuci-priyaḥ, viśleṣaṇa-dakṣaḥ, sevā-nirataḥ, vinamraḥ, kārya-kuśalaḥ ca bhavati. Budha-svāmitvāt sūkṣma-buddhiḥ, doṣa-darśana-śaktiḥ, śuddhi-vṛttiḥ ca prabalāḥ; ati-cintā-chidrānveṣaṇe doṣau. Sārāvalyāṃ ayaṃ pṛthvī-dvi-svabhāva-rāśiḥ pariśramiṇaṃ, gaṇaka-dakṣaṃ, ārogya-sajagaṃ karoti.

AADI.phalaProse: Ādināḍyāṃ nava nakṣatrāṇi (aśvinī, ārdrā, punarvasu, uttarāphālgunī, hasta, jyeṣṭhā, mūlā, śatabhiṣā, pūrvābhādrapadā ca). Ādināḍījātaḥ vātapradhānaprakṛtiḥ — capalaḥ, kriyāśīlaḥ, śīghracintakaśca. Nāḍīkūṭaṃ (aṣṭakūṭamadhye aṣṭāṅkaiḥ sarvādhikaṃ balavat) ārogyasantatyośca vicārakam; ubhayoḥ samānanāḍyoḥ satoḥ nāḍīdoṣaḥ, yaḥ santatibādhāṃ dāmpatyakleśaṃ vā sūcayati. Ekanakṣatre pādabhedena vā parihāraḥ sambhavati.

ANTYA.phalaProse: Antyanāḍyāṃ nava nakṣatrāṇi (kṛttikā, rohiṇī, āśleṣā, maghā, svāti, viśākhā, uttarāṣāḍhā, śravaṇa, revatī ca). Antyanāḍījātaḥ kaphapradhānaprakṛtiḥ — sthiraḥ, śāntaḥ, sahiṣṇuḥ poṣakaśca. Vivāhe ubhayoḥ antyanāḍyoḥ satoḥ nāḍīdoṣaḥ. Ādi-antyayoḥ (vāta-kaphayoḥ) melanaṃ tu śreṣṭhaṃ svāsthyasantatipradaṃ ca.

MADHYA.phalaProse: Madhyanāḍyāṃ nava nakṣatrāṇi (bharaṇī, mṛgaśirā, puṣya, pūrvāphālgunī, citrā, anurādhā, pūrvāṣāḍhā, dhaniṣṭhā, uttarābhādrapadā ca). Madhyanāḍījātaḥ pittapradhānaprakṛtiḥ — tīkṣṇaḥ, uṣṇasvabhāvaḥ, utsāhī netṛtvaśīlaśca. Vivāhe ubhayoḥ madhyanāḍyoḥ satoḥ nāḍīdoṣaḥ, yaḥ ārogyasantatyoḥ bādhāṃ sūcayati. Madhyanāḍau doṣaḥ tīvratamo manyate.

ANURADHA.namakaranaProse: Anurādhānakṣatre (mitradevatā, śanisvāmī) jātaḥ maitrīpriyaḥ, sahayogī, bhaktaḥ, saṅgaṭhanakuśalaśca. Nāmakaraṇe maitrīṃ bhaktiṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
ANURADHA.phala: Anurādhā — maitryāḥ, saṅgaṭhanasya, sarvaśubhasya ca mṛdunakṣatram.
ANURADHA.phalaProse: Anurādhā mitradevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ mṛdumaitranakṣatram. Maitrīsambandhaḥ, saṅgaṭhanakarma, yātrā, sarvamaṅgalakāryaṃ ca praśastam. Snehasiddhipradaṃ śubhaṃ ca.

ARDRA.namakaranaProse: Ārdrānakṣatre (rudradevatā, rāhusvāmī) jātaḥ tīkṣṇabuddhiḥ, parivartanaśīlaḥ, gahanacintakaḥ, saṃvedanaśīlaśca. Nāmakaraṇe gāmbhīryaṃ buddhiṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
ARDRA.phalaProse: Ārdrā rudrādhiṣṭhitaṃ tīkṣṇogranakṣatram. Śatrunāśaḥ, abhicāraḥ, tīkṣṇasāhasakarma ca yogyam; kintu vivāhagṛhārambhādiśubhamaṅgale varjyam. Ugraphalam.

ASHLESHA.namakaranaProse: Āśleṣānakṣatre (sarpadevatā, budhasvāmī) jātaḥ gūḍhaḥ, kūṭanītijñaḥ, medhāvī, rahasyapriyaśca. Nāmakaraṇe buddhiṃ gāmbhīryaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
ASHLESHA.phala: Āśleṣā — mantrasiddheḥ, tīkṣṇakarmaṇaḥ ca nakṣatram; śubhamaṅgale varjyam.
ASHLESHA.phalaProse: Āśleṣā nāgadevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ tīkṣṇadāruṇanakṣatram. Mantrasiddhiḥ, guptakarma, viṣauṣadham, tīkṣṇasādhyakāryaṃ ca yogyam; kintu śubhamaṅgale prāyaḥ varjyam.

ASHWINI.namakaranaProse: Aśvinīnakṣatre (aśvinīkumāradevatā, ketusvāmī) jātaḥ capalaḥ, tejasvī, kriyāśīlaḥ, ārogyapriyaśca. Nāmakaraṇe ārambhaśīlatāṃ sphūrtiṃ cikitsānaipuṇyaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
ASHWINI.phalaProse: Aśvinī aśvinīkumārādhiṣṭhitaṃ kṣipralaghu nakṣatram. Auṣadhakriyā, yātrā, śīghrasādhyakāryam, vāhanakrayaśca praśastam. Ārogyapradaṃ capalaṃ ca; mandakārye na praśastam.

BHARANI.namakaranaProse: Bharaṇīnakṣatre (yamadevatā, śukrasvāmī) jātaḥ dṛḍhasaṅkalpaḥ, saṃyamī, kartavyaniṣṭhaḥ, nyāyapriyaśca. Nāmakaraṇe dṛḍhatāṃ śuddhatāṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
BHARANI.phala: Bharaṇī — ugrakāryasya, dṛḍhaniścayasya ca nakṣatram; śubhamaṅgale varjyam.
BHARANI.phalaProse: Bharaṇī yamādhiṣṭhitam ugrakrūranakṣatram. Dṛḍhaniścayakarma, vivādanirākaraṇam, ugrasādhyakāryaṃ ca yogyam; kintu vivāhādisaumyamaṅgale prāyaḥ varjyam.

CHITRA.namakaranaProse: Citrānakṣatre (tvaṣṭṛdevatā, bhaumasvāmī) jātaḥ saundaryapriyaḥ, kalākāraḥ, ākarṣakaḥ, sṛjanaśīlaśca. Nāmakaraṇe saundaryaṃ śilpaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
CHITRA.phala: Citrā — kalāyāḥ, śilpasya, saundaryasya ca mṛdunakṣatram.
CHITRA.phalaProse: Citrā tvaṣṭṛviśvakarmadevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ mṛdumaitranakṣatram. Śilpakalā, gṛhasajjā, vastrābhūṣaṇam, saundaryakarma ca praśastam. Ākarṣakaṃ saumyaphalaṃ ca.

DHANISHTHA.namakaranaProse: Dhaniṣṭhānakṣatre (vasudevatā, bhaumasvāmī) jātaḥ samṛddhipriyaḥ, layasaṅgītapriyaḥ, udāraḥ, sāmājikaśca. Nāmakaraṇe samṛddhiṃ layaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
DHANISHTHA.phala: Dhaniṣṭhā — saṅgītasya, dhanasya, utsavasya ca caranakṣatram.
DHANISHTHA.phalaProse: Dhaniṣṭhā vasudevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ caracalanakṣatram. Saṅgītam, dhanakarma, utsavaḥ, yātrā ca praśastam. Samṛddhipradaṃ capalaṃ ca; sthirakārye nyūnam.

HASTA.namakaranaProse: Hastanakṣatre (savitṛdevatā, candrasvāmī) jātaḥ hastanipuṇaḥ, kuśalaḥ, pariśramī, caturaśca. Nāmakaraṇe kauśalaṃ pariśramaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
HASTA.phala: Hasta — śilpakarmaṇaḥ, vidyāyāḥ, sarvaśubhasya ca kṣipranakṣatram.
HASTA.phalaProse: Hasta savitṛsūryadevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ kṣipralaghunakṣatram. Hastaśilpam, vidyārambhaḥ, vāṇijyam, sarvamaṅgalakāryaṃ ca praśastam. Siddhipradaṃ śubhaṃ ca.

JYESHTHA.namakaranaProse: Jyeṣṭhānakṣatre (indradevatā, budhasvāmī) jātaḥ netṛtvaguṇī, saṃrakṣakaḥ, gambhīraḥ, anubhavapriyaśca. Nāmakaraṇe netṛtvaṃ saṃrakṣaṇaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
JYESHTHA.phala: Jyeṣṭhā — sāhasakarmaṇaḥ, adhikārasya ca tīkṣṇanakṣatram; śubhamaṅgale varjyam.
JYESHTHA.phalaProse: Jyeṣṭhā indradevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ tīkṣṇadāruṇanakṣatram. Sāhasakarma, adhikāragrahaṇam, śatrunāśaḥ, tīkṣṇasādhyakāryaṃ ca yogyam; kintu śubhamaṅgale varjyam.

KRITTIKA.namakaranaProse: Kṛttikānakṣatre (agnidevatā, sūryasvāmī) jātaḥ tejasvī, nirbhīkaḥ, netṛtvaguṇī, tīkṣṇabuddhiśca. Nāmakaraṇe tejaḥ netṛtvaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
KRITTIKA.phala: Kṛttikā — tīkṣṇakāryasya, agnikarmaṇaḥ, sāhasasya ca nakṣatram.
KRITTIKA.phalaProse: Kṛttikā agnidevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ tīkṣṇamiśranakṣatram. Agnisambandhakarma, tīkṣṇasāhasakāryam, śatrunāśaḥ, chedanādikarma ca yogyam. Tejaḥpradaṃ kintu ugraphalam.

MAGHA.namakaranaProse: Maghānakṣatre (pitṛdevatā, ketusvāmī) jātaḥ pratiṣṭhāpriyaḥ, paramparāniṣṭhaḥ, netṛtvaguṇī, gauravaśīlaśca. Nāmakaraṇe gauravaṃ paramparāṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
MAGHA.phalaProse: Maghā pitṛdevatādhiṣṭhitam ugranakṣatram. Pitṛtarpaṇam, rājasambandhakarma, paramparāgatakāryam, ugrasādhyakāryaṃ ca yogyam; saumyamaṅgale tu nyūnapraśastam.

MRIGASHIRA.namakaranaProse: Mṛgaśirānakṣatre (somadevatā, bhaumasvāmī) jātaḥ jijñāsuḥ, saumyaḥ, anveṣaṇapriyaḥ, capalaśca. Nāmakaraṇe jijñāsāṃ saumyatāṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
MRIGASHIRA.phala: Mṛgaśirā — yātrāyāḥ, kalāyāḥ, saumyakāryasya ca mṛdunakṣatram.
MRIGASHIRA.phalaProse: Mṛgaśirā somacandrādhiṣṭhitaṃ mṛdumaitranakṣatram. Yātrā, kalākarma, saṅgītam, vastrābhūṣaṇakrayaḥ, mitramelanaṃ ca praśastam. Saumyaphalaṃ capalaṃ ca.

MULA.namakaranaProse: Mūlanakṣatre (nirṛtidevatā, ketusvāmī) jātaḥ anveṣakaḥ, mūlagāmī, dṛḍhasaṅkalpaḥ, tattvānveṣī ca. Nāmakaraṇe gahanatāṃ anveṣaṇaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
MULA.phala: Mūla — mūlavicchedasya, auṣadhasya, tīkṣṇakarmaṇaśca nakṣatram; śubhamaṅgale varjyam.
MULA.phalaProse: Mūla nirṛtidevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ tīkṣṇadāruṇanakṣatram. Mūlocchedaḥ, auṣadhakarma, mantrasādhanā, tīkṣṇakāryaṃ ca yogyam; kintu vivāhādiśubhamaṅgale varjyam.

PUNARVASU.namakaranaProse: Punarvasunakṣatre (aditidevatā, gurusvāmī) jātaḥ āśāvādī, udāraḥ, dharmaniṣṭhaḥ, punarutthānaśīlaśca. Nāmakaraṇe udāratāṃ dharmaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
PUNARVASU.phala: Punarvasu — yātrāyāḥ, punarārambhasya, saumyakāryasya ca caranakṣatram.
PUNARVASU.phalaProse: Punarvasu aditidevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ caracalanakṣatram. Yātrā, punarārambhaḥ, gṛhagamanam, saumyamaṅgalakāryaṃ ca praśastam. Śubhaṃ capalaṃ ca; sthirakārye nyūnaphalam.

PURVA_ASHADHA.namakaranaProse: Pūrvāṣāḍhānakṣatre (āpodevatā, śukrasvāmī) jātaḥ ajeyabhāvaḥ, utsāhī, prabhāvaśālī, dṛḍhamatiśca. Nāmakaraṇe vijayaṃ utsāhaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
PURVA_ASHADHA.phala: Pūrvāṣāḍhā — jalakarmaṇaḥ, vijayasya, sāhasasya ca ugranakṣatram.
PURVA_ASHADHA.phalaProse: Pūrvāṣāḍhā āpjaladevatādhiṣṭhitam ugranakṣatram. Jalasambandhakarma, vijayayātrā, sāhasakarma, naukākāryaṃ ca yogyam. Aparājayapradam; saumyamaṅgale nyūnapraśastam.

PURVA_BHADRAPADA.namakaranaProse: Pūrvābhādrapadānakṣatre (ajaikapāddevatā, gurusvāmī) jātaḥ ādhyātmikaḥ, gambhīraḥ, tejasvī, dārśanikaśca. Nāmakaraṇe ādhyātmikatāṃ gāmbhīryaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
PURVA_BHADRAPADA.phala: Pūrvabhādrapadā — tīvrakarmaṇaḥ, tapasaḥ ca ugranakṣatram; śubhamaṅgale varjyam.
PURVA_BHADRAPADA.phalaProse: Pūrvabhādrapadā ajaikapāddevatādhiṣṭhitam ugradāruṇanakṣatram. Tapaḥ, tīvrasādhanā, ugrakarma ca yogyam; kintu vivāhādisaumyamaṅgale varjyam.

PURVA_PHALGUNI.namakaranaProse: Pūrvāphālgunīnakṣatre (bhagadevatā, śukrasvāmī) jātaḥ rasikaḥ, udāraḥ, kalāpriyaḥ, sukhapriyaśca. Nāmakaraṇe rasikatāṃ kalāṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
PURVA_PHALGUNI.phala: Pūrvaphālgunī — vivāhasya, premṇaḥ, sukhabhogasya ca ugranakṣatram.
PURVA_PHALGUNI.phalaProse: Pūrvaphālgunī bhagadevatādhiṣṭhitam ugranakṣatram. Vivāhasambandhaḥ, premakāryam, kalāsukhabhogaḥ, sandhivārtā ca yogyam. Ānandapradam; ugrasañjñe'pi maṅgale praśastam.

PUSHYA.namakaranaProse: Puṣyanakṣatre (bṛhaspatidevatā, śanisvāmī) jātaḥ poṣakaḥ, dharmaniṣṭhaḥ, sthiraḥ, sevābhāvī ca. Nāmakaraṇe poṣaṇaṃ sthairyaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam (puṣyaḥ śubhatamanakṣatreṣu ekaḥ).
PUSHYA.phala: Puṣya — sarvaśubhakāryasya paramaśreṣṭhaṃ nakṣatram; vivāhe tu varjyam.
PUSHYA.phalaProse: Puṣya bṛhaspatidevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ kṣipralaghu paramaśubhanakṣatram. Sarvamaṅgalakāryam, dhanasañcayaḥ, auṣadham, rājyābhiṣekaḥ ca praśastam; kintu śāstravacanāt vivāhe varjyam.

REVATI.namakaranaProse: Revatīnakṣatre (pūṣandevatā, budhasvāmī) jātaḥ poṣakaḥ, dayāluḥ, samṛddhipradaḥ, mārgadarśakaśca. Nāmakaraṇe poṣaṇaṃ dayāṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam (revatī śubhāntanakṣatram).
REVATI.phala: Revatī — yātrāyāḥ, poṣaṇasya, sarvaśubhasya ca mṛdunakṣatram.
REVATI.phalaProse: Revatī pūṣandevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ mṛdumaitranakṣatram. Yātrā, poṣaṇakarma, vāṇijyam, sarvamaṅgalakāryaṃ ca praśastam. Saumyaphalaṃ rakṣāpradaṃ ca.

ROHINI.namakaranaProse: Rohiṇīnakṣatre (brahmādevatā, candrasvāmī) jātaḥ ākarṣakaḥ, sṛjanaśīlaḥ, kalāpriyaḥ, samṛddhipriyaśca. Nāmakaraṇe saundaryaṃ sṛjanaśīlatāṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
ROHINI.phala: Rohiṇī — sthirakāryasya, kṛṣeḥ, gṛhārambhasya ca paramaśubhanakṣatram.
ROHINI.phalaProse: Rohiṇī brahmādhiṣṭhitaṃ dhruvasthiranakṣatram. Gṛhārambhaḥ, kṛṣiḥ, sthāvarasampatkrayaḥ, vṛkṣāropaṇam, sarvaśubhamaṅgalaṃ ca paramapraśastam. Sthiraphalaṃ samṛddhipradaṃ ca.

SHATABHISHA.namakaranaProse: Śatabhiṣānakṣatre (varuṇadevatā, rāhusvāmī) jātaḥ rahasyānveṣī, svatantraḥ, cikitsāpriyaḥ, gahanacintakaśca. Nāmakaraṇe rahasyabodhaṃ svātantryaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
SHATABHISHA.phalaProse: Śatabhiṣā varuṇadevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ caracalanakṣatram. Auṣadhakarma, mantrasādhanā, guptakāryam, jalakarma ca yogyam. Ārogyapradaṃ kintu ekāntapriyaṃ ca.

SHRAVANA.namakaranaProse: Śravaṇanakṣatre (viṣṇudevatā, candrasvāmī) jātaḥ śrotā, vidyāpriyaḥ, susaṃskṛtaḥ, saṃvādakuśalaśca. Nāmakaraṇe vidyāṃ śravaṇaśīlatāṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
SHRAVANA.phala: Śravaṇa — śravaṇavidyāyāḥ, yātrāyāḥ, dharmasya ca caranakṣatram.
SHRAVANA.phalaProse: Śravaṇa viṣṇudevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ caracalanakṣatram. Śāstraśravaṇam, vidyā, yātrā, dharmakarma, saṅgītaṃ ca praśastam. Jñānapradaṃ śubhaṃ ca.

SWATI.namakaranaProse: Svātīnakṣatre (vāyudevatā, rāhusvāmī) jātaḥ svatantraḥ, santulitaḥ, vyavahārakuśalaḥ, gatiśīlaśca. Nāmakaraṇe svātantryaṃ santulanaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
SWATI.phala: Svātī — vāṇijyasya, yātrāyāḥ, svatantrakāryasya ca caranakṣatram.
SWATI.phalaProse: Svātī vāyudevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ caracalanakṣatram. Vāṇijyam, yātrā, vāhanakarma, svatantravyavahāraḥ ca praśastam. Capalaṃ śubhaṃ ca; sthirakārye nyūnaphalam.

UTTARA_ASHADHA.namakaranaProse: Uttarāṣāḍhānakṣatre (viśvedevadevatā, sūryasvāmī) jātaḥ dharmaniṣṭhaḥ, sthiraḥ, vijayī, siddhāntapriyaśca. Nāmakaraṇe dharmaṃ sthairyaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
UTTARA_ASHADHA.phalaProse: Uttarāṣāḍhā viśvedevādhiṣṭhitaṃ dhruvasthiranakṣatram. Sthiravijayaḥ, dharmakarma, gṛhārambhaḥ, dīrghakālikasaṅkalpaśca paramapraśastam. Sthiraphalaṃ aparājayaṃ ca.

UTTARA_BHADRAPADA.namakaranaProse: Uttarābhādrapadānakṣatre (ahirbudhnyadevatā, śanisvāmī) jātaḥ śāntaḥ, jñānī, dānaśīlaḥ, gambhīraśca. Nāmakaraṇe śāntiṃ jñānaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
UTTARA_BHADRAPADA.phalaProse: Uttarabhādrapadā ahirbudhnyadevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ dhruvasthiranakṣatram. Sthirakāryam, gṛhārambhaḥ, gambhīrasaṅkalpaḥ, dharmakarma ca praśastam. Sthiraphalaṃ śāntaṃ ca.

UTTARA_PHALGUNI.namakaranaProse: Uttarāphālgunīnakṣatre (aryamādevatā, sūryasvāmī) jātaḥ sevābhāvī, viśvasanīyaḥ, sthiraḥ, sahayogapriyaśca. Nāmakaraṇe viśvāsaṃ sevāṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
UTTARA_PHALGUNI.phalaProse: Uttaraphālgunī aryamadevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ dhruvasthiranakṣatram. Vivāhaḥ, gṛhārambhaḥ, sthirasambandhaḥ, dīrghakālikakarma ca paramapraśastam. Sthiraphalaṃ śubhaṃ ca.

VISHAKHA.namakaranaProse: Viśākhānakṣatre (indrāgnidevatā, gurusvāmī) jātaḥ lakṣyaniṣṭhaḥ, mahattvākāṅkṣī, dṛḍhasaṅkalpaḥ, udyamī ca. Nāmakaraṇe lakṣyaniṣṭhāṃ utsāhaṃ ca sūcayan nāma praśastam.
VISHAKHA.phalaProse: Viśākhā indrāgnidevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ miśrasādhāraṇanakṣatram. Saṅkalpapūrtiḥ, spardhā, lakṣyasādhanam, dhanakarma ca yogyam; ārambhe mandam ante siddhipradam.

COMBUST.phalaProse: Yadā graho divākarasamīpe varttate tadā sa ravikiraṇairācchāditaḥ astaṅgato (dagdho) jāyate. Eṣa nijatejasā vihīnaḥ san svakīyakārakatvaphalaṃ pradātuṃ na śaknoti, mandaṃ kleśapradaṃ vā phalaṃ vitarati.

RETROGRADE.phala: Vakrī grahaḥ ceṣṭābalayuktaḥ san tīvram antarmukhaṃ ca phalaṃ dadāti.
RETROGRADE.phalaProse: Vakrī (vakragatiḥ) graho vilakṣaṇagatyā vilomaṃ gacchan pratīyate. Eṣa ceṣṭābalena samanvitaḥ san jātakasya jīvane tīvram, akasmāt, pūrvakarmasambaddhaṃ (prārabdhamūlakaṃ) phalaṃ vitarati. Śubhagrahāṇāṃ vakratvaṃ maṅgalakaraṃ pāpagrahāṇāṃ ca krūraṃ bhavati.

VARGOTTAMA.phala: Vargottamaḥ grahaḥ svoccatulyabalavān sthiratamaṃ śubhaphalaṃ ca dadāti.
VARGOTTAMA.phalaProse: Yadā graho janmakuṇḍalyāṃ (D1) navāṃśakuṇḍalyāṃ (D9) ca ekasminneva rāśau tiṣṭhati tadā sa vargottamaḥ kathyate. Eṣa grahasya śaktiṃ dṛḍhatāṃ ca atīva vardhayati, tasya śubhaphalaṃ śāśvataprāyaṃ bhavati.

DEBILITATED.phala: Nīcasthaḥ grahaḥ sarvathā nirbalaḥ mandaṃ vikṛtaṃ vā phalaṃ dadāti.
DEBILITATED.phalaProse: Svakīyanīcarāśisthitaḥ grahaḥ cetanāhīnaḥ balahīnaśca bhavati. Tasya kārakāṇi vikṛtarūpeṇa nyūnātinyūnena vā phalībhavanti, yadi nīcabhaṅgarājayogo na ghaṭeta.

EXALTED.phala: Uccasthaḥ grahaḥ pūrṇabalayuktaḥ san rājyasukhaṃ sarvottamaphalaṃ ca dadāti.
EXALTED.phalaProse: Nijaparamoccarāśisthitaḥ grahaḥ paramabalavān gauravayuktaśca bhavati. Eṣaḥ svakārakatvasya bhāvagatasya ca phalasya sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ, śubhatamaṃ, rājyamānayuktaṃ ca pariṇāmaṃ sādhayati.

MOOLTRIKONA.phala: Mūlatrikoṇasthaḥ grahaḥ atīva ūrjāyuktaḥ kāryasādhakaśca bhavati.
MOOLTRIKONA.phalaProse: Svakīyamūlatrikoṇe vartamānaḥ grahaḥ atīva ūrjāyuktaḥ kriyāśīlaśca bhavati. Eṣaḥ uccasadṛśaphalaṃ dadāti, jātakasya jīvanoddeśyaṃ saphalīkartuṃ sāhāyyaṃ karoti.

OWN_SIGN.phala: Svarāśisthaḥ grahaḥ sudṛḍhaḥ niścitaṃ sukhaṃ kalyāṇaṃ ca karoti.
OWN_SIGN.phalaProse: Svagṛhe niścintaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ grahaḥ svātmaviśvāsayukto bhavati. Eṣaḥ svakārakatvasya bhāvasya ca sthiraṃ, nirbādhaṃ, sukhamayaṃ ca phalaṃ jātakasya jīvane prakaṭīkaroti.

GHATI_LAGNA.phala: Ghaṭīlagnaṃ sattāyāḥ, adhikārasya, padapratiṣṭhāyāśca dyotakam bhavati.
GHATI_LAGNA.phalaProse: Ghaṭīlagnaṃ jātakasya sattāyāḥ, śāsanakṣamatāyāḥ, adhikārasya, samāje uccapadapratiṣṭhāyāśca vicāre prayujyate. Etallagnaṃ tīvronnatiṃ rājakīyasaphalatāñca sūcayati.

HORA_LAGNA.phalaProse: Horālagnaṃ jātakasya jīvanasya dhanasampatteḥ, ārthikapravāhasya, ājīvikāyāḥ, bhautikasampadāñca vicāre prayujyate. Asya balaṃ grahāṇāṃ sambandhaśca vipulaṃ dhanaiśvaryaṃ sūcayati.

PRANAPADA_LAGNA.phalaProse: Prāṇapadalagnaṃ jātakasya dehasya prāṇaśakteḥ, ārogyasya, śārīrikadṛḍhatāyāḥ, jīvanorjāyāśca vicāre prayujyate. Asya śubhatvaṃ dīrghāyuṣyaṃ susvāsthyañca sūcayati.

SREE_LAGNA.phala: Śrīlagnaṃ saubhāgyasya, devyāḥ lakṣmyāḥ anugrahasya, dāmpatyasukhasya ca sūcakam.
SREE_LAGNA.phalaProse: Śrīlagnaṃ jātakasya jīvanasya pracurasaubhāgyasya, devyāḥ mahālakṣmyāḥ sākṣātkṛpāyāḥ, dāmpatyasukhasya, aiśvaryasya ca sūcakam. Asya śubhatvaṃ vaivāhikasaukhyaṃ śriyañca dadāti.

VARNADA_LAGNA.phalaProse: Varṇadalagnaṃ jātakasya samāje sthānasya, varṇasya (dhārmika-vyāvasāyikabhūmikāyāḥ), sārvajanikacaritrasya, kartavyaniṣṭhāyāśca sūcakam. Asya balaṃ samāje samādaraṃ sūcayati.

AGNI.phala: Agnitattvaṃ tejaḥ utsāhaṃ netṛtvaṃ ca sūcayati.
AGNI.phalaProse: Agnitattve sapta nakṣatrāṇi (maghā, pūrvāphālgunī, uttarāphālgunī, hasta, citrā, svāti, viśākhā ca). Agnitattvapradhānaḥ tejasvī, utsāhī, spaṣṭavaktā netṛtvaguṇayuktaśca bhavati. Śīghrakopī kintu kriyāśīlaḥ, sāhasī, sattvaśīlaḥ nirbhīkaśca; pācanaśaktiḥ ojaśca prabalau. Pañcatattvamelane agni-vāyuyoḥ sakhyam (agnirvāyunā vardhate), agni-jalayostu virodhaḥ.

AKASHA.phala: Ākāśatattvaṃ ādhyātmikatāṃ viśālatāṃ anāsaktiṃ ca sūcayati.
AKASHA.phalaProse: Ākāśatattve pañca nakṣatrāṇi (dhaniṣṭhā, śatabhiṣā, pūrvābhādrapadā, uttarābhādrapadā, revatī ca). Ākāśatattvapradhānaḥ ādhyātmikaḥ, viśālacittaḥ, anāsaktaḥ, dārśanikaḥ sūkṣmacintakaśca bhavati. Udāradṛṣṭiḥ, svātantryapriyaḥ, gūḍhavidyānurāgī, kintu kadācit vyavahāre udāsīnaḥ. Ākāśaṃ sarvavyāpakaṃ nirākāraṃ ca; anena jātakaḥ sīmātītaṃ cintanaṃ mokṣābhimukhatāṃ ca prakaṭayati.

JALA.phala: Jalatattvaṃ bhāvukatāṃ antaḥprajñāṃ poṣakaṃ ca sūcayati.
JALA.phalaProse: Jalatattvapradhānaḥ bhāvukaḥ, antaḥprajñaḥ, anukūlanaśīlaḥ, poṣakaḥ sarasacittaśca bhavati. Saṃvedanaśīlaḥ, snehaśīlaḥ, smṛtimān, kalpanāpriyaśca; jalavat paristhityanurūpaṃ svarūpaṃ dhārayati. Kaphaprakṛtyā (antyanāḍīgaṇena) sambaddhā jalīyatā śāntiṃ sthiratāṃ poṣaṇaṃ ca sūcayati. Pañcatattvamelane jala-pṛthivyoḥ sakhyam, jala-agnyostu virodhaḥ.

PRITHVI.phala: Pṛthvītattvaṃ sthairyaṃ dhairyaṃ vyāvahārikatāṃ ca sūcayati.
PRITHVI.phalaProse: Pṛthvītattve nava nakṣatrāṇi (aśvinī, bharaṇī, kṛttikā, rohiṇī, mṛgaśirā, ārdrā, punarvasu, puṣya, āśleṣā ca). Pṛthvītattvapradhānaḥ sthiraḥ, dhairyavān, vyāvahārikaḥ, bhautikaniṣṭhaḥ, pariśramī viśvasanīyaśca bhavati. Sahanaśīlaḥ saṅgrahaśīlaḥ dīrghadarśī ca; āpatsu api avicalaḥ. Pañcatattvamelane pṛthvī-jalayoḥ sakhyam (jalena bhūmiḥ sarasā bhavati), pṛthvī-vāyuyostu alpavirodhaḥ.

VAYU.phala: Vāyutattvaṃ buddhiṃ cāñcalyaṃ sambhāṣaṇakuśalatāṃ ca sūcayati.
VAYU.phalaProse: Vāyutattve ṣaṭ nakṣatrāṇi (anurādhā, jyeṣṭhā, mūlā, pūrvāṣāḍhā, uttarāṣāḍhā, śravaṇa ca). Vāyutattvapradhānaḥ buddhimān, cañcalaḥ, sambhāṣaṇakuśalaḥ, parivartanaśīlaḥ jijñāsuśca bhavati. Nityaṃ nūtanavicārayuktaḥ, gatiśīlaḥ, samparkapriyaḥ, kintu kadācit asthiracittaḥ. Pañcatattvamelane vāyu-agnyoḥ sakhyam, vāyu-pṛthivyostu alpavirodhaḥ.

AMAVASYA.phala: Amāvāsyā — pitṛkarmaṇaḥ, tarpaṇasya, śubhārambhavarjanasya ca tithiḥ.
AMAVASYA.phalaProse: Amāvāsyā pitṛdevatādhiṣṭhitā tithiḥ. Pitṛtarpaṇam, śrāddham, dānam, śāntikarma ca praśastam; kintu candrābhāvāt navamaṅgalārambhaḥ varjyaḥ. Adhyātmacintanāya hitā.

KRISHNA_ASHTAMI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī kālabhairavadevatādhiṣṭhitā jayātithiḥ. Śaktyupāsanā, kālabhairavapūjā, sāhasakarma ca yogyam. Balapradā kintu ugraphalā.

KRISHNA_CHATURDASHI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśī rudrakālīdevatādhiṣṭhitā riktātithiḥ. Māsaśivarātriḥ, rudrakālīpūjā, ugrakarma ca yogyam; riktāsañjñatvāt navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ.

KRISHNA_CHATURTHI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣacaturthī gaṇeśadevatādhiṣṭhitā riktātithiḥ. Saṅkaṣṭīgaṇeśapūjā, vighnanāśasaṅkalpaśca praśastam; riktāsañjñatvāt navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ.

KRISHNA_DASHAMI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣadaśamī dharmarājadevatādhiṣṭhitā pūrṇātithiḥ. Dharmakarma, saumyavyavahāraḥ, nityaśubhakāryaṃ ca yogyam. Sāmānyaśubhā śāntaphalā ca.

KRISHNA_DVITIYA.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣadvitīyā brahmadevatādhiṣṭhitā bhadrātithiḥ. Sthirakāryam, maitrīsambandhaḥ, saumyavyavahāraśca yogyam. Śāntaphalā sāmānyaśubhā ca.

KRISHNA_DWADASHI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣadvādaśī viṣṇudevatādhiṣṭhitā bhadrātithiḥ. Vratapāraṇam, dānam, viṣṇusevā ca yogyam. Saumyā puṇyavṛddhikarī ca.

KRISHNA_EKADASHI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣaikādaśī viṣṇudevatādhiṣṭhitā nandātithiḥ. Upavāsaḥ, viṣṇupūjā, vratam, dharmakarma ca praśastam. Puṇyapradā ādhyātmikasiddhikarī ca.

KRISHNA_NAVAMI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣanavamī durgādevatādhiṣṭhitā riktātithiḥ. Devīpūjā, ugrakarma ca yogyam; riktāsañjñatvāt navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ. Sāvadhānaphalā.

KRISHNA_PANCHAMI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣapañcamī nāgadevatādhiṣṭhitā pūrṇātithiḥ. Dhanavyavahāraḥ, auṣadhasevanam, nāgapūjā ca yogyam. Sāmānyaśubhā sthiraphalā ca.

KRISHNA_PRATIPADA.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣapratipadā agnidevatādhiṣṭhitā nandātithiḥ. Saumyakāryam, nityakarma ca yogyam; kṣīyamāṇacandratvāt dīrghavṛddhikārye nyūnaphalam. Sāmānyaśubhā.

KRISHNA_SAPTAMI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣasaptamī sūryadevatādhiṣṭhitā bhadrātithiḥ. Yātrā, ārogyakarma, sūryopāsanā ca yogyam. Sāmānyaśubhā tejaḥpradā ca.

KRISHNA_SHASHTHI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣaṣaṣṭhī kārtikeyadevatādhiṣṭhitā nandātithiḥ. Śauryakarma, spardhā, balaprayogakāryaṃ ca yogyam. Utsāhapradā sāmānyaśubhā ca.

KRISHNA_TRAYODASHI.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣatrayodaśī kāmadevaśivadevatādhiṣṭhitā jayātithiḥ. Pradoṣavratam, śivapūjā, maitrīkarma ca praśastam. Vijayapradā saumyā ca.

KRISHNA_TRITIYA.phalaProse: Kṛṣṇapakṣatṛtīyā gaurīdevatādhiṣṭhitā jayātithiḥ. Sāhasakarma, spardhā, vivādanirākaraṇaṃ ca yogyam. Vijayapradā kintu kṣīṇapakṣatvāt mandaphalā.

PURNIMA.phala: Pūrṇimā — pūrṇacandrasya, satyanārāyaṇapūjāyāḥ, sarvaśubhasya ca pūrṇātithiḥ.
PURNIMA.phalaProse: Pūrṇimā candradevatādhiṣṭhitā pūrṇātithiḥ. Pūrṇacandrabalāt sarvaśubhakāryam, satyanārāyaṇavratam, dānam, maṅgalakarma ca praśastam. Paramaśubhā sampūrṇaphaladā ca.

SHUKLA_ASHTAMI.phala: Śuklāṣṭamī — śakteḥ, durgāpūjāyāḥ, dṛḍhakāryasya ca jayātithiḥ.
SHUKLA_ASHTAMI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣāṣṭamī durgādevatādhiṣṭhitā jayātithiḥ. Śaktyupāsanā, durgāpūjā, sāhasakarma, śastrasambandhakāryaṃ ca praśastam. Vijayapradā balapradā ca.

SHUKLA_CHATURDASHI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣacaturdaśī rudraśivadevatādhiṣṭhitā riktātithiḥ. Rudropāsanā, ugrakarma ca praśastam; kintu riktāsañjñatvāt navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ.

SHUKLA_CHATURTHI.phala: Śuklacaturthī — vighnaharaṇasya, gaṇeśapūjāyāḥ, riktakāryavarjanasya ca tithiḥ.
SHUKLA_CHATURTHI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣacaturthī gaṇeśadevatādhiṣṭhitā riktātithiḥ. Gaṇeśārādhanā vighnanāśaśca praśastam; kintu riktāsañjñatvāt navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ. Vighnaharaṇasaṅkalpāya hitā.

SHUKLA_DASHAMI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣadaśamī dharmarājadevatādhiṣṭhitā pūrṇātithiḥ. Dharmakāryam, vijayayātrā, sarvamaṅgalakarma ca praśastam. Saumyā sarvasiddhipradā ca.

SHUKLA_DVITIYA.phala: Śukladvitīyā — sthāpanāyāḥ, maitryāḥ, saumyakāryasya ca bhadrātithiḥ.
SHUKLA_DVITIYA.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣadvitīyā brahmadevatādhiṣṭhitā bhadrātithiḥ. Ādhārasthāpanam, maitrīsambandhaḥ, ābhūṣaṇakrayaḥ, saumyamaṅgalakāryaṃ ca śubham. Sthiraphalapradā śāntā ca.

SHUKLA_DWADASHI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣadvādaśī viṣṇudevatādhiṣṭhitā bhadrātithiḥ. Vratapāraṇam, dānam, viṣṇusevā, śubhamaṅgalakāryaṃ ca praśastam. Saumyā puṇyavṛddhikarī ca.

SHUKLA_EKADASHI.phala: Śuklaikādaśī — upavāsasya, viṣṇubhakteḥ, dharmakāryasya ca nandātithiḥ.
SHUKLA_EKADASHI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣaikādaśī viṣṇudevatādhiṣṭhitā nandātithiḥ. Upavāsaḥ, viṣṇupūjā, vratam, dharmakāryaṃ ca praśastam. Ādhyātmikasiddhipradā puṇyapradā ca.

SHUKLA_NAVAMI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣanavamī ambikādevatādhiṣṭhitā riktātithiḥ. Devīpūjā, ugrasāhasakarma ca praśastam; kintu riktāsañjñatvāt vivāhādinavaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ.

SHUKLA_PANCHAMI.phala: Śuklapañcamī — vidyāyāḥ, dhanasya, auṣadhasya ca pūrṇātithiḥ.
SHUKLA_PANCHAMI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣapañcamī nāgasarpadevatādhiṣṭhitā pūrṇātithiḥ. Vidyārambhaḥ, dhanasañcayaḥ, auṣadhasevanam, sarasvatīpūjā ca praśastam. Samṛddhipradā śubhā ca.

SHUKLA_PRATIPADA.phala: Śuklapratipadā — navavārambhasya, vṛddheḥ, maṅgalasaṅkalpasya ca tithiḥ.
SHUKLA_PRATIPADA.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣapratipadā agnidevatādhiṣṭhitā nandātithiḥ. Navakāryārambhaḥ, saṅkalpaḥ, gṛhapraveśaḥ, śubhamaṅgalaṃ ca praśastam. Vardhamānacandrabalāt kāryavṛddhiḥ śubhā.

SHUKLA_SAPTAMI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣasaptamī sūryadevatādhiṣṭhitā bhadrātithiḥ. Yātrā, ārogyakarma, sūryopāsanā, vāhanakrayaśca praśastam. Tejaḥpradā sarvaśubhakāryayogyā ca.

SHUKLA_SHASHTHI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣaṣaṣṭhī kārtikeyadevatādhiṣṭhitā nandātithiḥ. Śauryakāryam, spardhā, rājasambandhakarma, santānārthapūjā ca praśastam. Utsāhapradā śubhā ca.

SHUKLA_TRAYODASHI.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣatrayodaśī kāmadevaśivadevatādhiṣṭhitā jayātithiḥ. Premakāryam, saundaryavardhanam, śivapūjā, mitramelanaṃ ca praśastam. Ākarṣaṇasiddhipradā śubhā ca.

SHUKLA_TRITIYA.phala: Śuklatṛtīyā — vijayasya, maṅgalakāryasya, gṛhārambhasya ca jayātithiḥ.
SHUKLA_TRITIYA.phalaProse: Śuklapakṣatṛtīyā gaurīdevatādhiṣṭhitā jayātithiḥ. Akṣayatṛtīyāsadṛśī atiśubhā; vivāhaḥ, gṛhārambhaḥ, svarṇakrayaḥ, sarvamaṅgalakāryaṃ ca praśastam. Vijayapradā.

BUDHAVARA.phala: Budhavāraḥ budhādhiṣṭhitaḥ — buddheḥ, vāṇijyasya, vidyāyāśca dinam.
BUDHAVARA.phalaProse: Budhavāsaraḥ budhasya vāsaraḥ. Asmin dine buddhiḥ, sañcāraḥ, lekhanam, vāṇijyam, vidyābhyāsaśca praśastam. Sandhivārtā, gaṇitakarma, sandeśapreṣaṇaṃ ca siddhyanti. Divā medhākārye saphalatā; rātrau adhyayanaṃ mananaṃ ca hitakaram.

GURUVARA.phala: Guruvāraḥ bṛhaspatyadhiṣṭhitaḥ — jñānasya, dharmasya, maṅgalakāryasya ca dinam.
GURUVARA.phalaProse: Guruvāsaraḥ bṛhaspateḥ vāsaraḥ. Asmin dine jñānam, dharmaḥ, gurusevā, śubhamaṅgalakāryaṃ ca praśastam. Śikṣaṇam, yātrā, dhanasañcayaḥ, vivāhādimaṅgalaṃ ca siddhyanti. Divā śubhakarma phalapradam; rātrau prārthanā adhyayanaṃ ca hitakaram.

MANGALAVARA.phala: Maṅgalavāraḥ kujādhiṣṭhitaḥ — śauryasya, ūrjāyāḥ, vivādasya ca dinam.
MANGALAVARA.phalaProse: Maṅgalavāsaraḥ kujasya vāsaraḥ. Asmin dine śauryam, sāhasam, bhūmisambandhakarma, śastrakāryaṃ ca prabalam. Ṛṇamocanam, spardhā, vīrakarma ca siddhyanti; kintu krodhaḥ kalahaśca varjyaḥ. Divā udyamaḥ phalapradaḥ; rātrau saṃyamaḥ śāntiśca hitakaraḥ.

RAVIVARA.phala: Ravivāraḥ sūryādhiṣṭhitaḥ — tejasaḥ, netṛtvasya, ārogyasya ca dinam.
RAVIVARA.phalaProse: Ravivāsaraḥ sūryasya vāsaraḥ. Asmin dine ātmaviśvāsaḥ, netṛtvam, rājakāryam, pitṛsambandhakāryaṃ ca śubham. Ārogyacintā, devapūjā, uccapadābhigamanaṃ ca praśastam. Divā karma tejasvi; rātrau viśrāmaḥ śāntiśca hitaḥ.

SHANIVARA.phala: Śanivāraḥ śanyadhiṣṭhitaḥ — śramasya, dhairyasya, kaṭhinakāryasya ca dinam.
SHANIVARA.phalaProse: Śanivāsaraḥ śaneḥ vāsaraḥ. Asmin dine śramaḥ, dhairyam, sevākarma, kaṭhinapariśramaśca praśastam. Lohakāryam, sthirasampattiḥ, dīrghakālikakarma ca siddhyanti. Hanumatśanipūjā hitakarī. Divā pariśramaḥ phalapradaḥ; rātrau saṃyamaḥ śāntiśca hitaḥ.

SHUKRAVARA.phala: Śukravāraḥ śukrādhiṣṭhitaḥ — premṇaḥ, kalāyāḥ, sukhabhogasya ca dinam.
SHUKRAVARA.phalaProse: Śukravāsaraḥ śukrasya vāsaraḥ. Asmin dine prema, kalā, saṅgītam, saundaryam, sukhabhogaśca prabalam. Vivāhasambandhaḥ, alaṅkārakrayaḥ, vastrābharaṇaṃ ca śubham. Divā kalāsukhakarma phalapradam; rātrau rasarañjanaṃ prītiśca sukhadā.

SOMAVARA.phala: Somavāraḥ candrādhiṣṭhitaḥ — manasaḥ, jalasya, mātṛsambandhasya ca dinam.
SOMAVARA.phalaProse: Somavāsaraḥ candrasya vāsaraḥ. Asmin dine manaḥ saumyaṃ bhāvukaṃ ca; mātṛkāryam, jalasambandhakarma, gṛhakāryaṃ ca śubham. Śivārādhanā praśastā. Divā komalakāryeṣu siddhiḥ; rātrau candrabalāt śāntiḥ nidrā ca sukhadā.

BRAHMIN.phalaProse: Brāhmaṇavarṇe catvāri nakṣatrāṇi (kṛttikā, pūrvāphālgunī, pūrvāṣāḍhā, pūrvābhādrapadā ca) antarbhavanti. Varṇaḥ sāmājikabhedaṃ na sūcayati, api tu jātasya sahajāṃ mānasavṛttimeva; brāhmaṇavarṇajātasya cittaṃ sāttvikaṃ, jñānapriyaṃ, vidyānurāgi, cintanaśīlaṃ ca bhavati. Ete adhyayanādhyāpane, jñānaśodhane, parāmarśane dharmakarmaṇi ca svābhāvikīṃ pratibhāṃ dhārayanti. Varṇakūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye ekāṅkena ahaṅkārakarmavṛttimelanavicārakam) varasya varṇaḥ kanyāvarṇāt samaḥ adhiko vā śreyān; nyūne varṇadoṣaḥ.

KSHATRIYA.phala: Kṣatriyavarṇaḥ śauryaṃ netṛtvaṃ adhikāraṃ ca sūcayati.
KSHATRIYA.phalaProse: Kṣatriyavarṇe ṣaṭ nakṣatrāṇi (puṣya, uttarāphālgunī, citrā, mūlā, uttarāṣāḍhā, uttarābhādrapadā ca) antarbhavanti. Varṇaḥ sahajāṃ mānasavṛttimeva sūcayati; kṣatriyavarṇajātasya cittaṃ rājasaṃ, śauryayuktaṃ, netṛtvapriyaṃ tejasvi ca bhavati. Ete senāsañcālane, praśāsane, adhikārapade, pratirakṣaṇe sāhasakarmaṇi ca svābhāvikīṃ pratibhāṃ dhārayanti. Varṇakūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye ekāṅkena ahaṅkārakarmavṛttimelanavicārakam) varasya varṇaḥ kanyāvarṇāt samaḥ adhiko vā śreyān; nyūne varṇadoṣaḥ.

MLECCHA.phala: Mlecchavarṇaḥ caturvarṇabāhyaṃ svatantraṃ aparamparāgataṃ ca sūcayati.
MLECCHA.phalaProse: Mlecchavarṇe sapta nakṣatrāṇi (bharaṇī, ārdrā, āśleṣā, svāti, viśākhā, śravaṇa, śatabhiṣā ca) antarbhavanti. Mlecchaḥ brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrarūpāyāḥ caturvarṇavyavasthāyāḥ bāhyaḥ gaṇyate — svatantraḥ, aparamparāgataḥ, paradeśīyapravṛttiḥ sahajamuktacittaśca. Ete navīnakarmasu, aparipāṭivṛttau, paradeśasambaddhakārye svādhīnavyavasāye ca svābhāvikīṃ pratibhāṃ dhārayanti. Varṇakramabāhyatvāt varṇakūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye ekāṅke) sāmānyakramatulanā na pravartate; ayaṃ mānena grāhyaḥ, na tu hīnatayā.

SHUDRA.phala: Śūdravarṇaḥ sevāṃ śramaśīlatāṃ niṣṭhāṃ ca sūcayati.
SHUDRA.phalaProse: Śūdravarṇe pañca nakṣatrāṇi (rohiṇī, maghā, anurādhā, dhaniṣṭhā, revatī ca) antarbhavanti. Varṇaḥ sahajāṃ mānasavṛttimeva sūcayati; śūdravarṇajātasya cittaṃ sevāśīlaṃ, śramapriyaṃ, niṣṭhāvat bhūmisambaddhaṃ ca bhavati. Ete sevākarmaṇi, śilpakauśale, hastakarmaṇi, svāmibhaktau śramasādhyakārye ca svābhāvikīṃ pratibhāṃ dhārayanti. Varṇakūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye ekāṅkena ahaṅkārakarmavṛttimelanavicārakam) varasya varṇaḥ kanyāvarṇāt samaḥ adhiko vā śreyān; nyūne varṇadoṣaḥ.

VAISHYA.phala: Vaiśyavarṇaḥ vāṇijyaṃ vyāvahārikatāṃ samṛddhiṃ ca sūcayati.
VAISHYA.phalaProse: Vaiśyavarṇe pañca nakṣatrāṇi (aśvinī, mṛgaśirā, punarvasu, hasta, jyeṣṭhā ca) antarbhavanti. Varṇaḥ sahajāṃ mānasavṛttimeva sūcayati; vaiśyavarṇajātasya cittaṃ rājasaṃ kintu vyāvahārikaṃ, vāṇijyakuśalaṃ, samṛddhipriyaṃ prabandhanipuṇaṃ ca bhavati. Ete vyāpāre, vinimaye, arthaprabandhane, kṛṣivāṇijye udyame ca svābhāvikīṃ pratibhāṃ dhārayanti. Varṇakūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye ekāṅkena ahaṅkārakarmavṛttimelanavicārakam) varasya varṇaḥ kanyāvarṇāt samaḥ adhiko vā śreyān; nyūne varṇadoṣaḥ.

ATIGANDA.phala: Atigaṇḍayogaḥ — vighnasya, saṅkaṭasya ca aśubhayogaḥ; śubhārambhe varjyaḥ.
ATIGANDA.phalaProse: Atigaṇḍayogaḥ aśubhadāruṇasañjñakaḥ; saṅkaṭavighnasūcakaḥ. Navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ; śāntikarma, vighnaharaṇasaṅkalpaśca hitaḥ. Sāvadhānatā āvaśyakā.

AYUSHMAN.phala: Āyuṣmānyogaḥ — ārogyasya, dīrghāyuṣaḥ, sthirakāryasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
AYUSHMAN.phalaProse: Āyuṣmānyogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Ārogyakarma, āyurvardhanam, sthirakāryam, sarvamaṅgalaṃ ca praśastam. Dīrghaphalapradaḥ ārogyakaraśca.

BRAHMA.phala: Brahmayogaḥ — jñānasya, sṛjanasya, sarvaśubhasya ca paramaśubhayogaḥ.
BRAHMA.phalaProse: Brahmayogaḥ paramaśubhasañjñakaḥ. Jñānakarma, sṛjanātmakakāryam, gṛhārambhaḥ, sarvamaṅgalaṃ ca paramapraśastam. Śreṣṭhaphalapradaḥ atiśubhaśca.

DHRITI.phala: Dhṛtiyogaḥ — dhairyasya, sthiratāyā, santoṣasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
DHRITI.phalaProse: Dhṛtiyogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Dhairyakarma, sthirasaṅkalpaḥ, santoṣakāryam, sarvaśubhaṃ ca praśastam. Dhairyapradaḥ sthiraphalaśca.

DHRUVA.phala: Dhruvayogaḥ — sthairyasya, dṛḍhasaṅkalpasya, sthirakāryasya ca yogaḥ.
DHRUVA.phalaProse: Dhruvayogaḥ sthirasañjñakaḥ śubhayogaḥ. Sthirakāryam, gṛhārambhaḥ, sthāvarasampatkrayaḥ, dīrghakālikasaṅkalpaśca praśastam. Dṛḍhatā sthairyaṃ ca dadāti; capalakārye nyūnaphalam.

GANDA.phala: Gaṇḍayogaḥ — vighnasya, bādhāyāśca aśubhayogaḥ; śubhārambhe varjyaḥ.
GANDA.phalaProse: Gaṇḍayogaḥ aśubhasañjñakaḥ; vighnabādhāsūcakaḥ. Navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ; śāntikarma, vighnaharaṇasaṅkalpaśca hitaḥ. Sāvadhānatā āvaśyakā.

HARSHANA.phala: Harṣaṇayogaḥ — harṣasya, ānandasya, jñānakāryasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
HARSHANA.phalaProse: Harṣaṇayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Ānandakāryam, utsavaḥ, vidyā, sarvamaṅgalaṃ ca praśastam. Harṣapradaḥ śubhaśca.

INDRA.phala: Indrayogaḥ — aiśvaryasya, netṛtvasya, rājakāryasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
INDRA.phalaProse: Indrayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Aiśvaryakarma, netṛtvam, rājasambandhakāryam, sarvamaṅgalaṃ ca praśastam. Aiśvaryapradaḥ śubhaśca.

PARIGHA.phala: Parighayogaḥ — vighnasya, avarodhasya ca aśubhayogaḥ; śubhārambhe varjyaḥ.
PARIGHA.phalaProse: Parighayogaḥ aśubhasañjñakaḥ; avarodhavighnasūcakaḥ. Navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ; uttarārdhe nyūnadoṣaḥ. Śāntikarma hitam.

PRITI.phala: Prītiyogaḥ — snehasya, maitryāḥ, sukhakāryasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
PRITI.phalaProse: Prītiyogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Snehasambandhaḥ, maitrī, sukhakāryam, maṅgalakarma ca praśastam. Prītipradaḥ sarvaśubhakāryayogyaśca.

SADHYA.phala: Sādhyayogaḥ — sādhyakāryasya, siddheḥ, maṅgalasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
SADHYA.phalaProse: Sādhyayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Sādhyakāryasiddhiḥ, maṅgalakarma, sarvaśubhaṃ ca praśastam. Kāryasādhanapradaḥ śubhaśca.

SAUBHAGYA.phala: Saubhāgyayogaḥ — saubhāgyasya, samṛddheḥ, maṅgalakāryasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
SAUBHAGYA.phalaProse: Saubhāgyayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Vivāhaḥ, maṅgalakāryam, samṛddhikarma, sarvaśubhaṃ ca praśastam. Saubhāgyapradaḥ atiśubhaśca.

SHIVA.phala: Śivayogaḥ — kalyāṇasya, dharmasya, sarvaśubhasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
SHIVA.phalaProse: Śivayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Dharmakarma, kalyāṇakāryam, śivapūjā, sarvamaṅgalaṃ ca praśastam. Kalyāṇapradaḥ atiśubhaśca.

SHOBHANA.phala: Śobhanayogaḥ — saundaryasya, śobhanakāryasya, maṅgalasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
SHOBHANA.phalaProse: Śobhanayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Saundaryakarma, alaṅkāraḥ, śobhanamaṅgalakāryam, sarvaśubhaṃ ca praśastam. Kāntipradaḥ śubhaśca.

SHOOLA.phala: Śūlayogaḥ — vivādasya, pīḍāyāśca aśubhayogaḥ; śubhārambhe varjyaḥ.
SHOOLA.phalaProse: Śūlayogaḥ aśubhasañjñakaḥ; vivādapīḍāsūcakaḥ. Navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ; ugrakarmaṇi eva yogyaḥ. Śāntikarma hitam.

SHUBHA.phala: Śubhayogaḥ — maṅgalasya, kalyāṇasya, sarvaśubhakāryasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
SHUBHA.phalaProse: Śubhayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Sarvamaṅgalakāryam, śubhārambhaḥ, kalyāṇakarma ca praśastam. Śubhaphalapradaḥ sarvakāryayogyaśca.

SHUKLA.phala: Śuklayogaḥ — śuddhatāyā, saumyakāryasya, maṅgalasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
SHUKLA.phalaProse: Śuklayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Saumyamaṅgalakāryam, śuddhakarma, sarvaśubhaṃ ca praśastam. Saumyaphalapradaḥ śubhaśca.

SIDDHA.phala: Siddhayogaḥ — siddheḥ, saphalatāyā, sarvaśubhakāryasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
SIDDHA.phalaProse: Siddhayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Sarvakāryasiddhiḥ, maṅgalārambhaḥ, vidyākarma ca praśastam. Siddhipradaḥ śubhaśca.

SIDDHI.phala: Siddhiyogaḥ — kāryasiddheḥ, saphalatāyā, sarvaśubhasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
SIDDHI.phalaProse: Siddhiyogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Kāryārambhaḥ, siddhipradakarma, sarvamaṅgalaṃ ca paramapraśastam. Saphalatāpradaḥ atiśubhaśca.

SUKARMA.phala: Sukarmayogaḥ — satkarmaṇaḥ, puṇyakāryasya, sarvaśubhasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
SUKARMA.phalaProse: Sukarmayogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Satkarma, puṇyakāryam, dānam, sarvamaṅgalaṃ ca praśastam. Karmasiddhipradaḥ śubhaśca.

VAIDHRITI.phala: Vaidhṛtiyogaḥ — mahāvighnasya aśubhayogaḥ; śubhārambhe sarvathā varjyaḥ.
VAIDHRITI.phalaProse: Vaidhṛtiyogaḥ atiaśubhadāruṇasañjñakaḥ; mahāvighnasūcakaḥ. Sarvaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ; kevalaṃ śāntidānajapakarma hitam. Atīva sāvadhānatā āvaśyakā.

VAJRA.phala: Vajrayogaḥ — kaṭhoratāyā, āghātasya ca aśubhayogaḥ; śubhārambhe varjyaḥ.
VAJRA.phalaProse: Vajrayogaḥ aśubhasañjñakaḥ; kaṭhorāghātasūcakaḥ. Navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ; ugradṛḍhakarmaṇi eva yogyaḥ. Sāvadhānatā hitā.

VARIYANA.phala: Varīyānyogaḥ — śreṣṭhakāryasya, sukhasya, sarvaśubhasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
VARIYANA.phalaProse: Varīyānyogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Śreṣṭhakāryam, sukhabhogaḥ, maṅgalakarma, sarvaśubhaṃ ca praśastam. Utkṛṣṭaphalapradaḥ śubhaśca.

VISHKAMBHA.phala: Viṣkambhayogaḥ — bādhāsūcakaḥ aśubhayogaḥ; ārambhe sāvadhānatā hitā.
VISHKAMBHA.phalaProse: Viṣkambhayogaḥ aśubhasañjñakaḥ; ārambhe vighnabādhāsūcakaḥ. Navaśubhārambhe sāvadhānatā hitā; pariśrameṇa tu ante siddhiḥ sambhavā. Śāntikarma praśastam.

VRIDDHI.phala: Vṛddhiyogaḥ — vṛddheḥ, samṛddheḥ, dhanakāryasya ca śubhayogaḥ.
VRIDDHI.phalaProse: Vṛddhiyogaḥ śubhasañjñakaḥ. Dhanavṛddhiḥ, vyāpārārambhaḥ, samṛddhikarma, sarvaśubhaṃ ca praśastam. Vardhamānaphalapradaḥ śubhaśca.

VYAGHATA.phala: Vyāghātayogaḥ — āghātasya, virodhasya ca aśubhayogaḥ; śubhārambhe varjyaḥ.
VYAGHATA.phalaProse: Vyāghātayogaḥ aśubhasañjñakaḥ; āghātavirodhasūcakaḥ. Navaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ; ugrakarmaṇi eva yogyaḥ. Śāntikarma hitam.

VYATIPATA.phala: Vyatīpātayogaḥ — mahāvighnasya aśubhayogaḥ; śubhārambhe sarvathā varjyaḥ.
VYATIPATA.phalaProse: Vyatīpātayogaḥ atiaśubhadāruṇasañjñakaḥ; mahāvighnasūcakaḥ. Sarvaśubhārambhaḥ varjyaḥ; kevalaṃ śāntidānajapakarma hitam. Atīva sāvadhānatā āvaśyakā.

BUFFALO.phala: Mahiṣayoniḥ balaṃ sahanaśīlatāṃ śramaśīlaṃ ca sūcayati.
BUFFALO.phalaProse: Mahiṣayonau hasta-svātyoḥ nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Mahiṣayonijātaḥ balavān, sahanaśīlaḥ, śramaśīlaḥ dṛḍhaśca; gambhīraḥ, mandakopī, pariśrameṇa kāryasiddhikaraḥ sthiraśca. Vyavahāre bhāravahanakṣamaḥ, dhairyavān, kaṣṭasahiṣṇuḥ, dīrghakālikakarmasu ca saphalaḥ. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; aśvayonistu mahiṣasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

CAT.phalaProse: Mārjārayonau punarvasu-āśleṣe nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Mārjārayonijātaḥ svatantraḥ, caturaḥ, manasvī satarkaśca; svacchandaḥ, avasarakuśalaḥ, mṛdubāhyaḥ kintu svārtharakṣī. Vyavahāre ātmanirbharaḥ, sukhapriyaḥ, sūkṣmaceṣṭaḥ, svakīyakṣetraṃ ca sāvadhānena rakṣati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; mūṣakayonistu mārjārasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

COW.phala: Goyoniḥ saumyaṃ sahiṣṇuṃ poṣakaṃ ca sūcayati.
COW.phalaProse: Goyonau uttarāphālgunī-uttarābhādrapade nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Goyonijātaḥ saumyaḥ, sahiṣṇuḥ, poṣakaḥ śāntaḥ dhārmikaśca; paropakārī, udāraḥ, śramaśīlaḥ santoṣī ca. Vyavahāre pālanapoṣaṇanirataḥ, kuṭumbavatsalaḥ, sthiracittaḥ, sevayā ca sarveṣāṃ hitakārī bhavati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; vyāghrayonistu goyonyāḥ sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

DEER.phala: Mṛgayoniḥ saumyaṃ cañcalaṃ bhīruṃ ca sūcayati.
DEER.phalaProse: Mṛgayonau anurādhā-jyeṣṭhe nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Mṛgayonijātaḥ saumyaḥ, cañcalaḥ, saundaryapriyaḥ bhīruḥ saṃvedanaśīlaśca; kalāpriyaḥ, śīghratrastaḥ, svatantracārī komalahṛdayaśca. Vyavahāre sukumāraḥ, saundaryarasikaḥ, saṅgharṣaparāṅmukhaḥ, śāntavātāvaraṇapriyaśca bhavati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; śvayonistu mṛgasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

DOG.phalaProse: Śvayonau ārdrā-mūle nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Śvayonijātaḥ svāmibhaktaḥ, satarkaḥ, rakṣaṇaśīlaḥ niṣṭhāvān ca; sāhasī, sevāparaḥ, mitravatsalaḥ kadācicca śīghrakopī. Vyavahāre viśvāsapātraḥ, kartavyaniṣṭhaḥ, āśritānāṃ rakṣakaḥ, snehena ca sahajavaśaḥ bhavati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; mṛgayonistu śvasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

ELEPHANT.phala: Gajayoniḥ gāmbhīryaṃ balaṃ sthairyaṃ ca sūcayati.
ELEPHANT.phalaProse: Gajayonau bharaṇī-revatī nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Gajayonijātaḥ gambhīraḥ, balavān, sthiraḥ, dhairyavān sammānanīyaśca; mandagatiḥ kintu dṛḍhasaṅkalpaḥ, svalpakopī sahiṣṇuśca. Vyavahāre viśālahṛdayaḥ, uttaradāyitvabhāravahanakṣamaḥ, gṛhasthajīvane sthairyaṃ samṛddhiṃ ca ānayati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; siṃhayonistu gajasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

GOAT.phala: Meṣayoniḥ saumyaṃ mṛduṃ snehaśīlaṃ ca sūcayati.
GOAT.phalaProse: Meṣayonau kṛttikā-puṣye nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Meṣayonijātaḥ saumyaḥ, mṛdusvabhāvaḥ, snehaśīlaḥ santoṣī ca; anukūlanaśīlaḥ, samūhapriyaḥ, alpakalahapriyaḥ śāntacittaśca. Vyavahāre sahajasantuṣṭaḥ, parivārasamājayoḥ maitrīpūrṇaḥ, komalasvabhāvena sarvapriyaśca bhavati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; vānarayonistu meṣasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

HORSE.phalaProse: Aśvayonau aśvinī-śatabhiṣe nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Aśvayonijātaḥ cañcalaḥ, tejasvī, ojasvī, udyamaśīlaḥ vegavāṃśca; gatipriyaḥ svatantraḥ sthiratāyāṃ ca aruciḥ. Vyavahāre śīghranirṇayī, sāhasapriyaḥ, yātrāpravāsakarmasu nipuṇaḥ, paratantratāṃ ca na sahate. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat dāmpatye jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; mahiṣayonistu aśvasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

LION.phala: Siṃhayoniḥ parākramaṃ netṛtvaṃ gāmbhīryaṃ ca sūcayati.
LION.phalaProse: Siṃhayonau dhaniṣṭhā-pūrvābhādrapade nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Siṃhayonijātaḥ parākramī, netā, gambhīraḥ ātmābhimānī tejasvī ca; svādhikārapriyaḥ, udāraḥ, anuyāyivatsalaḥ avamānanāsahiṣṇuśca. Vyavahāre adhikārapadayogyaḥ, spaṣṭavaktā, prabhāvaśālī, svatantranirṇayī ca bhavati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; gajayonistu siṃhasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

MONGOOSE.phala: Nakulayoniḥ sāhasaṃ satarkatāṃ cāpalyaṃ ca sūcayati.
MONGOOSE.phalaProse: Nakulayonau uttarāṣāḍhānakṣatram ekameva antarbhavati. Nakulayonijātaḥ sāhasī, satarkaḥ, capalaḥ nirbhīkaḥ niścayī ca; kṣiprapratikriyaḥ, ātmarakṣākuśalaḥ, saṅkaṭe dhīraḥ svatantraśca. Vyavahāre āpatsu avicalaḥ, śatrupratirodhī, dṛḍhaniścayaḥ, svalpe'pi bhaye ca na vicalati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; sarpayonistu nakulasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

MONKEY.phala: Vānarayoniḥ cāpalyaṃ cāturyaṃ krīḍāśīlaṃ ca sūcayati.
MONKEY.phalaProse: Vānarayonau pūrvāṣāḍhā-śravaṇe nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Vānarayonijātaḥ capalaḥ, caturaḥ, krīḍāśīlaḥ buddhimān ca; vinodapriyaḥ, anukaraṇakuśalaḥ, bahumukhapratibhaḥ calacittaśca. Vyavahāre āśugrāhī, sāmājikaḥ, upāyacaturaḥ, nūtanasthānakāryayośca śīghrasamāyojī bhavati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; meṣayonistu vānarasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

RAT.phalaProse: Mūṣakayonau maghā-pūrvāphālgunyau nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Mūṣakayonijātaḥ capalaḥ, caturaḥ, saṅgrahaśīlaḥ buddhimāṃśca; kriyāśīlaḥ, alpasantoṣī, bahukāryapravṛttaḥ sāvadhānaśca. Vyavahāre mitavyayī, udyamī, saṅkaṭe śīghrabuddhiḥ, sādhanasaṅgrahe ca nipuṇaḥ. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; mārjārayonistu mūṣakasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

SERPENT.phalaProse: Sarpayonau rohiṇī-mṛgaśire nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Sarpayonijātaḥ rahasyapriyaḥ, tīkṣṇabuddhiḥ, sūkṣmadarśī ekāntapriyaśca; gūḍhabhāvaḥ, smaraṇaśīlaḥ, avasarajñaḥ kadācicca pratiśodhī. Vyavahāre mantraṇākuśalaḥ, saṅkaṭe śāntaḥ, guptavidyāsu ākarṣitaḥ, svakīyabhāvān ca na prakaṭayati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; nakulayonistu sarpasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.

TIGER.phala: Vyāghrayoniḥ sāhasaṃ tejaḥ svātantryaṃ ca sūcayati.
TIGER.phalaProse: Vyāghrayonau citrā-viśākhe nakṣatre antarbhavataḥ. Vyāghrayonijātaḥ sāhasī, tejasvī, svatantraḥ prabalaḥ ātmābhimānī ca; nirbhīkaḥ, svādhikārapriyaḥ, ekākikāryakṣamaḥ śīghrakopī ca. Vyavahāre netṛtvaśīlaḥ, pratispardhī, anyāyāsahiṣṇuḥ, svamārgānugāmī ca bhavati. Yonikūṭe (aṣṭakūṭamadhye caturaṅkāḥ, yat jaivikamaitrīṃ svābhāvikavṛttiṃ ca parīkṣate) samayonau pūrṇāścatvāraḥ aṅkāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ; goyonistu vyāghrasya sākṣāt śatruyoniḥ, yatra aṅkaḥ alpatamaḥ melanaṃ ca nikṛṣṭam.
